jobs.title: PNT Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**: IS4S is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to support the development of embedded software for Assured Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (APNT) systems working on-site in our Auburn, AL or Huntsville, AL location. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of navigation algorithms, sensor interfaces, platform integration, and software testing for resilient navigation solutions operating in challenging environments, including conditions where GPS/GNSS may be degraded, denied, or unavailable.

This role offers the opportunity to work across the embedded software development lifecycle, from algorithm implementation and hardware interfacing to integration, testing, and performance evaluation. The ideal candidate has strong modern C++ programming skills, experience developing software in Linux environments, and a commitment to producing reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Develop and maintain embedded software components for assured PNT systems using modern C++.

Implement and support navigation algorithms that process data from inertial sensors, GPS/GNSS receivers, clocks, and other navigation sources.

Develop and maintain software interfaces to sensors, embedded hardware, and host platforms.

Integrate software components with navigation hardware and platform systems, troubleshooting hardware/software interface issues.

Develop and execute unit, integration, and system-level tests to verify software functionality and performance.

Analyze test results, investigate defects, and support debugging and performance optimization.

Use Git-based version control, automated build systems, and CI/CD pipelines to support software quality and repeatable development workflows.

Collaborate with systems, hardware, and navigation engineers to develop, integrate, and demonstrate assured PNT capabilities.

**Required Qualifications**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Experience developing software in modern C++, including object-oriented programming, standard library features, and sound software design practices.

Experience developing, building, debugging, and testing software in a Linux environment.

Proficiency with Git or an equivalent modern version control system, including branching, merging, and collaborative development workflows.

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated software build, test, and integration processes.

Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to write clear, maintainable, and well-documented software.

Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with embedded software development on Linux-based platforms.

Familiarity with navigation algorithms, sensor fusion, inertial navigation systems (INS), GPS/GNSS, or other PNT technologies.

Experience interfacing with hardware using serial communications, Ethernet, SPI, I²C, CAN, or similar protocols.

Experience with unit testing frameworks and software quality tools, such as static analysis, code coverage, and automated linting.

Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI/CD.

Familiarity with Python or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping, test automation, and data analysis.

Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing, embedded system integration, or field testing.

**Benefits Summary:**

Competitive salary with comprehensive health and wellness benefits

Dynamic and collaborative work environment

Employee ownership

Medical, dental, and vision care plans

Paid time-off and parental leave programs

Group term life insurance

401(k) retirement plan

Tuition Assistance, Training, and education development offerings

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Senior Software Engineer

**Location**: Huntsville, AL

**Salary Range:** $123,600 - $164,800, plus bonus eligible

**Company Overview**

Founded in 2004 with locations in Atlanta, GA, Fort Worth, TX, Denver, CO, & Huntsville, AL, Thompson Software Solutions (TSS) is a mission-driven aerospace and defense software and systems engineering company supporting the U.S. military, defense primes, and commercial space partners. We specialize in the development, integration, test, and deployment of safety & mission-critical software systems that power next-generation aircraft, defense platforms, and space technologies. Our team understands what it takes to modernize complex embedded systems while maintaining the rigor, compliance, and reliability required for mission and safety-critical environments.

As a defense-focused company of highly skilled and dedicated engineers, we take pride in solving complex technical challenges that directly impact national security and operational readiness. We partner closely with customers across the military aviation and space domains to deliver resilient, future-ready solutions with portability, sustainability, and long-term mission success in mind.

**Description**

**Thompson Software Solutions** is seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** to support the development of embedded flight software and Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) capabilities for an advanced missile platform. This role offers the opportunity to design and integrate mission-critical software operating in high-performance, real-time environments where precision, reliability, and deterministic execution are paramount.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will develop embedded flight software, contribute to the architecture, design, implementation, integration, and verification of real-time systems supporting missile guidance, navigation, and control functions. You will work at the intersection of software, hardware, and control algorithms to ensure accurate sensor processing, state estimation, trajectory management, and actuator command execution under strict timing and performance constraints.

This position requires deep expertise in embedded and real-time software development, including low-level hardware interfaces, multi-threaded and deterministic system design, integration with GNC algorithms, and operation within safety- and mission-critical frameworks. Experience supporting hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments, simulation integration, system-level test, and flight qualification activities is highly valued.

You will collaborate closely with software engineers, GNC engineers, systems engineers, integration and test teams, and program leadership to mature capabilities from lab development through system qualification and flight test.

The successful candidate will join a high-performing software engineering team focused on delivering next-generation missile capabilities. This role requires strong systems thinking, exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills, and the ability to lead in a fast-paced, high-consequence development environment where performance and reliability are mission critical.

Selected applicants will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Continued eligibility for access to classified information is required throughout employment, as dictated by program needs.

**Basic Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in STEM discipline
* 5+ years of embedded software development
* Experience developing embedded software in C/C++
* Experience with I&T integration and test.
* Experience with Full Lifecycle Software Development
* Experience with (FSW) Flight software engineering
* Proficient with Linux and Windows development environments
* Ability to professionally communicate project status and collaborate on technical solutions with clients and peers
* Active Secret Clearance Required
* Ability to work onsite 100%
* Perform additional job duties as assigned.

**Preferred / Additional Skills**

* Proficient with Atlassian Tools (Confluence, JIRA, Bitbucket, etc.)
* Proficient in Python development
* Familiarity with Model-Based System Engineering (MBSE) concepts and tools (Cameo, AADL)
* Experience with Digital Simulation Development and integration
* Experience with safety-critical software development and practices (DO-178C)
* Experience with Navigation, Guidance and Control Implementation
* Experience with Signal Processing Implementation
* Experience developing Embedded Flight Software
* Experience communicating and documenting complex technical designs
* Ability to work in a collaborative and team-based environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills

**Sound Exciting?** Get in touch today! We have very robust benefits including:

* Low-cost Medical / Dental / Vision coverage options
* 401K with generous employer match
* Responsible Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays
* Remote work opportunities based on role
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Career growth and professional development opportunities

*Lynx is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, gender, color, disability, national origin, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity and/or expression, or other characteristics or status protected by law.*

jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

As the Manufacturing Robotics Engineer you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying robotic and industrial‑automation solutions that enable high‑mix, high‑value missile production.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

* Partner with missile designers, production operations, and stakeholders to design and integrate robotic, conveyor, vision, and control systems.
* Perform hands‑on integration and commissioning of robots, end‑of‑arm tools, and related equipment.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing processes, procedures, and layouts to maximize quality, safety, and efficiency.
* Lead the lifecycle of automated solutions from concept through implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure all designs comply with government regulations, company command media, industrial safety standards, and engineering requirements.

We are looking for a collaborative, results‑driven engineer who thrives in a fast‑moving, technically demanding environment. If you enjoy turning cutting‑edge ideas into reliable production assets and want to make a tangible impact on mission‑critical systems, this role offers the autonomy, resources, and support to excel. We value your expertise and invest in your growth.

We are committed to supporting your work‑life balance and overall well‑being, offering flexible scheduling options. Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s comprehensive benefits package here.

**Further Information About This Opportunity**

This position is in Troy. Discover more about our Troy, Alabama location.

**Security Clearance Requirement**

MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN - This position is located at a facility that requires special access. The selected candidate must possess an active Interim-Secret clearance to start.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering/Science, Physics, or other related discipline with 2 years of professional experience integrating and supporting factory automation and robotics for industrial use.

  

* Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and retain a U.S. DoD Secret Security Clearance. Lockheed Martin will assist selected candidate with obtaining at least an Interim Secret Clearance prior to starting.  
    
  Must be able to pass a Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (“ATF”) background investigation to obtain “employee possessor” approval (of explosives or other ATF-regulated items) as defined by ATF regulations. Failure to obtain and retain employee possessor status may result in revocation of an offer and loss of employment.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

Ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings and/or specifications.

Daily experience supporting various robotic applications (collaborative, material removal/finishing, material handling, and painting).

Working knowledge of Allen-Bradley (Rockwell Automation) programmable logic controllers (PLC) SLC 500 & ControlLogix5000, Ladder Logic, FANUC robotics and controls.

Proven project management skills of various automation and robotic projects from concept through final commissioning in a manufacturing factory environment.

Experience integrating machine‑vision systems (e.g., Cognex, Keyence) and sensor suites (force/torque, proximity, RFID) into robotic cells for quality inspection and adaptive control.

Knowledge of Ethernet/IP for integrating robots and PLCs into IIoT.

Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen principles to robotic line optimization, downtime reduction, and throughput enhancement.

Full-Time Salary Range: $70500.00 - $130900.00

Our RMS business in Huntsville, AL is a hub of talented engineers, scientists, and professionals committed to shaping the future of defense technology. We value collaboration, excellence, and integrity in everything we do. As a part of our team, you will work alongside like-minded individuals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

**The Work**

The selected Engineer will support the Ground-based Midcourse Defense (GMD) Weapon System (GWS) program as an individual contributor on the Architecture and Delivery (A&D) Automated Test and Verification (ATV) Team and is responsible for developing automation related SW development products in support of the GWS contract execution on behalf of the Missile Defense Agency (MDA).

* Our flexible schedules, competitive pay and comprehensive benefits enable you to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work.

* Experience with requirements management tools such as DOORS
* Familiarity with Agile software development using tools like Jira, Confluence, Fisheye/Crucible, and Bitbucket
* Post Test Analysis experience
* Familiar with Test Automation or Scripting (python or other coding language) to support test execution or analysis activities
* Must have an active Final Secret clearance or higher

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Experience with requirements decomposition and requirements management
* Experience with Requirement Verification methods such as Test
* GMD program knowledge
* Demonstrated independent planning, organization, and working in cross-functional teams with a customer focus
* Understanding of the Systems Engineering V-Model
* Experience developing technical solutions in collaboration with product teams
* Experience in software development related to Test Automation
* Experience using Jenkins and Elasticsearch
* Experience in Agile/Scrum leadership roles such as Scrum Master or Product Owner
* Current Security+ certification
* Professional experience development using Python or similar languages

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $98100.00 - $182100.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

jobs.description:
***Why Join Rincon Research Corporation (RRC)?***

At Rincon Research Corporation, our primary business is innovating, developing, and fielding digital signal processing (DSP) products and services for the United States Defense and Intelligence Communities in support of national security.

Rincon Research Corporation (RRC), an employee owned company, is seeking a talented, tenacious, results-driven individualto work in a multi-disciplinary R&D environment with similarly motivated electrical engineers, mathematicians, computer scientists, and analysts who are collectively responsible for creating custom digital signal processing solutions and leveraging them to make an operational mission impact.

Come join the team that is creating cutting edge signal processing and geolocation systems for the future!

***What are the primary responsibilities in the Sr. Software Engineer position?***

The position requires broad experience developing and leading teams in development of software for embedded and DSP systems. This role requires a self-starter with the ability and desire to achieve wide project situational awareness. This role requires working well with all functional areas: systems engineering, hardware, firmware/gateware, development, integration and test, project management, and project stakeholders including customers.

***What*** ***required*** ***background will make you successful?***

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent
* A minimum of 10 years of relevant software development experience
* Experience as a technical leader of a small team
* Knowledge of signal processing for GNSS systems
* Expertise developing for Linux or embedded Linux
* Basic understanding of electronic hardware such as microprocessors, FPGAs, and GPUs
* Experience with device drivers and APIs for Linux
* Skill developing with Python or Java
* Understanding of product lifecycle management including configuration management, release management, and verification of functional and performance requirements
* Experience with agile development leadership and devsecops
* Ability to perform in both rapid-prototyping and formal-process environments
* Current SECRET security clearance
* US CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED

***Preferred skills:***

* Experience with Yocto or similar ecosystems
* Experience using GitLab
* Device driver development experience
* Experience with middleware transport frameworks such as zeroMQ or Thrift
* Understanding of computer networks
* Experience programming for high speed I/O such as PCIe, 10/25/40/100GbE, and SSDs

***Where is the position located?***

This position is located onsite at our Tucson, AZ Headquarters.

* ***The likely salary range for this position is $174,000 to $210,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.***

* 100% employer-paid premiums for family medical and dental insurance, employee life insurance, short-term and long-term disability (STD & LTD)

The **Effector Digital Products** (EDP) department designs digital electronic circuit cards and electronic units which are supported from proposal through transition to production. The Digital, RF and Power Team is seeking a **Principal Digital Design Engineer** with digital electronics design and analysis skills to join our team.

This position is **100% ONSITE** in Tucson, Arizona.

**What You Will Do**

We are looking for candidates willing to collaborate, innovate, and team with our engineers to generate and utilize today’s cutting-edge technology to design digital electronics circuits that implement missile guidance, video and digital signal processing. Our technology base includes high-speed digital electronics, configurable logic, and homogeneous / heterogeneous multiprocessor designs.

The **Principal Digital Design Engineer** is responsible for the design, analysis, simulation, test, and integration of digital electronic modules and/or CCAs for Missile applications. The candidate should be experienced in all aspects of circuit card design including:

* hardware designs with processors
* FPGAs
* memory
* industry interfaces, such as PCIe, Ethernet, I2C, SPI, and UART

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 8 years of prior relevant experience
* Minimum of 8 years of engineering digital circuit design experience to include at least 2 of the following:
  + Development and design of electronic circuit designs, multi-assembly system/unit design
  + Ability to take a design concept from the block diagram or requirements level to development of a complete hardware design, and verification via test and integration
  + Experience with PCB design process and expertise in tools used to design (schematic capture), analyze and simulate designs prior to hardware execution.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering
* Experience with embedded test techniques, design for test, design margin analysis and design for production for complex circuit card assemblies between 16 and 32 layers
* Experience using Mentor Graphics Design Creation (Siemens EDA) tools: DxDesigner, xDX Designer VX, and Xilinx (Zynq Ultrascale, Vivado, Atrix)
* Experience using PCB electronic circuit design software: HyperLynx signal integrity, power integrity, and analog simulation, Xpedition Enterprise (xPCB)
* Constraint Editor System (CES)
* Experience with FPGA code development or software
* Experience leading a program transition from development to production
* Experience managing technical/schedule risks to identify cost reduction opportunities to meet assigned deadlines
* Experience with intellectual property generation (patents & publications)

**What We Offer**

Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

* This position offers relocation

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

Please consider the following role type definition as you apply for this role:

Employees who are working in **Onsite roles will work primarily onsite**. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

This position requires a security clearance. DCSA Consolidated Adjudication Services (DCSA CAS), an agency of the Department of Defense, handles and adjudicates the security clearance process. **Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Sr. Principal Electrical Engineer 4 – Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE)

Northrop Grumman Space Systems is currently seeking an experienced Principal Electrical Engineer to join our electrical ground support equipment group in our Chandler, AZ facility. Our electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) team supports our programs with the design, test, and sustainment of all EGSE and test support equipment hardware used in the integration and launch of our vehicles. Our EGSE team members work in a diverse set of roles across the lifecycle of a program.

Job Duties: Based on specific objectives, work with a system electrical engineering team to perform analysis, design, and test of complex “system level” designs with a focus on the electrical ground support equipment and test support equipment for the launch vehicle.

Job responsibilities:

* Broad understanding and application of company electrical engineering technical standards.
* Broad technical expertise and working knowledge of other related disciplines.
* Prepares and presents electrical engineering materials for Requirements and Design Reviews.
* With minimal guidance, studies basic design concepts and criteria for more complex problems.
* Applies electrical engineering principles to adapt or improve upon heritage features from previous successful designs of a similar nature.
* Actively and effectively participates and contributes in a positive manner while supporting team decisions and goals.
* Makes an extra effort to provide quality internal and external customer service.
* Constantly seeks new sources of information and provides information necessary to meet customer needs.
* Disciplined with escalation when required.
* Derives requirements through multiple sources of documentation and design meetings.
* Evaluate, with supervision, uncertainty and risks associated with requirements and designs.
* Patriciate in trade studies for both internal projects and procured equipment.
* Act with safety as your number one priority through every aspect of the role.
* Provides formal peer review of simple engineering designs or analyses for less experienced engineers.
* Completing day-to-day activities with no oversight of senior engineers.

Desired Experience:

* Design, test, and/or integration and deployment of electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) or test support equipment (TSE).
* Design, test, programming, and/or integration and deployment of automated test equipment (ATE).
* Testing of avionics, electronic components, or electrical systems using purpose designed test equipment.
* Burndown of nonconformances and/or root cause failure analysis of electronic systems.
* Release of engineering documentation including technical drawings, specifications, and test procedures.
* Leading teams or personnel in the execution of test procedures.
* Leading teams or personnel in the design of electronic equipment.
* Management or tracking of projects through a product life cycle.
* Support of manufacturing engineering during the production of test equipment products.
* Experience with telemetry systems including decoms and chapter 10 recorders.
* Development or support of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) or other integrations labs.
* Problem solving not only for technical issues, but also for schedule, cost, resource and other project challenges.
* Mentoring and cross-training team members across a diverse set of technologies and equipment architectures used to meet customer requirements.
* Knowledgeable with the use of basic test equipment such as power supplies, oscilloscopes, DMMs, and electronic loads.
* Broad or high-level circuit design and analysis.

Also seeking experience in any of the following:

* LabVIEW/TestStand programming and NI hardware and software products.
* Contributions to process improvement initiatives.
* CompTIA Security+ or similar certifications.
* Usage and troubleshooting of networks, Windows systems, and RHEL or other Linux distributions.
* Experience with classified test systems or systems subject to cyber security policies.

Basic Qualifications for Principal Electrical Engineer - 4

* Requires 8 years with a Bachelor’s in Engineering or 5 years with a Master’s in Engineering.
* Ability to obtain DoD Secret Clearance at time of application.
* U.S. Citizenship is required
* Proficient knowledge of electrical engineering principles.
* Design, Test, or Integration experience with EGSE or similar equipment.
* Experience with processes applicable to operating EGSE in secure environments.

jobs.description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > DSP Architecture and Design

**General Summary:**

**General Summary**

Qualcomm is seeking a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (6+ years of experience) to join the Core Platform Kernel software team. The Core Platform Kernel team develops and deploys real-time operating system (RTOS) software across multiple subsystems on Qualcomm SoCs, servicing Mobile Handset, XR, Compute, Automotive, Cloud AI, and IoT market segments. The team is responsible for the deployment and evolution of two RTOS platforms at scale: QuRT OS and Zephyr RTOS.

  

As part of Qualcomm's continued investment in open source software, this role will help drive our Zephyr strategy and serve as a technical leader for Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr ecosystem. We are specifically seeking engineers who can contribute to and help maintain upstream Zephyr components while enabling Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm products. This role is well suited for engineers who enjoy deep technical work, influence system architecture, collaborate across organizational boundaries, and have a passion for building software that benefits both Qualcomm products and the broader open-source community.

  

What You'll Do As a Staff Engineer, you will:

* Design, implement, and maintain RTOS and low-level system software components.
* Own and drive resolution of complex system-level issues involving performance, stability, scalability, and correctness.
* Lead feature development from problem definition through deployment.
* Analyze crash dumps, traces, and logs to perform deep root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate closely with hardware, systems, validation, and software teams to deliver robust solutions.
* Participate actively in design and code reviews, influencing technical direction and engineering standards.
* Drive Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr open-source community through technical discussions, code reviews, and upstream collaboration.
* Mentor engineers on upstream development practices, code quality, and community engagement.
Influence technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and software quality initiatives across the organization.  

  

You will be expected to take ownership of key technical areas, make sound engineering tradeoffs, and help raise the effectiveness of the broader team through technical leadership and example. QuRT OS QuRT OS is Qualcomm's real-time operating system optimized for the Hexagon DSP, enabling high-performance, low-power workloads including edge AI, modem processing, audio, sensor processing, and other specialized compute workloads. In the QuRT OS space, you will:

* Drive enhancements to expose the full capability of the Hexagon processor architecture.
* Design and implement new RTOS features with attention to correctness, performance, and maintainability.
* Own features end-to-end: requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, integration, and support.
Improve CI, automation, and test infrastructure to increase development velocity and software quality.  

  

Zephyr RTOS The Core Platform Kernel team is a major adopter of Zephyr RTOS across Qualcomm SoCs and subsystems. We maintain a scalable Zephyr platform while contributing improvements back to the upstream community. This role is focused on technical leadership, stewardship, and upstream engineering within the Zephyr ecosystem. Successful candidates will possess a strong understanding of RTOS architecture, embedded systems, and open-source development practices. In the Zephyr space, you will:

* Serve as a maintainer or technical owner for key Zephyr subsystems, drivers, platform infrastructure, or architecture components.
* Review, guide, and integrate contributions from both internal and external developers.
* Design and implement new Zephyr capabilities with an emphasis on upstream acceptance and long-term maintainability.
* Lead architecture discussions and influence technical direction within the Zephyr project.
* Drive Qualcomm's upstream contribution strategy and ensure internal development aligns with community best practices.
* Collaborate with maintainers and contributors from other companies across the Zephyr ecosystem.
* Enable Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm platforms through board support packages, architecture enablement, driver development, and system software integration.
* Improve testing, CI infrastructure, release readiness, and software quality across upstream and Qualcomm-maintained components.
* Represent Qualcomm in technical working groups, design reviews, and community discussions.
Help shape the future evolution of Zephyr through upstream contributions, reviews, and technical leadership.  

  

**How You Work (Tools, Automation & Modern Engineering)**

Staff Engineers at Qualcomm are expected to be force multipliers, not just individual contributors. In practice, this means:

* Applying modern development tools, including AI-assisted tools, when they meaningfully improve productivity or code quality.
* Leveraging automation, scripting, CI systems, debuggers, profilers, static analysis tools, and simulation environments to improve engineering effectiveness.
* Exercising strong engineering judgment regarding when automation is appropriate and when deeper hands-on investigation is required.
Continuously identifying opportunities to improve engineering workflows, developer productivity, and software quality.  

  

You are not expected to be an AI expert, but you are expected to be tool-fluent, curious, adaptable, and pragmatic.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

OR
  
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relate

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Test & Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About Mainspring**

Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

* Pragmatic Optimism
* Excellence without Ego
* Proactive Collaboration

### **Job Overview**

Mainspring Energy has fundamentally redefined onsite power generation. Our breakthrough product—the Mainspring Linear Generator (LGen)—is a completely new category of energy technology. Distinct from an engine, turbine, or fuel cell, the LGen directly converts straight-line motion into electricity using a low-temperature, non-combustion thermochemical reaction.

With only two moving parts per core, a frictionless air-bearing system, and zero-flame chemical conversions, we deliver over 46% net AC electrical efficiency. More importantly, it is the world’s only commercially available technology capable of real-time fuel-switching under load, seamlessly transitioning between natural gas, biogas/RNG, propane, hydrogen, and ammonia.

Behind this mechanical simplicity lies an incredibly complex software abstraction layer. To achieve dynamic load-following, sub-millisecond grid synchronization, and real-time thermochemical adaptive fuel mixing, our proprietary controls manage thousands of high-frequency variables simultaneously.

As a Senior Staff Software Test & Automation Engineer, you will architect the core validation and automation frameworks that ensure this distributed energy asset operates with 100% safety and utility-scale reliability. You will own the strategy for testing the intersection of real-time embedded software, predictive control loops, and multi-fuel dynamics.

### **Responsibilities**

* Architect Automation & Test Infrastructure: Design, scale, and maintain custom hardware test beds alongside robust, reusable test automation frameworks, software tools, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines
* System Validation & Integration: Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, technical test approaches, and traceability matrices to validate complex hardware/software integrations and resolve system-level bottlenecks
* Root Cause & Failure Analysis: Lead deep-dive failure analysis, debug and diagnose issues found during testing, and champion risk mitigation strategies to ensure test stability and environmental reliability
* Strategic Coverage: Drive risk-based testing strategies, performing risk analysis to ensure 100% comprehensive test coverage of all critical-path functionalities
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with development teams and support cross-functional engineering initiatives to diagnose system anomalies and vet new technologies

### **Qualifications (Must Haves)**

* Experience & Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field with 16+ years of professional experience, or a Master’s degree with 15+ years in an SDET, Embedded Test, or Software Engineering role
* Strategic Automation Leadership: A proven track record of leading complex automation projects from design to implementation, combined with the foundational ability to perform deep-dive manual exploratory testing and technical test case design
* Technical Versatility: Strong hands-on software development experience in Python and C++, with the flexibility to navigate, debug, and contribute to diverse codebases (including Bash scripting) as the project requires
* AI Workflow Ownership: Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants as a force multiplier for productivity, combined with the professional judgment to challenge, validate, and expand upon AI-generated solutions to ensure system integrity and long-term maintainability
* Domain Expertise: Professional experience testing and validating systems in at least three of the following areas: Cloud computing, embedded systems, networking, IoT with RTOS, controls, simulations (MIL/SIL/PIL), emulators, or complex algorithms

### **Desirable Qualifications**

* DevOps & Infrastructure: Experience working with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and configuration management via Ansible
* Industry Tooling: High proficiency with common industry test and development workflows like Jira, Xray, GitLab, or equivalent tools

This position is **onsite** at our **Menlo Park HQ**. The salary will be adjusted to reflect local market conditions based on employee location as well as the experience of the employee. Along with the base salary, Mainspring offers pre-IPO stock options + benefits.

Does your experience not meet all of our posted requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to positions unless they meet every listed requirement. At Mainspring, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, flexible, and collaborative environment, so if you want to help us transition the world to clean and affordable electricity, and don’t meet all posted requirements for a particular role, we’d still love to hear from you. Mainspring can sometimes be flexible enough to shift responsibilities for the right person, or otherwise identify open or upcoming roles that may better fit your professional background.

In more traditional words, Mainspring Energy, Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against

==================

Bright Silicon Technologies (BST) develops precision optical systems built around our Lightfield Directing Array (LDA), a MEMS micromirror array for fast, precise control of light. Our OCTANE free-space optical communications terminal brings together free-space optics, fiber-based photonics, and communications hardware to enable high-bandwidth links between ground and airborne platforms.  
  
We’re looking for a software engineer to own modem integration and communications software for OCTANE. jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Matternet is building the future of delivery with autonomous drone networks that move critical goods faster, cleaner, and at lower cost. We work with partners across healthcare, logistics, food, and retail to deliver everything from medical items to everyday essentials, safely and reliably.

We’re seeking an Embedded Systems Engineer to make the boards, sensors, and software on our aircraft and ground stations work together as reliable systems. Working at the boundary between hardware and software, you’ll define interfaces and requirements, bring up and integrate new boards and peripherals, and prove they work through bench, hardware-in-the-loop, and flight testing. You’ll work closely with our Electrical, Mechanical, and Onboard Software teams, alongside senior engineers who will help you grow your scope.

In this role, you will:

* Integrate boards, sensors, actuators, and communication links into working subsystems on our aircraft and ground stations
* Define and document subsystem requirements and interfaces, including messages, timing, power, and failure behavior across CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, and BLE
* Bring up new boards and hardware revisions with Electrical, and write the firmware and test code needed to exercise them
* Plan and run subsystem verification, from bench and hardware-in-the-loop testing through flight test, including test plans, acceptance criteria, and sign-off
* Contribute to component and sensor selection and trade studies, and review schematics and designs with Electrical
* Triage integration and field issues across hardware, firmware, and comms, and collaborate with Electrical, Mechanical, Onboard Software, Operations, Safety, and Production

  
**Requirements**  

* BS in Electrical, Computer, or Systems Engineering, or a related field, and 3+ years in embedded systems, hardware/software integration, or test
* Working proficiency in C/C++ for firmware and test tooling, plus Python for automation and data analysis
* Solid knowledge of embedded communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART) and how to debug them
* Comfort reading board-level schematics and datasheets, and debugging at the signal level using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers
* Experience writing requirements, test plans, and acceptance criteria, and verifying a subsystem against them
* Ability to support flight test needs and debug systems rapidly at our flight test facility
* Clear technical communication and strong cross-disciplinary teamwork in a fast-paced environment

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* UAV, autonomous robotics, aerospace, or other safety-critical regulated experience
* Experience with hardware-in-the-loop test setups and test automation
* Familiarity with an autopilot stack such as ArduPilot or PX4, and UAV/avionics technologies (ADS-B, GPS/GNSS, LiDAR, radar)
* Experience with embedded Linux on ARM, an RTOS, or bare-metal firmware
* Experience with power systems, battery management systems, or smart battery ICs
* Experience with environmental, EMI/EMC, or reliability testing

* Experience using AI coding assistants to accelerate development

**Benefits**

At Matternet, we’re advancing a new era of logistics, one where autonomous drones deliver what matters faster, cleaner, and more efficiently. We know our mission is challenging, but it's worth it, and we are committed to taking care of the people who make it possible.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Embedded Systems
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Software Engineer to join our embedded engineering team, where you will develop low-level software and firmware that powers consumer hardware products. In this role, you will work at the intersection of hardware and software, building reliable, performant embedded systems that operate under strict resource constraints. You will contribute to the full embedded software development lifecycle, from system bring-up and driver development to real-time operating system integration and hardware abstraction layer design, helping shape the foundation of Meta's next generation of connected devices.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Embedded Systems Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and maintain embedded firmware and low-level software components for resource-constrained hardware platforms
* Develop and debug hardware abstraction layers, device drivers, and board support packages for custom silicon and peripherals
* Integrate and configure real-time operating systems (RTOS) to meet latency, power, and memory requirements
* Write automated tests including unit, integration, and hardware-in-the-loop tests to validate firmware behavior across expected and error conditions
* Instrument firmware with logging, metrics, and alerting to support observability and production reliability
* Collaborate with hardware engineers, silicon teams, and product partners to define firmware interfaces and resolve cross-disciplinary dependencies
* Participate in code reviews to improve firmware quality, identify common embedded software defects, and share knowledge with peers
* Analyze and optimize firmware for power consumption, memory footprint, and real-time execution performance
* Own embedded software components end-to-end, including responding to production issues and maintaining code health through deprecation of obsolete implementations
* Produce clear technical documentation for firmware interfaces, bring-up procedures, and system behaviors to support current and future contributors

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience developing embedded firmware or low-level software in C or C++
* Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS), bare-metal programming, or embedded Linux environments
* Experience developing or debugging device drivers, hardware abstraction layers, or board support packages for microcontrollers or SoCs
* Experience writing automated tests and using debugging tools such as JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or serial debuggers to isolate and resolve firmware defects
* Experience analyzing and optimizing embedded software for power, latency, or memory constraints

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with sensor fusion, signal conditioning, or ADC/DAC interfacing
* Experience with optical sensor integration and signal processing
* Experience with communication protocols commonly used in embedded systems such as SPI, I2C, UART, USB, or Bluetooth Low Energy
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience with power optimization for battery-constrained wearable or portable devices
* Experience developing firmware for low power analog sensors
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Familiarity with continuous integration workflows adapted for embedded targets, including cross-compilation and hardware-in-the-loop testing pipelines
* Experience with embedded software development for consumer electronics, wearables, or IoT devices

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

jobs.title: Staff Embedded Linux Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About SirenOpt**

SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro- and nano-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks.

SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made.

We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia.

**About the job**

**Job Title:** Staff Embedded Linux Software Engineer — Firmware Team

**Location:** On-Site (San Leandro, CA)

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Role Overview**

SirenOpt is seeking an **Embedded Linux Software Engineer** to join a small, high-impact firmware team building the embedded software stack for a commercial bench-top scientific instrument. The platform is an AMD/Xilinx FPGA SoC (Zynq / UltraScale+) running PetaLinux, with a mix of userspace applications, device drivers, and real-time control interfacing with custom programmable logic.

You'll work alongside an embedded systems architect who owns the Linux application layer, peripheral subsystems, protocol design, and hardware integration. Your core mandate is threefold: share the Linux application workload, own test automation infrastructure, and establish CI/build reliability. You'll write production code and the tooling that proves it works.

This is a small, documentation-driven team, and you'll be expected to write clear design docs and track progress in Jira/Confluence. The role combines hands-on lab work with prototype hardware and desk-based software development, following a sequenced release cadence (HDL OS/drivers embedded applications system integration).

**What You'll Do**

* Develop embedded Linux application software in C (userspace, POSIX)
* Develop userspace and kernel-space drivers for internal and external devices (sensors, actuators, instruments)
* Implement and extend application-level command/control/data protocols over TCP/IP
* Implement communication drivers for industrial instruments (mass flow controllers, vacuum gauges, motor controllers) over serial and CAN interfaces
* Design, build, and maintain hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) automated test systems
* Develop host-side test tooling (Python GUIs, emulators, scripted instrument drivers)
* Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines and reproducible build infrastructure
* Participate in hardware bring-up, board-level validation, and lab bench debugging
* Contribute to architecture decisions, documentation, and design reviews

**What We're Looking For**

* S., M.S., or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, with 10+ years of relevant industry experience
* C for embedded Linux userspace, including threading, IPC, and POSIX APIs
* Python for test automation (pytest or equivalent framework) and scripted instrumentation
* TCP/IP socket programming on Linux (non-blocking I/O, connection lifecycle, streaming)
* UDP for discovery and lightweight telemetry
* Bus and serial protocols: UART, SPI, I2C, and CAN
* RS-232 and RS-485, including byte-level protocol implementation (framing, CRC, state machines, multi-device arbitration)
* Hardware bring-up and board-level debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers
* Producer-consumer and ring buffer patterns for real-time data flow
* Hardware-in-the-loop test development and execution

**Nice to have:**

* Linux DMA programming (scatter-gather, buffer pool management, AXI-DMA)
* CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Docker-based build environments)
* Yocto or PetaLinux BSP experience
* Unit test frameworks for C (gtest, cmocka, Unity)
* Familiarity with FPGA register interfaces (UIO, devmem, register maps)
* Performance profiling and network analysis (Wireshark, throughput characterization)
* Python GUI development for test/operator tooling (Tkinter, PyQt)
* Familiarity with scientific or process-control instrumentation

**Benefits**

* Equity and Salary compensation depends on experience
* Health, Dental, Vision plans provided
* 401k matching provided
* Time off: 20 days of PTO per year, plus approximately 15 paid US holidays per year

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Cyngn, Inc.**

Based in Mountain View, CA, Cyngn is a publicly-traded autonomous technology company. We deploy self-driving industrial vehicles -**specifically autonomous tuggers**- to factories, warehouses, and other facilities throughout North America. To build this emergent technology, we are looking for innovative, motivated, and experienced leaders to join us and move this field forward. If you like to build, tinker, and create with a team of trusted and passionate colleagues, then Cyngn is the place for you.

**Key reasons to join Cyngn:**

**We are small and big.**

With under 100 employees, Cyngn operates with the energy of a startup. On the other hand, we’re publicly traded. This means our employees not only work in close-knit teams with mentorship from company leaders—they also get access to the liquidity of our publicly-traded equity.

**We build today and deploy tomorrow.**

Our autonomous vehicles aren’t just test concepts—they’re deployed to real clients right now. That means your work will have a tangible, visible impact.

**We aren’t robots. We just develop them.**

We’re a welcoming, diverse team of sharp thinkers and kind humans. Collaboration and trust drive our creative environment. At Cyngn, everyone’s perspective matters—and that’s what powers our innovation.

**About the role**

As a **Senior Robotics Systems Software Engineer on Cyngn’s Autonomy team**, you will develop, integrate, and deploy software across the autonomous driving stack for our industrial vehicles.

This role is ideal for a strong robotics generalist who enjoys working across subsystem boundaries. Depending on the problem, you may contribute to behavior and decision-making, motion planning, controls, localization, perception interfaces, simulation, or vehicle integration.

You will work closely with engineers across autonomy, vehicle infrastructure, hardware, QA, and deployment to turn robotics algorithms into reliable production systems operating on autonomous tuggers and forklifts at customer sites.

**What you'll do**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy software for autonomous industrial vehicles across areas including behavior and decision-making, motion planning, controls, and vehicle systems.
* Write and maintain production-quality C++ and Python software running on Cyngn’s autonomous vehicle platforms.
* Develop and integrate algorithms for navigation, trajectory generation, vehicle control, obstacle handling, and autonomous behaviors.
* Integrate autonomy software with sensors, drive-by-wire systems, vehicle hardware, and other onboard software components.
* Bring up, validate, and debug software on real vehicles, tracing issues across autonomy modules, middleware, hardware interfaces, and vehicle behavior.
* Develop simulation scenarios, testing infrastructure, metrics, and regression tests to validate autonomy behavior before deployment.
* Investigate field issues and edge cases, reproduce failures, identify root causes, and implement robust production solutions.
* Support deployment and validation of autonomous vehicles at customer facilities, translating real-world observations into improvements across the autonomy stack.
* Collaborate closely with engineers in Planning, Controls, Perception, Localization, Vehicle Infrastructure, Hardware, QA, and Operations.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical design, and continuous improvement of Cyngn’s autonomy software.

**Priorities: 3-6-12 Month Goals**

**First 90 Days**

* Build a working understanding of Cyngn’s autonomy architecture, simulation environment, vehicle platforms, development workflow, and deployment process.
* Partner with engineers across autonomy, infrastructure, hardware, QA, and operations to trace representative vehicle behaviors, build working relationships, and identify high-value reliability, integration, and test-coverage risks.
* Deliver one scoped production improvement—such as fixing a well-understood autonomy defect, adding a regression scenario, or improving diagnostic tooling—and validate it in simulation and, where appropriate, on a vehicle.
* Propose a prioritized plan for addressing one or two larger cross-stack risks, including candidate success metrics, data sources, and how each metric will be measured.

**By 6 Months**

* Complete a production-quality autonomy improvement that spans two or more subsystem boundaries and has been accepted into a release candidate and/or at production customer sites.
* Establish the agreed baseline metrics and demonstrate early improvement, such as improved scenario pass rate, fewer interventions, reduced tracking error, or faster failure resolution.
* Add reusable simulation scenarios, regression tests, diagnostics, or validation tools that are incorporated into the team’s release-candidate testing.
* Publish a technical design or process improvement that is reviewed and adopted by the affected teams.

**By 12 Months**

* Demonstrate sustained, measurable production improvement against the six-month baseline through broader deployment and fleet monitoring.
* Own a significant autonomy capability from design through implementation, vehicle validation, deployment, and production monitoring.
* Improve team effectiveness through documentation, code and design reviews, and reusable cross-stack debugging practices.
* Demonstrate technical ownership through observable signals: serving as a reviewer for one or two repositories, leading triage for a class of field issues, or maintaining adopted runbooks and tools used by other engineers.

**Qualifications**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience developing software for robotics, autonomous vehicles, or other autonomous systems.
* Strong proficiency in modern C++ and working proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Testing
jobs.description:
**About IonQ:**  
  
IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  
  
**About Vector Atomic:**

Vector Atomic, an IonQ company, is building quantum technology to transform navigation, timing, geophysical exploration, and telecommunications. Our team of engineers, scientists, software developers, and operations professionals works together to solve complex challenges and turn bold ideas into real-world solutions. We value collaboration, curiosity, and diverse perspectives, and we give every team member the opportunity to make an immediate impact while growing their skills. If you're excited to work on breakthrough technology in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, we'd love to hear from you.

We are seeking an experienced test engineer to collaborate with our diverse group of physicists, electrical, mechanical, and optical engineers. Vector Atomics has the opportunity to disrupt industries with world-beating sensor performance. Success requires rapid development of specialized, cutting-edge electronics. To support the development effort, an equally challenging effort is required to rapidly improve our verification procedures and approaches.

In this critical role, you'll be part of the technical team defining the direction of our hardware test strategy. The right candidate will be comfortable not only executing test procedures, but also creating them. They should be able to work effectively in the lab and assist with debugging challenging board-level issues with custom electronics. They must lead by example and actively engage early-career engineers as mentors.  
  
**Location:** This role is based onsite at our office in Pleasanton, CA.  
**Travel:** Up to 10%, domestic or international.

 **Requirements**

**What You’ll Do**

* Be a technical leader for a growing group that is tasked with both testing and debugging complex electronic circuits. The circuits include a mix of technologies, including FPGAs, MCUs, mixed-signal, precision analog and photonics devices.
* Collaborate with physicists, electrical, mechanical, software, and optical engineers to develop test procedures to verify electronic designs for next-generation quantum instruments.
* Collaborate with engineering and manufacturing to define DFT and DFM improvements.
* Create test plans for performance, environmental, EMI and EMC testing. Oversee and manage execution of these plans at external facilities, when necessary. This role requires the ability to adapt test protocols on the fly to optimize results.
* Use electronic test and measurement equipment to characterize and verify performance.
* Define equipment for automated data systems for production systems.
* Write test scripts for automated test systems for configuraiton and measurement of results.

**Required expertise:**

* BSEE/MSEE Degree combined with experience testing precision instruments and/or sensors.
* Must be comfortable working in a laboratory environment.
* Able to write test scripts and code to support test activities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with coworkers and collaborators, both written and verbal. Able to create new test plans and procedures for novel instrumentation.
* Organize and manage test results. Take ownership of data storage and management systems to ensure valuable test data is retained and properly documented
* Experience with devising testing protocols for precision instruments. Including specifying appropriate equipment, writing programs/scripts to automate testing, and finally documenting procedures for the team to use.
* Must be proficient in post-test data analysis to extract required performance metrics.
* Experience designing test loads, cabling, and custom equipment to support verification work
* Able to read schematics, data sheets, and technical information to define expected measurement ranges.
* Proficiency with laboratory test and measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, VNA, SA, power supplies, function generators, and DVM.
* To comply with the US export control laws, Vector Atomic employees must be U.S. citizens (born or naturalized), lawful U.S. permanent residents (i.e. green card holders), and certain categories of refugees, and asylees.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience using PCB Layout tools, particularly Altium
* Able to write test firmware for embedded MCUs to support testing of MCU-based PCBs.
* Experience with compliance testing for electronic products
* Experience with environmental testing for space electronics, including radiation effects, is a plus.

jobs.title: Staff Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Our Mission**
===============

Expand human ambition in the physical world.

*Critical infrastructure is constrained by labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and operational complexity. Watney builds and deploys autonomous robotic systems that increase the speed and capacity of buildout, starting with data centers.*

**About the Role**
==================

At Watney, firmware engineers write the firmware for our robots’ mainboards and actuators, and bring up new boards with our manufacturing partners. They work with our mechanical, electrical, and ML teams as new sensors and embodiments arrive.

How far firmware can take a robot on its own is still an open question: which faults a board can recover from without a person, and how one design carries across new boards and embodiments.

The firmware you write sets how reliable and safe every robot is. The architecture bets you make carry into every robot we build after this one.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* Lead board bring-up with our manufacturing partners, from specification discovery through first boot.
* Write the drivers and hardware abstraction layers that run on our microcontrollers and actuators.
* Build and run automated hardware-in-the-loop tests across embodiments.
* Build the common firmware base for mainboards and actuators, in Rust and C.
* Work with the ML and mechanical teams to prototype and validate new sensors.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You:**
=================================

* Have shipped production firmware to millions of devices.
* Have written production firmware in Rust, C, or both.
* Have debugged communication buses on real hardware.
* Have built or operated hardware-in-the-loop test infrastructure.
* Have worked with contract manufacturers or OEMs to turn ambiguous requirements into a board layout.
* Have worked with electromechanical systems or cameras and optics, electrically, mechanically, or in software.
* Have working knowledge of electrical engineering and either field-oriented control or RF.

We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. At Watney Robotics, we welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential. If you’re passionate about robotics but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply!

**Curious to learn more?**
==========================

Follow us here on**X**and**LinkedIn**

jobs.title: Production Systems Engineer, Edge
jobs.description:
Meta's Edge compute fleet - around 162,000 servers in more than 600 locations worldwide - is how our users reach us. Unlike most of Meta's hardware, this fleet doesn't run in our own data centers: it lives in Edge PoPs terminating user connections, and in ISP and cell-service-provider locations running caching for partner networks.The Edge Hardware team is the hardware engineering partner to the Traffic organization that owns this footprint. We are a key partner in hardware selection and qualification, qualify firmware across every component, investigate failures in the deployed fleet, and define the detection and remediation tooling that keeps it healthy. The work sits directly in the user path: a hardware fault we miss becomes a user-visible availability problem. You'd work day to day with an engineer being hired alongside you, and with the team in Dublin who owns the area today - plus the wider Edge and hardware reliability teams, and your Traffic partners, on both coasts.  
  
  

### **Production Systems Engineer, Edge Responsibilities:**

* As a Production Systems Engineer on Edge Hardware, you'll contribute across New Product Introduction and Sustaining work on Meta's Edge compute fleet, taking ownership of well-defined areas and growing your scope as you ramp
* Qualify successive server generations and new platforms into the fleet, and sustain existing generations for the 3–5 years they remain deployed
* Build out failure detection and remediation coverage - new checks, porting existing validation to new vendor hardware, cleaning up noisy checkers that currently create work for partner operations teams
* Help requalify components that have reached end of sale (new NICs, SSDs), unblocking Meta's ability to purchase Edge servers and replace failed parts
* Improve fleet visibility, surfacing failures we currently detect late or not at all
* Take on part of the firmware qualification cadence - NIC, BIOS, BMC, management engine, GPU VBIOS, PSU, flash
* Contribute to multi-vendor enablement - Meta's Edge fleet has run on a single server vendor for many years and we're onboarding alternatives. That means rebuilding provisioning, validation, detection and remediation assumptions that have held for years

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
* 2+ years of experience in production systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, network operations, or a related hardware operations discipline
* 2+ years of experience developing automation or tooling in Python, Go, or a comparable scripting or systems programming language for infrastructure or hardware management
* Experience with server or network hardware components including switches, routers, NICs, and compute platforms, including hands-on troubleshooting and failure analysis
* Experience with configuration management, fleet management, or hardware lifecycle tooling in a large-scale data center, edge, or cloud infrastructure environment
* Experience operating or supporting distributed infrastructure across geographically dispersed sites or points of presence

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with server BMC / iLO / Redfish, firmware upgrade frameworks, or hardware qualification workflows
* Experience working across time zones and with cross-functional partners in different sites
* Background in Edge, CDN, or distributed infrastructure. Experience working directly with OEM vendors (e.g., HPE, Dell)
* Familiarity with large-scale data analysis tools

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.  
  
$118,000/year to $170,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

jobs.description:

-------------------------

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

  
  

**Job Description**

Platform management firmware is essential to the reliability, serviceability, and manageability of hyperscale AI servers. This Senior role owns BMC firmware architecture and development—built on OpenBMC—for Hyve's next-generation AI and compute server platforms, spanning manageability, telemetry, power/thermal control, security, and manufacturing enablement in close partnership with hardware and Hyperscaler customers.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **BMC firmware architecture.** Define and own the OpenBMC-based firmware architecture for AI/GPU server platforms, including manageability stack, Redfish interfaces, IPMI, and platform telemetry.
* **Platform control and monitoring.** Develop and integrate power, thermal, fan-control, and sensor monitoring firmware in close collaboration with power delivery and thermal teams.
* **Security and reliability.** Implement secure boot, firmware update/recovery, RoT integration, and robust error handling to meet hyperscaler security and reliability requirements.
* **Bring-up and debug.** Lead firmware bring-up across EVT/DVT/PVT, debug at board and system level, and drive root-cause analysis and permanent fixes across firmware, hardware, and system-integration domains.
* **Manufacturing and deployment enablement.** Deliver firmware tooling and features for factory provisioning, diagnostics, and fleet deployment, and support field issue resolution at scale.
* **Technical leadership.** Set firmware development methodology, review code, and mentor engineers; represent firmware architecture to customers and internal executives.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
------------------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 10+ years of embedded/firmware development experience, including significant BMC/platform management firmware work and hands-on OpenBMC development. Proven delivery of server-class firmware into production; hyperscale experience preferred.
* **Technical expertise:** Strong C/C++ and embedded Linux skills; deep knowledge of OpenBMC, Redfish, IPMI, I2C/I3C, PMBus, SPI, and platform management interfaces; experience with secure boot, firmware update, and RoT.
* **Systems knowledge:** Solid understanding of server hardware, power/thermal control loops, and the interaction of firmware with BIOS, hardware, and manufacturing flows.
* **Communication:** Able to lead cross-functional debug, drive architecture decisions, and communicate effectively with hardware teams, customers, and executives.
