jobs.title: Senior PLM Software Engineer, Manufacturing Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build the software-defined shipyard. That means the full technology stack running Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, ArsenalOS (our manufacturing execution system that workers and planners use every shift), the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.  
  
This work is anchored by Arsenal-2, our software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base. ArsenalOS is the digital backbone of that yard. It connects fabrication and outfitting to material movement and inspection. Planners get one real-time view of production. We aren't waiting for the yard to open. Development is already underway here in Orange County, California. The team is proving out the manufacturing methods and digital workflows that will scale across the shipyard network.  
  
MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.  
  
This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

MDP is building the manufacturing digital thread that connects engineering release to the machines and inspection systems on the factory floor. You'll own the Development and integration integration layer between Teamcenter and Anduril's ArsenalOS platform so CAM programs, CAI/CMM programs, tools and fixtures, and inspection results move automatically instead of by hand.

* Build and own the integrations that carry CAM and CAI data out of Teamcenter and onto the shop floor, including NX CAM outputs, DNC dispatch to machine controls and the return path for as-run data.
* Develop custom Teamcenter extensions using ITK and SOA, along with BMIDE data model changes and Active Workspace interfaces, to support manufacturing workflows that off-the-shelf configuration can't reach.
* Close the inspection loop by integrating CAI and metrology systems so measured results land back in the digital thread as structured data rather than static reports.
* Make EBOM to MBOM propagation and model-based definition data flow automatically into downstream manufacturing and quality systems.
* Unblock partner teams across scheduling, applied AI and manufacturing systems by exposing manufacturing data through APIs they can build on.
* Partner with manufacturing engineers and factory operators to understand production workflows and translate them into software requirements.
* Write production-quality code with comprehensive tests, participating in code review and architectural discussions.
* Deploy and operate your systems in factory environments, including edge compute clusters and OT networks.
* Leverage AI tooling (coding assistants, automation) in your development workflow and contribute to team engineering practices.
* Join an on-call rotation supporting production factory systems.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 8+ years of experience in a software engineering role building production systems, ideally in a fast-paced environment.
* Deep expertise in Teamcenter development: 5+ years hands-on with ITK and SOA customization in C++ and Java, BMIDE data modeling and Active Workspace.
* Demonstrated experience building custom Teamcenter handlers, services and integrations, not only configuring workflows and templates.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing data domains, including CAM, CAI, CMM, and NC programming outputs, machine dispatch, metrology and inspection data, and the relationship between EBOM and MBOM.
* Experience authoring and developing NX Open programs to automate NX/Design Center workflows.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, ML Training Performance
jobs.description:
Zoox is on a mission to reimagine transportation and ground-up build autonomous robotaxis that are safe, reliable, clean, and enjoyable for everyone. We are still in the early stages of deploying our robotaxis on public roads, and it is a great time to join Zoox and have a significant impact in executing this mission. The ML Platform team at Zoox plays a crucial role in enabling innovations in large-scale Foundation models, VLMs, and VLAs to make autonomous driving as seamless as possible.

**The Opportunity**

Are you excited to drive our ML Training Performance initiatives and make the models that power autonomous driving trains faster, cheaper, and at greater scale? You will work with SOTA accelerators and cutting-edge techniques in distributed training, parallelism strategies, mixed-precision training and RL, especially for VLA and VLM models that are multi-modal — partnering closely with all the Autonomy teams within Zoox (Perception, Prediction, Planner, Simulation, Collision Avoidance) and pushing the boundaries of how ML training is practiced at Zoox.

We build and operate the base layer of ML tools, model development, and training systems that our applied research teams use for in- and off-vehicle ML use cases. You will work alongside a team of strong software engineers and act as a force multiplier for our internal customers. This team has many growth opportunities as we expand our robotaxi deployments and venture into new ML domains. If you want to learn more about our stack behind autonomous driving, please look here. If you want to learn more about our ML Infrastructure, here is one of our past talks at re:Invent.

### **In this role, you will:**

* Design, implement, and operate cutting-edge ML training performance optimization techniques — distributed training (data/tensor/pipeline parallelism), mixed-precision, gradient checkpointing, and GPU kernels — to scale our VLM, VLA, and Foundational models training efficiency.
* Work on RL framework and RL performance optimization for driving foundation model
* Profile and debug training throughput bottlenecks across the compute, compiler, framework, and cluster-networking stack.
* Collaborate closely with ML researchers, data engineers, and hardware engineers to define requirements and align on architectural decisions for large-scale training infrastructure.
* Implement custom kernels and build benchmarks to track and validate training-performance optimizations across the stack.

### **Qualifications**

Note: You do not have to meet all the requirements below to be considered for this position:

* 4+ years of total experience, including 2+ years working on large-scale model training platforms.
* Experience with distributed training frameworks (Megatron-LM, TorchTitan), efficiently utilizing GPU/accelerator clusters at scale.
* Experience with RL framework such as Verl/MILES and RL algorithms(GRPO, PPO)
* Experience with collective communication libraries (e.g., NCCL) and optimizing communication/compute overlap in multi-node training.
* Experience using profiling tools (NVIDIA Nsight, PyTorch Profiler, or XLA/JAX profiling) to identify and resolve training bottlenecks.
* Proficient in Python or C++.
* Experience with ML compilers, performance tooling, or hardware/software co-design (e.g., GPU/TPU/accelerator architectures).

A sign-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long-term care insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. **ABOUT FUSE**
--------------

We are building one of the most potentially consequential companies of the century. Our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to fusion energy while safeguarding humankind. This is not a normal company. This is not a normal job. We are committed for the long term to win.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------

We're looking for robotics engineers to stand up and grow Fuse's robotic manufacturing capability from the ground up. You will design, build, program, and deploy robotic cells that handle the full lifecycle of our pulsed-power hardware, from individual components up to our complete Impedance-Matched Marx Generator (IMG) modules. This is a hands-on, high-responsibility role: you'll select the robots, design the end-effectors and fixturing, write the control and vision software, integrate everything into a working line, and keep it running. You'll work shoulder to shoulder with our pulsed-power, mechanical, and electrical engineers to make our hardware manufacturable by robots.

**WHAT WE VALUE**
-----------------

* Obsess about the details — sloppy work costs us later, so do it right the first time.
* Care — pick up the trash. Do things no one asks you to do. Go the extra mile because you care.
* Act with urgency — every hour matters more than it feels like it does.
* Be responsible for the outcome, not just the task; if it is not working, it remains your problem until it is fixed.
* Assume good intent — disagree openly, then commit fully once a call is made.

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**
-------------------------

* Design and deploy robotic capabilities to fabricate and assemble Fuse's core pulsed-power components, including FDGS (field-distortion gas switches), "bricks" (capacitor and switch assemblies), stages, full IMG modules, and transmission lines.
* Build automated assembly, fastening, bonding, alignment, and handling processes for high-voltage, high-energy parts, including heavy and delicate components.
* Develop robotic workflows for inspection, test, and preventive maintenance of fielded hardware, reducing manual intervention in high-voltage environments.
* Design and fabricate custom end-effectors, grippers, tooling, and fixtures tailored to our components.
* Integrate machine vision, force/torque sensing, and metrology for precise alignment, quality control, and error detection.
* Program and integrate industrial and/or collaborative robots (arms, gantries, mobile platforms) with PLCs, motion controllers, and factory software.
* Define the cell-level architecture, including safety systems, interlocks, material flow, and throughput, and contribute to the build-out from concept to a fully functioning production line.
* Partner with design engineers on Design for Automated Assembly, feeding manufacturability requirements back into component design.
* Establish maintenance, calibration, spares, and documentation practices so the automation is reliable and serviceable.
* Help onboard new team members as the robotics team grows.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------

* Degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Controls, or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Hands-on experience deploying robotic automation in a manufacturing or assembly environment.
* Strong skills in robot programming and integration (e.g., FANUC, KUKA, ABB, Universal Robots, or similar) and industrial controls (PLCs, motion control, I/O, safety systems).
* Experience designing end-effectors, fixtures, and tooling in CAD and seeing them through fabrication.
* Working knowledge of machine vision and sensor integration for guidance and inspection.
* Software ability (e.g., Python, C++, and/or ROS) for control, vision, and system integration.
* Solid grasp of automation safety standards and safe design practice.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, iterating fast, and owning a system end to end in a startup.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience automating the assembly of high-voltage, high-energy, or hazardous hardware, and familiarity with the associated safety requirements.
* Background in pulsed power, Marx generators, capacitors, high-voltage systems, or fusion/plasma hardware.
* Experience with heavy-payload handling, precision alignment/metrology, or automated electrical/hi-pot testing.
* Experience with mobile robots or automated maintenance/inspection in field environments.
* Experience standing up a new automation function or production line.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**
---------------------------

* Based in or willing to relocate to our San Leandro, CA facility; this role is fully onsite.
* Comfortable working hands-on in a lab and production environment around high-voltage and high-energy equipment, following strict safety procedures.
* Ability to lift and maneuver equipment and tooling as needed during cell build-out and maintenance.
* Occasional travel to other Fuse locations.

**BENEFITS**
------------

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* Relocation assistance for roles that require it.
* Flexible time off. Take what you need, no accrual tracking.
* 2 weeks of paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs).
* Supportive leave of absence policies.
* Paid leave for new parents.

Sciton is a Silicon Valley based pioneer in laser, light, and energy technologies for aesthetic and medical applications. Our engineers helped bring laser products to market just a few years after lasers were first invented, and that same spirit of innovation still drives us today.  
  
We are built on a strong set of values: Selflessness, Candor, Innovation, Execution, Objectivity, Excellence, Learning, Ownership, and Clarity. With more than 500 employees worldwide, Sciton has been recognized as a USA TODAY Top Workplace for four consecutive years from 2022 to 2026.  
  
If you want to work on meaningful technology that directly improves patient outcomes and be part of a company that values curiosity, ownership, and excellence, we would love to meet you.  
  
**Position Summary**  
As a Senior Electronics Design Engineer, you'll play a critical role in the design, development, and support of Sciton's next generation of aesthetic medical laser systems. You'll work alongside a multidisciplinary engineering team to develop innovative electronic hardware used in high-performance, FDA-regulated medical devices.  
  
From concept through production, you'll help design complex electrical systems, integrate embedded hardware, troubleshoot prototypes, and support products throughout the development lifecycle. This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology that directly impacts physicians and patients around the world.  
  
**What You'll Work On:**

* Lead electronic hardware design from concept through production, including circuit design, simulation, analysis, and validation
* Design multilayer PCBs using Altium Designer
* Develop embedded controller hardware based on ARM microcontrollers and microprocessors
* Design system wiring harnesses and electrical interconnects
* Perform hardware integration, system bring-up, testing, debugging, and prototype evaluation
* Support system verification, regulatory compliance, and product validation activities
* Select electronic components with consideration for performance, reliability, availability, cost, and long-term lifecycle management
* Collaborate with mechanical, software, manufacturing, and quality engineering teams throughout New Product Introduction (NPI) and sustaining engineering efforts
* Support prototype builds, troubleshooting, SMD rework, and laboratory testing

**What We're Looking For:**

* Extensive experience designing PCBs using Altium Designer
* Strong experience designing embedded hardware utilizing ARM-based microcontrollers or microprocessors
* Experience developing FDA-regulated medical devices or other regulated medical electronic systems
* Strong understanding of electronic hardware design from concept through production
* Experience collaborating across multidisciplinary engineering teams
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Core Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) required
* 10+ years of hands-on electrical engineering experience
* Proven experience taking products through the full product development lifecycle
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced engineering environment

**Preferred Skills & Experience:**

* Analog and mixed-signal circuit design
* ADC, DAC, and microcontroller interface design
* Serial communication protocols (I²C, SPI, UART, CAN, etc.)

jobs.title: Vehicle Battery Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Anduril's Maritime Division is transforming American sea power to meet the defining national security challenges of our era and secure our future of maritime dominance.  
  
We are scaling at a historic pace, anchored by Arsenal-2, our new software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base.  
  
Arsenal-2 is purpose-built to break long-standing industrial bottlenecks and scale production of critical components for the Navy's Virginia-class attack submarines to support fleet requirements. At the same time, it will build the industrial muscle to field our next-generation AUVs at scale.  
  
We aren't waiting for the new shipyard to be completed. The work on this transformation starts right now, with development inside our new 160,000 square foot Proto-Factory in Orange County, California, where the team is already laying the foundation. As the prototyping hub for Arsenal-2, this facility gives us a multi-year head start, proving out the advanced manufacturing methods, digital workflows, and quality systems that will scale across our broader shipyard network.  
  
In Anduril's Maritime Division, we are actively building America's next decisive advantage at sea—and this is the moment to join us.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

You will own energy storage system design for a maritime autonomous vehicle. Reporting to the Vehicle Systems Lead, you will drive cell selection, module design, thermal management, and pressure-rated packaging for battery systems that must deliver ultra-long-range endurance under pressure.  
  
Your spectrum of support will be diverse in nature and require you to leverage your technical expertise as well as leadership skills to set objectives, build cross-functional teams, and rapidly drive to completion. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience will be key in making sure the right design, analysis, and test steps are completed to ensure success. The ideal candidate will leverage their experience executing and successfully completing prior highly optimized multi-disciplinary projects.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own energy storage architecture: cell chemistry selection, module design, and pack integration
* Design pressure-rated battery enclosures for full-ocean-depth operation
* Perform battery sizing, energy budget analysis, and cycle life modeling
* Drive thermal management design for safe operation across environmental conditions
* Define charging profiles and integration with external charging interfaces
* Interface with energy distribution, structural, and production teams
* Support prototype builds, testing, and design-for-manufacturability reviews
* Contribute to safety analysis for energy storage systems
* Travel up to 25% to test sites and vendor facilities

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent
* 5+ years of experience in battery system design, energy storage, or power electronics
* Experience with lithium-ion or equivalent high-energy-density battery systems
* Familiarity with battery management systems and thermal management
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with marine or subsea battery systems
* Working knowledge of battery safety standards (UN38.3, IEC 62619, or military equivalents)
* Experience with pressure-rated enclosure design
* Familiarity with battery modeling and simulation tools
* Experience in defense or maritime robotics

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. Do you want to join a team of talented engineers building the next generation of real-time data platforms that power analytics and data-driven experiences across PlayStation? As part of our Data Platform team, you will play a key technical leadership role in designing and evolving the Real-Time Analytics Platform (RTAP), enabling high-throughput, low-latency analytics and stream processing at PlayStation scale.

The Software Engineers within our Platform Engineering Group design, build, document, and operate large-scale distributed data platforms that support real-time and near real-time analytics across PlayStation. You will solve complex distributed systems challenges, evolve our streaming and analytics architecture, integrate AI-powered platform capabilities, and improve scalability, reliability, performance, and developer productivity.

We're looking for someone who is passionate about distributed systems, real-time analytics, and building scalable data platforms. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Security, and Data Engineering teams to shape technical strategy, influence architecture across organizations, mentor engineers, and help drive the long-term evolution of PlayStation's data platform.

* Strong systems design skills with the ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs across scalability, latency, throughput, consistency, reliability, and cost.

* Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture ownership, mentoring engineers, and influencing technical decisions across multiple teams.

The Splunk Agent Resilience team is defining the future of AI resilience. Our team provides scalable, cost-effective evaluation and guardrails that ensure AI agents behave as intended, improving reliability and reducing risks. This unified approach empowers our customers to confidently deploy and run AI-powered applications with enhanced observability and control.
  
  
As a Staff Software Engineer on the Data& Scalability Platform team, you will provide technical leadership for the architecture, scalability, and cost of the entire data plane: the stores that hold the data, the streaming and compute components that move and transform it, and tooling proving how all of it behaves under load. You will define the multi-quarter, technical direction for that data plane, establish the standards other teams build against, own the initiatives that keep it fast and correct as it grows by orders of magnitude, and influence the technical direction of the platform with engineering team leadership and product teams.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
Define and drive the multi-quarter technical roadmap for the data platform — storage, streaming, compute, and the tooling that measures them.
  
  

* Lead the architecture and evolution of the data plane, including storage engine selection, sharding and tenancy models, and control/data plane boundaries.
* Establish platform-wide standards for schema design, migration safety, retention of data, and lead the review process that enforces them.
* Lead the capacity and performance model, and define the SLOs that set the definition of what correct and fast mean.
* Lead major scalability and performance initiatives spanning data stores, streaming pipelines, and distributed worker fleets.
* Drive cost efficiency, the cost per unit of telemetry, cost attribution, and quota and rate-limit design.
* Set the direction for multi-tenant isolation so that no tenant can degrade another.
* Design and build the internal frameworks and performance tooling — load testing, profiling, and benchmarking — that other engineers rely on to support design and capacity decisions.
* Establish observability standards for the platform so signals are correct, complete, and affordable.
* Lead the most production investigations and drive systemic remediation rather than point fixes.
* Make and document technology-selection and build-versus-buy decisions, with explicit cost, risk, and migration analysis.
* Partner with engineering leadership to influence platform direction and investment, and represent the data platform to the product teams building on it.
* Mentor engineers and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, technical standards, and documentation.

* Bachelor's degree with 8+ years of related experience, or Master's degree with 6+ years, or PhD with 3+ years, in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — including at least 6 years building and/or operating data-intensive backend services and/or platforms.
* Technical leadership experience, including experience setting technical direction, driving multi-quarter initiatives, and/or influencing decisions beyond your immediate scope.
* Experience with designing, operating, and/or delivering highly scalable, reliable, production-grade data-intensive platforms. Experience designing large-scale distributed systems and solving problems of scalability, availability, performance, reliability, and/or fault tolerance.
* Backend software engineering experience with either Go, Java, Rust, C++, and/or Python. Experience with cloud-native technologies, containerized environments (Kubernetes), and public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or similar)

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Demonstrated performance engineering ability — profiling, benchmarking, and load testing real systems, and turning the measurements into capacity, design, and cost decisions.
* Experience operating and tuning both an OLTP database (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and an analytical, columnar, or time-series store (e.g., ClickHouse, Druid, BigQuery, Snowflake) at production grade at scale — schema design, indexing, query tuning, and migration safety.
* Deep production experience with streaming or queueing systems (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pulsar, Kinesis) — partitioning, consumer-group semantics, delivery guarantees, and backlog and dead-letter handling.
* Experience scaling data-processing compute — queue consumers, async task workers, or streaming jobs — including concurrency tuning, batching, backpressure, and throughput behavior under sustained load.
* Deep experience running ClickHouse or a comparable columnar store at scale — sharding and replication topology, materialized views, merge and mutation behavior, retention and TTL mechanics.
* Experience with a capacity model or a FinOps practice at platform scope: cost per.unit of telemetry, cardinality governance, and quota or rate-limit design.
* Experience designing multi-tenant isolation and noisy-neighbor mitigation in shared data systems.
* Experience leading a significant data migration or storage-engine transition in production without customer-visible impact.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

The Foundation and Luau Platform team builds the shared platform that Roblox's user interface runs on. Our UI is written in Luau, Roblox's scripting language, using React-style frameworks. We own the core pieces that product teams across Roblox rely on: a component library used across Roblox's apps and tools, server-driven UI, the core app frame and navigation, and the frameworks and libraries underneath them.

Our goal is to make that platform fast, consistent, and reliable for the engineers who build on it. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help shape and build it, working across systems, platforms, and infrastructure.

**You Will**

jobs.title: Software Engineer III/Senior, Infrastructure Platform
jobs.description:
**About ngrok Inc.**
--------------------

ngrok is an all-in-one cloud networking platform that secures, transforms, and routes traffic to services running anywhere. Instead of cobbling together nginx, NLBs, VPNs, model routers, and oodles of other tools, developers solve every networking problem with one gateway. Doesn’t matter if they’re sharing localhost or running AI workloads in production.

We're trusted by more than 9 million developers at companies like GitHub, Okta, HashiCorp, and Twilio. What started as a way to put your local app on a public URL has grown into a universal gateway for API delivery, AI inference, device fleets, and site-to-site connectivity. It’s the same ngrok that millions of developers have loved and leaned on every day for years, now with the power to run production traffic at scale.

A few things you should know:

* We are obsessed with our pets, Viper sunglasses and Bufo (yes, the toad)
* We have a designated Chief Emoji Officer - they are vital to our success!
* We like software that’s serious and culture that’s not

Still reading? Good. There's more below worth your time.

**About the Infra Platform Team**
---------------------------------

The Infra Platform team builds the systems ngrok engineers rely on to build, deploy, and operate ngrok itself. We think about infrastructure the way software engineers think about software: APIs, abstractions, automation, reliability, and developer experience.

We own the internal platform that keeps engineering productive and production stable. That includes build systems, deployment workflows, infrastructure tooling, service reliability, and the glue that connects it all together. Our work touches nearly every engineer at the company, which means when we improve something, everyone feels it.

You’ll work on systems with real production load, latency constraints, and reliability requirements. We run a modern stack built primarily around Go, PostgreSQL, gRPC, Kubernetes, Terraform, Protobuf, nix, and AWS. Most of our infrastructure and application code lives in a monorepo powered by extensive code generation and internal tooling that makes complex workflows feel surprisingly manageable.

This is the team people come to when things are scaling, failing, deploying too slowly, or generally behaving like distributed systems tend to behave.

**What You’ll Actually Do**
---------------------------

* **Build and improve the engineering platform**: You’ll work on the systems engineers use every day to develop, test, deploy, and operate ngrok. Better tooling, smoother workflows, fewer sharp edges.
* **Treat infrastructure like software**: You’ll automate operational workflows, improve reliability, and build systems that scale cleanly under production load. SRE and DevOps problems solved with software engineering discipline.
* **Improve the developer experience**: You’ll contribute to builder tools, deployment systems, CI/CD infrastructure, and internal abstractions that make engineers faster and safer when shipping changes.
* **Help keep production healthy**: You’ll participate in maintaining high uptime and operational excellence by improving observability, reliability, and incident response processes.
* **Raise the engineering bar**: You’ll mentor teammates, contribute technical direction, and help evolve the architecture and operational maturity of the platform over time.

**You Might Be a Great Fit If…**
--------------------------------

* You have 3+ years of experience as a software engineer
* You’ve built and operated distributed systems in AWS or other cloud environments
* You’re comfortable in a statically typed, compiled language such as Go, Rust, C++, or Java (with bonus points for Go)
* You think operational problems are engineering problems
* You care deeply about developer experience and scalable systems design
* You enjoy understanding how systems fail, recover, and evolve over time

Extra credit if you’ve worked with:

* Kubernetes, Terraform, nix, PostgreSQL, Kafka, or gRPC
* Observability platforms like Datadog or Honeycomb
* Internal developer platforms or builder tooling
* Networking, infrastructure, or security-focused systems

**Tech Stack**
--------------

ngrok runs entirely on AWS. Engineers develop by using remote development tools and/or ssh to connect to remote EC2 environments that run a full Kubernetes cluster of the ngrok stack, closely mirroring production. The codebase is primarily Go and TypeScript. We use Postgres for persistence, Kafka for streaming, Protobuf for service boundaries, and Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, and Buildkite to operate and ship reliably. React is used for user interfaces, and GitHub supports our development workflows and remembers everything.

**Location**
------------

This is a remote position for candidates outside of the Bay Area and a hybrid role for candidates within commuting distance to San Francisco. Our Bay Area employees commute to the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

**Sponsorship**
---------------

All candidates must be US-based, and legally authorized to work in the United States.

At this time, ngrok is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent, ongoing basis without the need for current or future sponsorship.

* Tier 2 (rest of US): $186,300 – $227,700

The company serves clients across a diverse set of large and stable end markets including manufacturing, power generation, aerospace, medical, and defense. ATS was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Marietta, GA. Today the Company employs nearly 2,100 team members in over 95 locations across the United States.

Radiation Test Solutions (RTS), a family company of ATS, is the world leader in radiation effects testing and analysis of semiconductor devices and materials for space, airborne and ground applications, in both natural and man-made environments. Our experienced staff and 35,000 sq/ft comprehensive, commercial laboratory ensures we can meet any testing needs, on time and on budget.adiation effects testing on electronics in support of large and small aerospace companies and device manufacturers. We are a smaller, rapidly growing company based in Colorado Springs, Colorado.

**Job Description:**

Radiation Test Solutions (RTS) is seeking an experienced Senior FPGA Design Lead to establish and lead our internal FPGA development capability. This role will be responsible for FPGA architecture, design implementation, verification, and technical leadership across multiple programs. The successful candidate will serve as the company's FPGA subject matter expert, define FPGA development methodologies and best practices, mentor junior FPGA engineers, and guide FPGA-based solutions from concept through deployment.

This position is ideal for a highly motivated engineer with deep FPGA development experience and a passion for building engineering teams, improving design processes, and delivering high-reliability solutions for aerospace, defense, and advanced electronics applications.

**Responsibilities:**

* FPGA Technical Leadership

  + Lead all aspects of FPGA architecture, design, implementation, verification, and integration.
  + Establish and maintain FPGA development processes, coding standards, documentation requirements, and design review practices.
  + Define FPGA technology roadmaps and recommend device families, development tools, and design methodologies.
  + Provide technical leadership for FPGA-related customer projects and internal R&D efforts.
  + Support proposal development and technical planning activities.
* FPGA Design and Verification

  + Develop FPGA designs using VHDL, Verilog, and/or SystemVerilog.
  + Create simulation environments, testbenches, and verification plans.
  + Perform timing analysis, resource optimization, and design closure activities.
  + Interface with embedded processors, high-speed serial links, memory devices, communication protocols, and mixed-signal systems.
  + Support board bring-up, debugging, and laboratory validation activities.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration

  + Participate in customer technical reviews.
  + Coordinate with FPGA manufacturers and development partners.
  + Collaborate with RTS radiation effects engineers during test planning and data interpretation.

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of FPGA design experience with demonstrated technical leadership.
* Strong proficiency in VHDL and/or Verilog.
* Experience with AMD/Xilinx, Microsemi/Microchip, and/or Intel FPGA toolchains.
* Expertise in digital design, timing closure, clock-domain crossing, simulation, and verification.
* Experience with high-speed interfaces, memory architectures, and embedded systems integration.

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Accordingly, the company will consider only “U.S. Persons” for this position. A “U.S. Person” includes (a) U.S. citizens or nationals; (b) U.S. lawful permanent residents (i.e., “green card” holders); (c) persons granted refugee status; or (d) persons granted asylum in the United States. jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.

At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. We’re creating future-ready solutions, focusing on resiliency and urgency through our 21st Century Security® vision. We’re erasing boundaries and forming partnerships across industries and around the world. We’re advancing spacecraft and the workforce to fuel the next generation. And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.

Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.

**What does this role look like?**

The successful candidate will serve as both Systems Engineering (SE) Manager and Deputy Chief Systems Engineer (CSE) across the SDA portfolio providing strategic technical leadership and day-to-day guidance across critical SE domains—requirements management, verification, interface control, architecture, baseline configuration management, and command/telemetry databases.

This role includes shaping portfolio-level SE processes to drive product delivery, and extensive collaboration with integrated project teams. As the Deputy CSE, this role supports the CSE for technical direction, planning, staffing, design review execution, program management/customer meetings, technical baseline control, and assess cost and schedule performance. The position requires a high level of technical and business acumen to balance priorities, drive issue prevention/resolution, and clearly communicate status and needs to our customers/partners, and with both Lockheed Martin and supplier executives.

The information below reflects the standard job description for this position:

Performs technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, cost and risk, and supportability and effectiveness analyses for total systems. Responsible for coordinating subordinate employee recruitment, selection and training, performance assessment, work assignments, salary, and recognition/disciplinary actions. Analyses are performed at all levels of total system product to include: concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal. Ensures the logical and systematic conversion of customer or product requirements into total systems solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule, and cost constraints. Performs functional analysis, timeline analysis, detail trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies to translate customer requirements into hardware and software specifications.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelors or higher degree in an Engineering, Computer Science, or closely related subject area, or equivalent experience
* Systems Engineering across the entire systems lifecycle, understanding SE principles and processes
* Prior experience leading technical and/or functional teams
* Knowledge or experience with systems architecture within space, aerospace, or related programs
* Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance, thus U.S. Citizenship is required

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Project management and CAM experience
* Good Communication and Interpersonal skills
* Experience supporting the Systems Engineering organization on a development program
* Experience with system-level considerations for multi-vehicle architectures and high-performance systems for space applications
* Experience with Model Based Systems Engineering, leveraging SysML and MBSE tools (Cameo, Rhapsody, etc.)
* Experienced with Fixed price program execution
* Experience with Systems Engineering principles and processes, and their application to complex space architectures through the entire life cycle
* Experience in a formal leadership role
* Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**Software Engineering Manager**

**City/State:** Colorado Springs, CO USA

**Type and Schedule:** Full-Time, Salary/Exempt, on-site with limited remote work flexibility.

**Annualized Salary Range:** $170,000 - $215,000 commensurate with experience.

**About Us:**

Caliola is an award-winning woman-owned small business that is improving and protecting our Nation's way of life through secure collaboration and resilient communications. Our engineers, subject matter experts, and veterans are developing and delivering trusted solutions for mission-critical communications. We seek teammates who share our core values:

**I****3** **for C****3** **- Insight, Innovation, and Integrity for Command, Control, and Communications**

These values guide how we work every day. At Caliola, you will find technically challenging, mission-focused work within a flexible and collaborative culture that is uncommon in the defense industry. We offer flexible PTO, subsidized health insurance, 401(k) matching, professional development, and a competitive compensation structure designed to support long-term growth.

**Position Description:**

Caliola is seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead and grow our software team as we scale our business and the mission-critical technologies we deliver. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically strong, people-focused leader who enjoys developing engineers, solving complex problems, and building the processes and practices that help great teams do their best work. You'll lead engineers developing innovative software for mission-critical communications, alternate positioning, navigation, and timing (A-PNT), and secure mesh networking.

As Caliola continues to grow, you'll play a critical role in helping our software team scale with it. Working closely with the VP of Engineering, you'll strengthen development and testing practices, establish consistent and repeatable processes, develop technical talent, and improve how we plan, execute, and deliver software across multiple programs. You'll also help shape our approach to AI-enabled development and quality assurance, identifying opportunities to use emerging technologies to improve efficiency, consistency, and quality.

We're looking for a leader who brings deep technical understanding, sound judgment, and a genuine passion for helping engineers succeed. Someone who can dive into technical challenges, identify and remove roadblocks, coach engineers through complex problems, and bring structure and accountability without sacrificing innovation or collaboration. If you're energized by growing a team, building scalable engineering practices, and helping shape the future of a growing defense technology company, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

Leadership, ManagementAccountability (LMA)

* Provide leadership, management, and accountability for the software engineering team, establishing clear expectations, monitoring performance, removing roadblocks, and ensuring alignment with organizational and program priorities.
* Coach, mentor, and develop software engineers and emerging technical leads, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with engineering leadership and HR on staffing, hiring, performance management, professional development, and organizational growth.

Resource Planning

* Plan and allocate software engineering resources across active programs, future awards, and internal development efforts, balancing staffing, technical capabilities, schedules, budgets, and competing priorities.
* Monitor team capacity, project dependencies, and resource constraints, proactively identifying risks and adjusting assignments to support program commitments and organizational growth.

Software Development Process

* Define, document, standardize, and continuously improve software development processes across the organization, including Agile practices, coding standards, code reviews, testing, quality assurance, and release management.
* Lead the adoption of consistent development and testing practices, providing training, guidance, and accountability to ensure processes are effectively implemented across teams and programs.
* Oversee software development execution, maintaining visibility into progress, technical risks, and deliverables to ensure software meets requirements, quality standards, and program schedules.

Software Architecture

* Provide technical leadership and direction for software architecture across applications, backend services, and integrated systems, establishing scalable, maintainable, and reusable technical foundations.
* Guide architectural decisions and technical approaches, working closely with engineers to evaluate tradeoffs, resolve complex challenges, manage technical debt, and ensure solutions meet mission and program requirements.
* Support the evolution of customer-funded and internally developed capabilities into sustainable, reusable software products.

DevOpsSoftware Tools

jobs.description:

AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. Are you an experienced embedded software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems at the intersection of firmware, electronics, and motion control?

Del Medical is looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to help develop, improve, and support the embedded systems powering our medical imaging equipment. This is an opportunity to take meaningful technical ownership of real-world products, work closely with electrical and mechanical engineers, and see your engineering solutions move from development into production.

We are particularly interested in engineers who understand what happens below the application layer—people who can write efficient firmware, debug hardware-software interactions, and develop dependable embedded solutions rather than relying exclusively on high-level software frameworks.

What You'll Do

* Design, develop, debug, and maintain embedded firmware using C and/or C++.
* Develop bare-metal firmware for microcontroller-based systems and real-time applications.
* Design and improve motion-control functionality involving motors, encoders, sensors, and actuators.
* Implement and troubleshoot communication protocols, including CAN/CANopen, RS-232, I²C, SPI, and Ethernet.
* Collaborate with electrical engineers on PCB bring-up, electronic interfaces, and hardware-software integration.
* Use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, and other diagnostic equipment to identify and resolve complex technical problems.
* Develop software verification tests, investigate failures, and improve system reliability.
* Document software architecture, interfaces, requirements, testing, and engineering changes.
* Support prototype development, production troubleshooting, and ongoing product improvements.
* Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, quality, and product engineering teams.

What We're Looking For

Required qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 7+ years of professional embedded software or firmware development experience.
* Strong proficiency in embedded C and/or C++.
* Demonstrated experience with bare-metal programming and microcontroller-based systems.
* Hands-on experience debugging electronic hardware and firmware integration issues.
* Experience with embedded communication interfaces and protocols.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently own technical assignments and deliver maintainable, reliable software.

Highly desirable experience:

* Motor control, motion-control systems, encoders, feedback loops, or real-time control.
* Medical devices, diagnostic imaging, industrial controls, or other reliability-critical products.
* Altium Designer, PCB development, and electronic schematic interpretation.
* RTOS development, firmware update mechanisms, automated testing, or hardware diagnostics.
* Familiarity with medical-device software lifecycle, risk management, verification, and quality requirements.

What Makes This Opportunity Different?

* Meaningful technical ownership: Contribute directly to embedded systems used in medical imaging equipment.
* Hands-on engineering: Work with actual electronics, firmware, motors, and integrated systems.
* Cross-disciplinary collaboration: Work alongside electrical, mechanical, and product engineering professionals.
* Visible impact: Help improve product functionality, reliability, and serviceability.
* Competitive compensation: Earn $100,000–$150,000 annually based on demonstrated expertise.

Benefits:

* Competitive salary based on experience and knowledge
* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* STD, LTD, Life and AD&D Insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
* Paid time off, including holidays and vacation.
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

Who Will Succeed Here?

You are a hands-on engineer who enjoys understanding how systems work, diagnosing difficult problems, and building solutions that last. You are comfortable working independently, but you also know how to collaborate with engineers from different disciplines.

You take pride in code quality, sound engineering decisions, technical documentation, and seeing a project through to completion.

Candidates whose experience is limited to application-level software development without hands-on embedded firmware or hardware integration experience are unlikely to be a fit.

Please submit your résumé highlighting your embedded development experience, microcontroller platforms, communication protocols, and a few examples of challenging technical problems you have solved.

Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. **Cintal is a forward-thinking global technology company that develops and provides cutting-edge products and services to various industries such as heavy equipment, industrial, defense, agriculture, and medical. With our dedicated team of experienced technical professionals, Cintal aims to add value for its customers by leveraging advanced technologies to reduce product costs, shorten design and development lead times, and accelerate the introduction of high-quality products to the market.**

**BENEFITS:**

* 10 paid holidays per year
* 2 weeks of paid time off per year, the current year is pro-rated based on start date
* Access to the company’s medical insurance, including dental and vision
* Eligibility for life insurance and disability coverage for short or long-term disabilities or long- term care needs
* 401 (k) eligibility with employer contribution annually
* Reimbursement for relocation expenses up to a certain amount on a case-by-case basis
* Yearly bonus based on company performance
* Visa sponsorship

**JOB DESCRIPTION/TYPICAL TASK BREAKDOWN:**

* Applying new autonomous system solutions and technologies on a semi or full autonomous system
* Decomposition of Customer requirements into (L6) system level requirements including both hardware and software related requirements
* Managing system level requirements and related features in DevOps
* Work closely with Machine System teams (L6) to determine the best way to deliver on machine autonomous features, including component selection and system integration
* Ensure clear documentation and traceability.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Surface Loading Machine Autonomous Solutions
* Communicates system readiness and technical risk to stakeholders

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Responsible for helping to define the requirements and architecture for bringing an autonomous machine system together. The role will primarily focus on developing the system integration requirements for multiple systems within an autonomous machine within the Loading, Dozing & Compaction Application Team. These systems can include many different types of onboard electronic systems, as well as process and people interactions. The incumbent needs to be very detail oriented and work well with and through others. They will also need to be capable of making and communicating good decisions around the trade-offs between time, resources, and quality.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* Years of experience: 5-7 years of experience
* Degree requirement: A Bachelor’s degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
* No 2 year degrees
* Open to Master’s with full 5 years experience

**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS:**

* Proven ability to work on production products through design, implementation, customer rollout, and support.
* Ability to decompose complex customer requirements into achievable technical requirements for the systems that make up the product.
* Knowledge and experience with Autonomous Systems
* Experience with systems integration over CAN and Ethernet
* Communicating Complex Concepts:
* Work with a global team to communicate the Why’s and develop the How’s of agreed features.
* Clearly document the details for the system and ensure understanding and compliance with each subsystem team.
* Communicate designs and tradeoffs with stakeholders at multiple levels.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and global team. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are pleased to offer visa sponsorship for eligible and qualified individuals.

Cintal provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age, disability, genetic information, service in the military, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. Equal employment opportunities apply to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave of absence, compensation, and training.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
94,000 - 100,000 USD per year(Mossville, IL )

jobs.title: Staff AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Working at Abbott**

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**The Opportunity**

A senior individual-contributor engineering role that drives architecture and delivery for significant portions of **Abbott's enterprise AI Platform**. This role sets technical direction for one or more platform capability areas, partners closely with the Tech Lead/Architect on reference architecture decisions, and is a primary technical escalation point for consuming teams. Expected to operate with substantial autonomy and to raise the technical bar for the team.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead the design of major platform capabilities (e.g., multi-provider model gateway, GenAI runtime, agent/model registries, evaluation and tracing pipelines) with minimal oversight, in partnership with the Tech Lead/Architect.
* Make and document architecture decisions and tradeoffs for the platform's control plane, paved-road SDKs, and developer experience, weighing scalability, security, cost, and operability.
* Drive platform observability and evaluation strategy, including distributed tracing, quality/drift/latency/cost signals, and standards other engineers build against.
* Lead implementation of security, guardrails, and responsible-AI controls (PII/PHI handling, prompt-injection defenses, identity-on-behalf-of, policy enforcement) across platform services.
* Own platform reliability engineering: define SLOs, lead incident response for high-severity issues, drive root-cause analysis, and improve resilience.
* Set engineering standards through architecture reviews, design docs, and code reviews; identify and resolve systemic technical risk before it blocks delivery.
* Make build-versus-buy and vendor recommendations with cost/tradeoff analysis, in partnership with the Tech Lead/Architect and Product Manager.
* Mentor and technically develop mid-level and junior engineers; act as a technical lead on cross-team initiatives without formal people-management responsibility.
* Partner with the Product Manager, AI Platform to sequence roadmap, and directly engage senior stakeholders across AI/Agentic Engineering, Applied Data Science, and security on feasibility and design.

**Education and Experience You’ll Bring**

**Required Qualifications**

* 8–10 years of software engineering, platform engineering, distributed systems, or infrastructure experience, with a track record of owning significant technical scope.
* Hands-on experience designing and operating **enterprise AI/GenAI platforms** or comparable developer, data, or ML platforms in production at scale.
* Strong software engineering ability in Python and at least one of **TypeScript, Go, or Java, including distributed systems, API design, testing, and secure SDLC.**
* Deep technical understanding of at least two of: **model gateways, GenAI runtimes, RAG, agent/model registries, evaluation, observability/tracing, guardrails, or platform governance.**
* Experience with **containers and orchestration** (e.g., Kubernetes), infrastructure as code, CI/CD, cloud services, and production SLO/on-call practices, including leading incident response.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.
* Demonstrated ability to drive technical decisions with significant autonomy, influence engineers outside a direct reporting line, and communicate clearly with technical leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building enterprise GenAI or agent platforms using capabilities such as multi-model routing, agent registries, prompt management, evaluation harnesses, and **GenAI tracing.**
* Experience in a highly regulated environment such as health tech, med-tech, or life sciences, with GxP, HIPAA, validation, and change-control constraints.
* Experience implementing security, responsible-AI, privacy, policy, or cost/FinOps controls for shared AI infrastructure.
* Experience with open standards and tooling such as MCP, OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platform engineering practices; prior informal technical leadership or mentoring track record.

**Misc:** This is an onsite role at Abbott location in **IL.** This is not a remote role/opportunity.

* **Apply Now**
* **Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:** www.abbottbenefits.com
* Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.
* Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott, and on Twitter @AbbottNews.

**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**About this role**

We are seeking a Senior Firmware & Embedded Engineer to design, develop, and optimize embedded firmware for next-generation air conditioning products.

These solutions require the product development coordination of embedded controls technologies with state-of-the-art GUIs, cloud, and mobile app interactivity. This individual would be responsible for leading the embedded software Wi-Fi development activities of the embedded software group for various embedded products.

In this role, you will contribute to architecture decisions, solve complex technical challenges, and collaborate with hardware, systems, and production teams. You will support critical technical topics, provide guidance to other engineers, and help ensure our products meet global standards for quality, reliability, safety, and cybersecurity.

**Required Qualifications**

L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**Job Title:** **Lead, Software Engineering**

**Job Code: 46302**

**Job Location:** **Fort Wayne, IN**

**Job Schedule:** **9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off**

**Job Description:**

L3Harris is seeking a skilled and motivated Software Engineer to join our Space Systems team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and enhancement of software solutions that support the strategic objectives of the organization. This is a hands-on, on-site position that involves close collaboration with a dynamic, multidisciplinary engineering team to design, develop, and maintain software used for the integration, test, verification, and operational readiness of deliverable products.

The ideal candidate will bring strong software engineering skills along with experience in space, defense, or other complex, mission-critical environments.

**Essential Functions:**

  

* Participate in the full software development lifecycle to create software solutions used to integrate and test complex customer-deliverable hardware.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to understand mission needs and define, document, and refine software requirements and designs.
* Design, implement, review, integrate, and test software using a variety of programming languages, including C++, C, XML, and Python, across Windows and Linux platforms.
* Support hardware integration and test activities, including software troubleshooting, defect resolution, performance improvement, and technical problem-solving.

* Leverage automation, reuse, and emerging AI-enabled development tools to improve productivity, quality, and long-term software reliability.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance is required for this position.

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
* 1+ year of experience in one or more programming languages such as C++, Python, or similar.

* Working knowledge of Agile methodologies, including Scrum practices, team facilitation, and backlog management.
* Experience with DevOps tools and technologies for virtualization and automation (e.g. Docker, Jenkins, CMake, git/Bitbucket, Artifactory).

* Experience using AI-assisted and agentic software development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, or similar) to improve software design, implementation, debugging, testing, code review, and engineering productivity.

* Experience with drivers/hardware interfaces including PCIe, 1553, RS232, FPGAs, and other unique hardware.

jobs.title: Lead, Systems Engineer (Mission Payload)
jobs.description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**Job Title:** Lead, Systems Engineer – Mission Payload  
**Job Code:** 46150  
**Job Location:** Fort Wayne, Indiana  
**Job Schedule:** 9/80 (Every Other Friday Off!)

**Job Description:**  
L3Harris is seeking a Lead, Systems Engineer to support development of a space-based Electro-Optical/Infrared (EO/IR) sensor system. This position will play a key technical leadership role across the system lifecycle, with primary emphasis on requirements development and management, interface definition and control, and system-level analysis.  
The successful candidate will work across cross-functional engineering teams to ensure mission, payload, subsystem, and external interfaces are clearly defined, traceable, verifiable, and aligned to customer and program objectives. This role is well-suited for an engineer with strong experience in systems engineering rigor, technical coordination, and development of complex space or remote sensing systems.

This position is in Fort Wayne: https://careers.l3harris.com/en/Fort-Wayne

**Essential Functions:**  

* Lead systems engineering efforts for a space-based EO/IR mission payload system across concept, development, integration, test, and verification phases.
* Develop, decompose, allocate, and manage system and subsystem requirements in accordance with program and customer needs.
* Establish and maintain requirements traceability from mission objectives through system architecture, subsystem specifications, and verification methods.
* Define, document, and manage internal and external interfaces, including development of Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and interface verification approaches.
* Perform and coordinate system-level analyses to assess performance, functionality, risk, operability, and compliance to requirements.
* Support system architecture definition and technical baseline maturation for EO/IR payload solutions.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including payload, optics, focal plane, electronics, software, mechanical, integration and test, and mission operations engineering.
* Lead or support technical reviews such as SRR, SDR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and other lifecycle reviews.
* Ensure systems engineering products are complete, consistent, and compliant with internal processes and customer expectations.
* Identify technical risks, develop mitigation plans, and communicate status to engineering and program leadership.
* Support verification and validation planning, including requirements verification cross-reference matrices and test/analysis inspection demonstrations.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers on systems engineering methods, tools, and best practices.
* Job is onsite in Fort Wayne, Indiana

**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM discipline and a minimum of 9 years of relevant experience; or a Graduate degree and a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
* Ability to obtain DoD Secret security clearance

**Preferred Additional Skills:**  

* Experience with space-based EO/IR systems, remote sensing payloads, or electro-optical mission systems.
* Familiarity with requirements management tools such as DOORS, DOORS Next, Jama, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodologies and tools such as Cameo, MagicDraw, Capella, or similar.
* Experience serving as an Integrated Product Team Lead (IPTL) or in another technical leadership role.
* Experience creating and managing ICDs, verification matrices, and technical baselines.
* Understanding of spacecraft-to-payload interfaces and mission operations considerations.
* Experience supporting major program technical reviews and customer interactions.
* Active security clearance
* Experience in systems engineering for complex aerospace, defense, or space-based systems.
* Experience developing and managing requirements at system and subsystem levels.
* Experience defining and managing interfaces across hardware, software, and multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Experience performing or coordinating system analysis, trade studies, or mission/performance assessments.
