jobs.title: Cloud Production Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Experience organizing and prioritizing work across multiple teams in a large-scale, distributed environment and experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes in a large-scale, distributed environment.  
  
  

### **Cloud Production Platform Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Serve as subject matter expert for compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms in Meta's production data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers, anticipating and diagnosing issues for the operations teams, and escalating as appropriate to hardware design and NPI teams
* Act as the deep escalation point for cloud hardware issues, taking handoffs from the cloud triage teams and driving hardware and software investigation through to resolution
* Identify systemic hardware issues within a single cloud provider and across cloud providers, separating cloud provider specific behavior from platform behavior already characterized in Meta's own fleet
* Represent Meta's reliability, diagnosability, and serviceability expectations to cloud providers, compiling the technical evidence those conversations depend on
* Carry findings from the cloud environment back into Meta's own platform work, and apply what is already known about Meta's platforms to accelerate diagnosis in the cloud
* Provide end to end lifecycle support (operational test through end of life decommissioning) of hardware platforms and new technologies in the data centers

* Issue timely alerts and fixes to operations teams, and assure a robust feedback pipeline to engineering teams
* Build strong relationships and collaboration with engineering and cross functional teams across the company. Actively solicit feedback from teams, and use that feedback to improve operational effectiveness as infrastructure scales

* BS degree in Engineering discipline with a minimum 6 years of relevant experience developing real-time embedded software in C or C++ (4 years with MS degree).

**Title:**

Senior Electro-Optical Systems Engineer  
  

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.

  
  

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions.

  
  

Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact.

  
  

*Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment.*

  
  
  

**Position Summary**

  
  

KBR is seeking a Senior Electro-Optical Engineer to support the MIST Contract with NASA at Goddard Space Flight Center. The Senior Electro-Optical Engineer will work on projects from inception at the concept development stage to completion at the product space flight qualification stage. The position requires a specialist's level of knowledge in the design and laboratory testing of remote sensing systems and knowledge of radiometric modeling, radiometric calibration test techniques and algorithms, and level one data processing algorithms and techniques.

  
  

**Must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident**

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

* Conduct the electro-optical design, development, and test of both active and passive remote sensor systems and subsystems for making difficult and complex measurements for science and exploration spaceflight applications for both autonomous and human-rated systems.

* Develop radiometric models of remote sensing instruments and error sources.
* Interacts with end users to resolve engineering design issues and limitations, provide solutions, and coordinate with applications development to design system enhancements as necessary.
* Performs laser related Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) as well as Hazard Analysis for functional safety to identify, manage and reduce risks.
* Possesses both theoretical and experimental expertise in radiometry, radiometric calibration techniques, infrared detectors, programming, data acquisition and processing, and atmospheric spectroscopy.
* Possesses knowledge of electromagnetic sources, such as lasers and blackbodies, along with the means of optically collecting and detecting these sources. The development and deployment of advanced remote-sensing measurement systems is by nature a multi-disciplinary activity which involves a group of individuals with wide ranging skills and abilities. Interpersonal skills, communication skills, and team skills are essential.
* Performance monitoring and enhancements and Validation of performance via NIST calibration of Check Samples. Bidirectional Scatter Distribution Function calibration related experience is a plus.
* Work with Mechanical & Systems Engineers, thermal/structural engineers, customers, and vendors to produce opto-mechanical system development projects in cross-functional engineering teams
* Work with other engineers, technicians, manufacturing, and quality engineers in a team environment
* Prepare and deliver technical presentations, provide inputs to the project schedule and support project level reviews
* Write test procedures, plans & reports as necessary
  

  
  
  
  

**Required Education, Experience, & Skills:**

* MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Electro-Optical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 12 + years of experience as an electrical and/or electro-optical engineer in the aerospace arena.

* Experience with one or more of the following: BRDF measurements, fiber optics, fiber lasers, spectroscopy, integrated photonics, laser communication systems and RF photonics.

* Strong written and oral communication skills

* Strong knowledge in using Zemax or Code V for Aerospace applications with experience in design and/or analysis of optical assemblies and precision mechanisms.

* Knowledge of detectors, detector systems, fiber optics and the design and development of laser systems is desired
* Experience in the development and qualification of Flight Electro-Optical Systems
* Comfortable working in a cross-disciplinary environment to develop and implement new designs or help trouble-shoot existing ones.

* Knowledge of optics fabrication and testing methods.
* Demonstrate ethical and professional behavior in accordance with company values.
  

**Preferred Experience & Skills:**

* Solid understanding of the NASA flight hardware development process and methodology is strongly desired
* Knowledge of optical metrology and interferometry
* Knowledge of optical coating design, process and inspection
* Knowledge in using Zemax or Code V for Aerospace applications with experience in design and/or analysis of optical assemblies and precision mechanisms.

jobs.description:
**Job ID:** 115792

**Location:** Germantown, MD

**Business Unit:** DRS RADA Technologies

**Schedule:** 9/80

**Shift:** First

  

DRS RADA Technologies, a subsidiary of Leonardo DRS, is focused on proprietary radar solutions and legacy avionics systems supporting the defense industry globally. The company is a global pioneer of AESA tactical radars for active military protection, counter-drone applications, critical infrastructure protection, and border surveillance.

**The Role:**
-------------

We are seeking a Senior Software Systems Engineer to advance our systems engineering capabilities in the US, serve as the primary interface between the systems engineering and software engineering teams, and manage our product software configurations. This role will be responsible for identifying, developing, and improving the interfaces for RADA software products and managing requirements for those products. Responsibilities will involve a mix of systems engineering and configuration management.

**What You Will Do:**
---------------------

* Define user needs, functional and product architectures, and product requirements.
* Utilize Model-Based Systems Engineering tools, such as Cameo Enterprise Architecture to capture systems engineering artifacts.
* Maintain and track system-level and product-level configurations to ensure compatibility between components within radar systems.
* Independently evaluate, test, and verify software products against requirements and document results.
* Collaborate closely with software, systems, hardware, integration, and test teams to understand system behavior and deliver working solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, configuration management, documentation, and engineering process improvements.
* Lead assigned technical work, communicate technical risks and tradeoffs clearly, and provide guidance to other engineers as needed.

**What You Bring:**
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field, plus at least five years of relevant systems engineering experience.
* Experience with version control tools such as git
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills in integrated or system-level software environments.
* Ability to own technical work independently and collaborate effectively across software, systems, hardware, integration, and test teams.
* Broad systems engineering experience including thorough understanding of requirements management, functional requirements parsing, derivation, and allocation; systems design, systems integration, technical risk identification and management strategies, and Verification and Validation (V&V) principles.
* Experience developing system engineering artifacts (e.g. specifications, Interface Control Documents, Use Cases, System Architecture Descriptions, Trade Studies, etc.).
* U.S. citizenship is required, along with the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.

**What This Role Is Not:**
--------------------------

* This is not a software development role. While you will manage software requirements and systems configuration, the implementation will be done by the software team.
* This is not a remote position. This full-time role is based on-site in Germantown, Maryland, where close collaboration with software, systems, hardware, integration, and test teams is essential.
* This is not an entry-level engineering role. The Senior Systems Engineer is expected to work independently, lead assigned technical work, make sound engineering decisions, and provide guidance to other team members.
* You will not work in isolation. You will work within a cross-functional team and contribute to systems that must perform reliably in demanding real-world defense environments.

**What We Bring:**
------------------

At DRS RADA Technologies, your work supports technologies that help protect military personnel, critical infrastructure, and communities around the world. You will join a mission-driven team developing advanced radar technology that supports system performance and real-world defense applications.

  

We offer competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; a company contribution to a health savings account; telemedicine; life and disability insurance; legal insurance; and a 401(k) savings plan. We invest in employee well-being, career growth, professional development, and skill enhancement, and offer a flexible 9/80 schedule, competitive vacation, health/emergency leave, paid parental leave, and community service hours.

U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.

  

*The salary range for this position is* ***$107,089.00 -$144,570.00 per year****. This range reflects the good faith estimate of pay the employer is willing to offer at the time of posting. Several factors can influence the pay scale, including but not limited to: Federal contract labor categories and contract wage rates, collective bargaining agreements, geographic location, business considerations, scope, and responsibilities of the position, local or other applicable market conditions, and internal equity. Other factors include the candidate’s qualifications such as prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education/training, and certifications. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for: annual performance-based bonuses, equity awards, and overtime pay (for non-exempt employees as applicable. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), employer matching 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off including vacation, holidays, and sick leave (including ant state-mandated paid sick leave), parental leave benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional development support, and life and disability insurance coverage.*

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Anduril Imaging team develops state-of-the-art imaging systems across both hardware and software, deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies. The team is heavily involved in utilizing computer vision, perception, electro-optical, infrared, and sensor data to give our war fighters and allies an advantage.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

The Imaging team is seeking a Senior Embedded Engineer to design a new product lines. In this role, you will work closely with an interdisciplinary technical team to define, complete the design and analysis, build prototypes leading to ground and flight testing, and mature the prototypes into products.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Lead FPGA architecture, standards, development and review processes
* FPGA Development: Designing, architecting, simulating, and integrating VHDL designs into FPGAs or Systems on Chip (SoC) for optimized performance, resource utilization, and power efficiency.
* Hardware/Software Integration: Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams (electrical engineers, software engineers, systems engineers) to ensure seamless integration of the firmware with the overall system, including processor bring-up and board support packages.
* Testing and Validation: Developing robust test benches in VHDL/Verilog and utilizing lab tools such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers for rigorous testing and validation of designs against functional specifications and performance requirements.
* Optimization: Optimizing the algorithms for hardware acceleration, including MIPS optimization and efficient use of on-chip bus protocols like AXI or AXI-Stream.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Education: A Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field is typically required.
* Experience: 10+ years of experience developing HDL firmware for FPGA devices
* Hardware Description Languages: Expertise in VHDL and/or Verilog/SystemVerilog is essential for RTL (Register Transfer Level) design.
* FPGA Tools: Experience with industry-standard FPGA design tools such as Xilinx Vivado or Intel Quartus.
* Debugging Skills: Strong hardware/software debugging skills using standard lab equipment.
* Version Control: Proficiency with version control systems (e.g., Git) for collaborative development.
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Demonstrated experience designing with multi-gigabit SERDES, DDR memory busses, Ethernet MAC and PHY interfaces, FPGAs, and common communication busses like SPI and I2C
* Embedded software development experience with the use of timers, interrupts, hardware peripherals such as SPI controllers and ADCs
* Knowledge of embedded Linux development, including device trees, hardware drivers, bootloaders, and basic Unix/Linux tools
* Familiar with common programming languages like Python and MATLAB
* Familiarity with infrared image sensor technology

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email

jobs.description:

**Working Location: Massachusetts, Westborough**

**Job Description**
-------------------

Provide technical leadership for verification, test automation, and quality engineering activities supporting the OlySense AI Project, one of the organization’s key strategic initiatives.

The Principal Engineer will serve as a technical leader within the Test Engineering organization, defining and driving scalable test strategies, automation architectures, engineering best practices, and verification approaches across complex software and hardware systems.

This role requires deep technical expertise in software testing and automation, particularly in C++-based systems, combined with the ability to influence engineering direction across multiple teams. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product requirements are testable, verification activities are robust, and appropriate documentation and engineering processes are maintained.

The Principal Engineer will also mentor engineers, establish technical standards, identify opportunities for increased automation, and drive continuous improvements in test effectiveness, maintainability, reliability, and efficiency.

**Job Duties**
--------------

* Provide technical leadership and strategic direction for software verification, test automation, and quality engineering activities across the OlySense AI Project.
* Define, architect, and evolve scalable and maintainable test automation frameworks for complex software, embedded, and hardware-integrated systems.
* Establish and drive the overall automation strategy, with a strong focus on increasing automated verification and reducing reliance on repetitive manual testing.
* Lead the development of risk-based verification and test strategies, ensuring appropriate coverage of functional, integration, system, regression, and performance requirements.
* Perform and guide detailed test analysis of approved functional and system requirements, identifying test conditions, dependencies, risks, and coverage needs.
* Lead requirements ambiguity and testability reviews, working with Systems and Software Engineering teams to improve requirement clarity, completeness, and verifiability.
* Develop and review test plans, test cases, test procedures, traceability documentation, and test summary reports.
* Provide technical oversight for exploratory, automated, integration, system, and regression testing based on functional requirements, architecture, and design documentation.
* Design and maintain functional models and other engineering representations that augment natural-language requirements and improve verification coverage.
* Develop advanced test infrastructure, simulators, mocks, test harnesses, and supporting tools required to verify complex software and hardware interactions.
* Establish best practices for C++ unit testing, mocking, component testing, integration testing, and automated system verification.
* Drive integration of automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, enabling reliable and repeatable execution of verification and regression testing.
* Analyze complex software and system failures, identify root causes, and collaborate with engineering teams to improve product architecture, reliability, observability, and testability.
* Identify gaps in existing verification approaches and introduce innovative tools, techniques, and technologies that improve test effectiveness and engineering productivity.
* Define and promote engineering standards for test code quality, maintainability, reliability, scalability, and documentation.
* Serve as a technical mentor and subject-matter expert, coaching engineers on automation architecture, C++ testing, mocking strategies, test design, and engineering best practices.
* Conduct technical and design reviews and provide guidance on architecture and implementation decisions that affect system testability and verification.
* Collaborate across Software, Systems, Test, Quality, and Program teams to ensure verification activities meet project objectives and applicable development processes.
* Influence technical decisions across teams and help establish the long-term technical roadmap for test automation and verification capabilities.

**Job Qualifications**
----------------------

**Required:**

* Minimum of 10 years of experience in software engineering, software verification, test automation, or related engineering disciplines, including significant experience designing and implementing complex automated test solutions.
* Demonstrated experience operating as a technical leader, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Architect, or equivalent senior engineering role.
* Strong proficiency in C++, including modern C++ development practices and experience testing complex C++ applications and libraries.
* Deep understanding of: Unit testing. Mocking. Dependency isolation. Integration testing. System testing. Test-driven engineering principles.
* Hands-on experience with C++ testing and mocking frameworks such as: Google Test. Google Mock. FakeIt. Equivalent technologies.
* Strong experience designing and maintaining test automation frameworks and test infrastructure.
* Experience with test management and requirements management platforms such as: Azure DevOps. Jama. Quality Center. Equivalent tool

jobs.title: Senior Mission Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**About the Team**
------------------

The Imaging team builds and fields state-of-the-art camera and sensor systems deployed to solve real security challenges for the United States and its allies. We work across the full stack, from bare-metal hardware and firmware to networked services and cloud integrations, and we own our systems all the way through to the field. When something breaks in a deployed environment, we fix it.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Mission Software Engineer to join the Imaging Interfaces team. This is not a pure product development role. You will spend meaningful time keeping fielded systems alive, triaging issues across the full stack, and serving as a technical representative for our products in integrations with external teams and customers.  
  
The work is varied and sometimes ambiguous. You might spend a morning extending a gRPC service, an afternoon diagnosing a time sync issue on a deployed device over the phone with a field operator, and a week traveling to support a customer integration. You'll need to be comfortable with that range—and ideally energized by it.  
  
If you want to own your software end-to-end in a fast-moving environment where the stakes are real, this role is built for you.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own fielded system success.** You are responsible for the health and uptime of deployed imaging systems. When issues arise—whether the root cause is in your code, the firmware, the network, or the hardware—you triage, diagnose, and drive resolution.  
  
**Build and maintain production services.** You'll develop and extend modular software services that run on edge-compute devices in austere environments. These services need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable by engineers who didn't write them.  
  
**Support field operations.** You'll work directly with field operators and non-technical users to diagnose and resolve issues on deployed hardware. Clear communication under pressure is part of the job.  
  
**Represent the team externally.** You'll serve as a subject matter expert in integrations with other products and teams; sometimes remotely, sometimes on-site. You don't need to know everything, but you need to be able to speak credibly across the full system stack and know what you don't know.  
  
**Maintain end-to-end system understanding.** Our devices sit at the intersection of hardware, firmware, networking, and software. You'll develop broad fluency across that stack over time, and apply it to optimize how our services interact and degrade gracefully when components fail.  
  
**Collaborate across teams.** You'll plan, build, and test complex functionality alongside firmware, hardware, and platform engineers. You'll need to be effective working across team and organizational boundaries.  
  
Travel expected approximately 15% of the time for field testing and customer integrations.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required**

* 5+ years of experience in software development with meaningful production responsibility—not just shipping features, but owning systems after they ship
* Strong Python and C++ skills. You don't need to be a language expert in both, but you need to be able to work effectively in either
* 5+ years working in Linux-based environments, including bare-metal hardware
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve issues across system boundaries (networking, services, hardware interaction) without always having full visibility into every component
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical problems clearly to non-technical audiences
* Willingness to travel approximately 15% of the time for field testing and customer integrations.
* Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance

**Preferred**

* Experience with gRPC or similar RPC frameworks
* Familiarity with systems service management and observability practices on Linux
* React/JSX experience; we have a UI surface and it matters
* Familiarity with Nix or NixOS—uncommon, but genuinely valuable on our stack
* Experience supporting fielded or deployed systems, not just development environments

**What are Trust Fund Positions?**

Trust Fund positions are unique to the Smithsonian. They are paid for from a variety of sources, including the Smithsonian endowment, revenue from our business activities, donations, grants and contracts. Trust employees are not part of the civil service, nor does trust fund employment lead to Federal status. The salary ranges for trust positions are generally the same as for federal positions and in many cases trust and federal employees work side by side. Trust employees have their own benefit program, which may include Health, Dental & Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Transit/Commuter Benefits, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Annual and Sick Leave, Family Friendly Leave, 403b Retirement Plan, Discounts for Smithsonian Memberships, Museum Stores and Restaurants, Credit Union, Smithsonian Early Enrichment Center (Childcare), Flexible Spending Account (Health & Dependent Care).

The Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory (SAO) is at the forefront, internationally, of the scientific exploration of the universe. The research objectives of SAO are carried out primarily with the support of Government and Smithsonian Institution funds, with additional philanthropic support. Government funds are in the form of Federal appropriations or the form of contracts and grants from other agencies. In contrast, Institution funds are available to SAO through grants from the Institution's Restricted Funds, Special Purpose Funds, Bureau Activities, Business Activities, and non-Federal contracts and grants.

At Mass General Brigham, our competency framework defines what effective leadership “looks like” by specifying which behaviors are most critical for successful performance at each job level. The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People-Focused, half Performance-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
STR is hiring a **Software Engineer** to join our multidisciplinary cyber/networking team committed to developing cutting-edge technologies that have an immediate and significant impact on our national security. Our team innovates communications technology across all networking layers, from the physical to the application layer. We value diverse skills, experiences, and perspectives, which are vital to delivering innovative solutions to our customers. If any of the skills below align with your expertise, we encourage you to apply!

**Job Overview:** A successful candidate will possess experience in software engineering, integration and testing, and networking concepts and protocols, with a strong passion for results-driven development on Linux systems. This candidate will bring a versatile skill set in computer science, software architecture, and practical software development, testing, and documentation. The ideal Software Engineer is intellectually curious, motivated, and thrives in a team-based environment focused on rapid prototyping and delivering impactful solutions.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a high-profile, fast-paced, yet structured development environment alongside a diverse and talented team. In this role, you will design, implement, and test software that enhances advanced real-time data communications and networking solutions using open systems principles. We aim for the highest standards of quality, maintainability, and reuse in our tools and techniques. Therefore, experience with sound software engineering principles and testing methodologies is crucial.

**What you will do:**

* Collaborate closely with a small, dedicated research team to develop innovative solutions to complex problems
* Execute assigned tasks and report overall status to project leadership
* Develop and test novel software solutions spanning research, development, and deployed production systems
* Identify creative and innovative approaches to open-ended problems
* Deliver high-quality software in a rapid-paced team environment
* Develop operational prototypes for experimentation and performance analysis
* Create customer-facing operational systems

**Who you are:**

* This position requires the ability to obtain a **Top Secret (TS)** security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is required by the U.S. Government.
* Proficient in Python, C, C++, or similar interpreted or low-level programming languages
* Familiar with rapid prototyping design methodologies and open architectures
* Someone with a working knowledge of software testing and evaluation best practices
* Experience developing software with GNU/Linux toolchains using open-source software
* Understanding of the 5-layer OSI networking stack
* Strong team player with excellent communication skills
* Have a Bachelor's or Masters degree in Computer Science, Electrical & Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, with at least 2 years of relevant experience

**Nice to Have:**

* Active Top Secret (TS) Security Clearance
* Proficiency in Python, MATLAB, and other high-level programming languages
* Experience in building, deploying, and maintaining robust and stable software
* Experience writing software within a large multi-party codebase
* Experience working in a laboratory environment performing quantitative data analysis
* Familiarity with multi-threaded or multi-core real-time operating concepts
* Knowledge of high-level software architecture design
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  

**Pay Information**  
Full-Time Salary Range: $112,000 - $154,000

*The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate's experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.*

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

*STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at* *appassist@str.us* *and provide your contact info.*

*Pursuant to applicable federal law and regulations, positions at STR require employees to obtain national security clearances and satisfy the requirements for compliance with export control and other applicable laws.*

The Systems Engineering and Test Capabilities (SE&TC) Surface Radars & Sensors Center is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to be the Product Owner for an Agile team developing radar simulation tools for the Long Range Radars Department. This onsite role is based in Woburn, MA. The Systems Engineering Long Range Radars (SELRR) department provides subject matter expertise in concept development, architectural design, requirements generation and flow‑down, modeling and simulation, systems analysis, integration, test, and evaluation of world‑class Missile Defense and Sensor Systems.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive product direction and execution for a radar simulation tool suite, leading Agile ceremonies and ensuring strong technical integration.
* Own and manage the team backlog, ensuring features are clearly defined, prioritized, and translated into actionable Agile user stories with measurable acceptance criteria.
* Lead refinement sessions, break down epics into estimable user stories, and define sprint goals aligned with program needs.
* Oversee technical, cost, and schedule performance for assigned engineering scope within the AN/TPY‑2 program.
* Support milestone planning, schedule development, earned value management, and risk/issue resolution.
* Design, develop, and execute verification and validation test plans for radar system capabilities within the Common X‑Band Environment Development Tool (CX‑EDT) simulation.
* Review radar system designs and implement updates within the simulation environment.
* Develop software tools and components that emulate radar system behavior.
* Conduct performance data analysis and automate workflows using MATLAB.
* Verify and validate simulation performance against fielded radar systems.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to enhance digital simulations, support multi‑mission scenario analysis, and troubleshoot radar performance issues.
* Support integration of high‑fidelity radar simulations into systems operated by other U.S. Government organizations.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 5 years of prior relevant experience.
* Experience in Systems Engineering and/or Software Engineering.
* Experience working in an Agile environment and/or on Agile development projects

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Excellent communication, technical writing, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interface directly with customers and lead technical solutions.
* Prior experience with the AN/TPY‑2 system and/or broader Missile Defense programs, including work on large, complex systems.
* Strong understanding of radar systems engineering, including radar design, analysis, modeling, and hands‑on simulation experience.
* Proficiency in software development, including Python and C++, and expertise in MATLAB for data analysis and automation.

* Proven experience with current Missile defense programs with specific experience in large, complex systems.
* Ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment with time-critical requirements.
* Advanced degree (PhD/Master’s) in Engineering or related discipline.

**What We Offer**

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
* Relocation Eligibility – Relocation assistance available.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Robotics
jobs.description:
**Location:** United States - Minneapolis, MN

**Pay:** $85,200 - $127,600

  

With more than $1B in revenue, Tennant Company is a globally recognized leader in the cleaning equipment industry. For the past 150 years, we have been passionate about developing and manufacturing innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers. At Tennant Company, we are committed to stewardship and creating a cleaner, safer and healthier world. With manufacturing, operations and sales, service, and support functions across the globe, your journey at Tennant can take you places you never expected.

  

We are seeking an Experienced Software Engineer to join the Tennant Company (TNC) Robotics Product Development organization. This role focuses on the development, integration, and support of embedded and connected software systems that power robotic cleaning machines and related platforms.

The Software Engineer works closely with Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Test, and other Software Engineers to translate product requirements into robust, maintainable software solutions. Success in this role is measured by software quality, reliability, integration effectiveness, and the ability to deliver features on schedule while adhering to sound engineering practices.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Embedded & Platform Software Development**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded software using C/C++ on Linux and/or Real‑Time Operating Systems (RTOS).
* Contribute to software running on machine controllers and companion processing units.
  

**Support activities such as:**

* Board bring‑up and hardware/software integration
* Driver configuration or modification under guidance of senior engineers
* Debugging software and hardware/software interface issues
* Ensure software integrates cleanly with electrical, controls, and mechanical subsystems.
  

**Connected Systems & Communications**

* Develop and support software that interfaces with connected and distributed systems, including:
* Controller‑to‑controller communication (CAN, CANOpen)
* Ethernet and USB‑based interfaces
* Support implementation of IoT‑enabled features under defined architectures, including data exchange and system monitoring.
* Follow established practices for secure and reliable communications.
  

**Software Design & Requirements**

* Establish and refine functional requirements and performance targets for assigned software features or subsystems
* Create and maintain software design documentation, including flowcharts, context diagrams, and interface descriptions.
* Participate in design reviews, providing constructive feedback and incorporating review outcomes into designs.
* Ensure software designs align with regulatory and product requirements.
  

**Quality, Testing & Debugging**

* Develop software with a strong focus on quality and maintainability.
* Perform software debugging, fault isolation, and root cause analysis.
* Participate in unit‑level and system‑level testing, supporting verification of software requirements.
* Follow coding standards and contribute to peer reviews.
  

**Development Process & Tooling**

* Execute software development activities through the New Product Development (NPD) lifecycle.
* Participate as a contributing team member in Agile or iterative development processes.
  

**Use established tools for:**

* Configuration management (Bitbucket or similar)
* Defect tracking and task management (Jira)
* Requirements management and collaboration (Visure or similar)
* Contribute to improving software processes and documentation over time.
  

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Systems, Hardware, Test, Manufacturing, and external partners to resolve integration challenges.
* Support new product launches and help address issues discovered during integration, testing, or early production.
* Communicate technical status, risks, and recommendations clearly within the team.
  

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical, Software or Computer Engineering.
* Minimum 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, including embedded or systems‑adjacent development.
* Hands‑on experience developing software using C/C++; familiarity with Linux and/or RTOS environments.
* Experience working with requirements, configuration management, and defect tracking tools.
* Demonstrated ability to debug software and support system‑level troubleshooting.
* Experience working effectively on cross‑functional engineering teams.
  

**Preferred**

* Experience in robotics, autonomous systems, or complex electro‑mechanical products.
* Exposure to IoT or connected systems.
* Experience with scripting or higher‑level languages such as Python or C#.
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN or CANOpen.
* Experience with unit testing, integration testing, or system verification.
* Interest in growing technical scope and responsibility over time.
  

**Key Attributes for Success**

* Strong hands‑on software engineer with solid fundamentals and curiosity.
* Comfortable working in complex systems and learning new technologies.
* Quality‑focused, with attention to detail and follow‑through.
* Collaborative team member who communicates clearly across disciplines.
* Motivated to grow toward senior or lead software engineering roles.
  

**Total Compensation = Pay range + Benefits**

Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. Tennant Sales and Service Co. reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualifications of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity. The salary range reflects both entry into the role and future growth. Total Compensation = Base Salary + Benefits

  

Benefits = A comprehensive benefits package including multiple medical plan options, 401(k) with a 100% match up to 6%, paid vacation time, 8 paid company holidays and 3 personal holidays dental and vision coverage, wellness rewards, robust family support

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking an **Electrical Engineer** to join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team in Plymouth, Minnesota, supporting critical programs for our defense customers.

This requisition may be filled at either the **Electrical Engineer (Level 2)** or **Principal Electrical Engineer (Level 3)** based on the selected candidate’s qualifications.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively on cross‑functional teams.

* Must be a U.S. citizen.
* Ability to obtain a U.S. Government Secret security clearance after hire.
* Solid understanding of electronic product development processes.
* Experience creating and modeling electrical schematics and evaluating design robustness through simulation and lab testing, using electronic design schematic capture and simulation tools.
* Ability to evaluate and select components that meet applicable requirements.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively on cross‑functional teams.
* Demonstrated ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
* Proven ability to perform effectively in a fast‑paced, rapidly changing environment with short turnaround times.
* Ability to travel occasionally to meet with government and industry customers and to interface with suppliers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Mentor Graphics/Siemens EDA design and simulation tools.
* Experience in developing embedded systems that utilize high-performance FPGAs.
* Printed wiring board (PWB) layout and design experience; knowledge of PWB manufacturing processes in accordance with IPC Class III requirements.
* Experience working with PWB and circuit card assembly (CCA) suppliers.
* Experience with design for manufacturability (DFM) and design for assembly (DFA).
* Experience developing high‑reliability electronics for military environments, including:
  + Extreme temperature conditions
  + High‑G shock loads

jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Experience organizing and prioritizing work across multiple teams in a large-scale, distributed environment and experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes in a large-scale, distributed environment.  
  
  

### **Cloud Production Platform Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Identify systemic hardware issues within a single cloud provider and across cloud providers, separating cloud provider specific behavior from platform behavior already characterized in Meta's own fleet
* Represent Meta's reliability, diagnosability, and serviceability expectations to cloud providers, compiling the technical evidence those conversations depend on
* Carry findings from the cloud environment back into Meta's own platform work, and apply what is already known about Meta's platforms to accelerate diagnosis in the cloud
* Provide end to end lifecycle support (operational test through end of life decommissioning) of hardware platforms and new technologies in the data centers

jobs.description:
Overview:

The Controls Engineer is responsible for the development, validation, and release of electronic control products, software-enabled features, and supporting applications used in Hussmann equipment. This role interprets customer needs, translates them into functional control solutions, and leads cross functional activities related to new product development, customer-driven requests, and existing product improvements. The engineer will also provide technical support to internal teams and customers, ensuring reliable, safe, and effective control system performance.

Responsibilities:

* Capture functional requirements and create design documentation for electronic control systems and PC based applications.
* Coordinate with suppliers and development partners to improve electronic designs for cost, quality, reliability, and functionality.
* Review system‑level control assemblies including embedded PCs, PLCs, power supplies, displays, sensors, wiring harnesses, and communication interfaces.
* Analyze and validate application‑specific electronics and 3rd‑party components for system compatibility and regulatory compliance.
* Perform system‑level and component‑level validation, testing, and analysis to ensure proper control operation and customer-driven functionality.
* Support validation of software behavior in control systems, including troubleshooting and identifying improvements.
* Contribute to the development of manuals, instructions, test procedures, user documentation, and technical bulletins.

**Project Leadership & Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Marketing, Field Service, and other teams to support new product development and product enhancements.
* Serve as a technical resource for field technicians, sales teams, and customers regarding control system behavior and product functionality.
* Create and communicate project plans, tasks, and deliverables; present concise updates at key milestones.
* Lead and support engineering activities required to meet KPIs, timelines, and customer expectations.
* Leverage internal and external experts to incorporate emerging technologies into Hussmann products and create competitive advantages.

**Continuous Improvement & Technical Development**

* Utilize diagnostic tools, validation equipment, and instrumentation to support development and troubleshooting of electronic control systems.
* Apply a strong understanding of refrigeration system behavior to evaluate control logic, sensor usage, and system protection strategies.
* Participate in continuous learning to grow expertise in electronics, control systems, refrigeration principles, and software validation.
* Support improvement of manufacturing processes through documentation, procedures, and control-related best practices.

* Experience with Bill of Material Structures and Engineering Change processes.
* Technical understanding of refrigeration systems, sensors, and control strategies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Our teams are currently hiring for a *broad range of experience levels* including; Associate, Experienced and Senior Level Software Engineers.

  
  

The **Network Centric Operations Team** designs, develops, and implements platform-agnostic software capabilities that enable network operations for tactical fighter aircraft. As a Data Fusion Software Engineer, you’ll develop and prototype advanced sensor-fusion algorithms, applying mathematical and statistical techniques to track and combine data from multiple sensors and sources. You’ll evaluate algorithm performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and partner with the software architect to transition successful prototypes into production-ready capabilities.

  
  

We’re looking for a collaborative, accountable professional who is committed to customer satisfaction and continuous process improvement. The successful candidate will thrive in a multi-contract, multi-program environment and apply ingenuity and innovation to complex challenges.

  
  

You should be adaptable and eager to learn new technologies in evolving development environments. You’ll bring a strong foundation in mathematics and the ability to translate theoretical concepts into practical, real-world solutions, along with the drive to solve difficult problems and contribute to a team’s success.

  
  

**Join Us. Power the Mission.**

  
  

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Derive and quantify data fusion algorithms and techniques (Kalman Filters, Bayesian Networks, statistical modeling, etc.)
* Author and maintain technical description documents, requirements and algorithm analysis memos (AAMs) for data fusion algorithms and techniques
* Analyze data fusion techniques for accuracy and effectiveness
* Develop prototype algorithms (C++, Python, MatLab, etc)
* Partner with software architect(s) to inform effective and efficient algorithm implementation and design
* Collect, organize, synthesize, and analyze data; summarize findings; develop conclusions and recommendations from appropriate data sources
* Collaborate with customers on requirements development
  

  

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/ Experience):**

* Bachelor's Degree
* **Ability to obtain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S.** Citizenship
* 2+ years' experience with sensors, sensor management and fusion, datalinks, and/or weapons and their interactions
* 2+ years' experience with data fusion engines, kinematic correlation techniques and Kalman filters
* Experience with pattern recognition, multi-modal sensor data fusion, sensor calibration and visualization technologies
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* 3 or more years’ related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* 5 or more years’ related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* **Active U.S. Secret Security Clearance**
* **Associate** (Level 2): Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), chemistry, physics, mathematics, data science, or computer science and 2+ years of related work experience **OR** Bachelor’s Degree and 6+ years of directly related work experience **OR** 10+ years of related, relevant experience
* **Experienced** (Level 3): Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), chemistry, physics, mathematics, data science, or computer science and 5+ years of related work experience **OR** Bachelor’s Degree and 9+ years of directly related work experience **OR** 13+ years of related, relevant experience
* **Senior** (Level 4): Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), chemistry, physics, mathematics, data science, or computer science and 9+ years of related work experience **OR** Bachelor’s Degree and 13+ years of directly related work experience **OR** 17+ years of related, relevant experience
* Data Fusion analysis/software development experience
* Self-starter with a positive attitude, high ethics, strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills and a track record of working successfully under pressure in a time-constrained environment
* Skill and ability to: collect, organize, synthesize, and analyze data; summarize findings; develop conclusions and recommendations from appropriate data sources
* Experience with sensor data such as Radar and various infrared sensors
* Experience developing and implementing probabilistic models to combine sensor data such as Bayesian reasoning, Kalman filtering and evidence theory
* Experience with advanced probability statistics and applying in real world scenarios
  

  

**Drug Free Workplace:**

Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace (DFW) where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Sr. Software Engineer- EPMO position is a direct report to the EPMO Operations Manager. The role is responsible for EPMO systems and how they align with IT user needs. The Engineer documents requirements, establishes scope, establishes objectives and determines strategy for implementing IT systems to achieve business goals. The role partners with IT business functions to understand operations, reliability, business value and technical requirements and align them with IT functional and non-functional business requirements.

The Engineer is responsible for the development, implementation, and maintenance of Smartsheet solutions for PSEG. The ideal candidate will have experience with Smartsheet, as well as strong programming and analytical skills.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Involved in the full systems life cycle and responsible for designing, coding, testing, implementing, and supporting application software and systems.
* Analyze end-user needs and designs, develop and test software to satisfy demand.
* Perform build versus buy analysis for business demand.
* Partner with business analysts to translate business requirements to application requirements.
* Evaluate existing applications and platforms and provide recommendations for improving application performance by conducting gap analysis, identifying feasible alternative solutions, and assisting in the scope of modifications.
* Create process flowcharts, diagrams, and other related documentation; develop technical workflows using different modeling techniques.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and infrastructure to integrate applications and hardware.
* Ensure that the design and application implementation meet security and QA standards.
* Suggest fixes to issues by doing a thorough analysis of root cause and impact of the defect.
* Analyze application reports to ensure that the functionality and performance meets all product and service level requirements.
* Code applications using a disciplined development process.
* Provide daily support with resolution of escalated tickets.
* Apply operation break fixes and other proactive maintenance activities until permanent solutions can be implemented.
* Support and participate in the software deployment process for new modules, upgrades, and fixes to the production environment.
* Document functions and change to new or modified modules and test activities/results.
* Make modules production-ready by moving them to libraries, completing forms, following procedures, completing version control documents, etc.

**Job Specific Qualifications**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Information Science, or related field.
* Minimum of 6 years of work experience in web and software development.
* Must have 6 years of experience in the following: technical and functional experience in the development and support of IT systems; experience with one or more of the following technologies: .NET, FileNet, WebLogic, Oracle Application Server, IIS, Tomcat, MSSQL, Oracle SQL, OSI PI, IBM WebSphere.
* Experience with translating business requirements into system functional and non-functional requirements; experience with business and system process flow techniques using UML (e.g. Use Case Diagrams, Activity Diagrams, Entity Relationship Diagrams); experience with specific phases of the software development life cycle, especially Agile, Iterative, and Waterfall.
* Experience creating both technical and non-technical end-user documentation.
* Must be available for 24x7 coverage for nuclear application support when needed, as well as for assignment for 24x7 scheduled coverage during for Nuclear refueling outages.
* Scheduled remote work allowed in conjunction with required in office days in Salem, NJ. Must have legal authority to work in U.S. EEOE. Standard company benefits.

jobs.title: Principal Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Onto Innovation is a leader in process control, combining global scale with an expanded portfolio of leading-edge technologies that include: 3D metrology spanning the chip from nanometer-scale transistors to micron-level die-interconnects; macro defect inspection of wafers and packages; metal interconnect composition; factory analytics; and lithography for advanced semiconductor packaging. Our breadth of offerings across the entire semiconductor value chain helps our customers solve their most difficult yield, device performance, quality, and reliability issues. Onto Innovation strives to optimize customers’ critical path of progress by making them smarter, faster and more efficient.

**Job Summary & Responsibilities**

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Systems Engineer to lead the architecture, integration, and validation of complex systems for advanced semiconductor Films and OCD metrology equipment. This role requires deep technical leadership across multidisciplinary domains, including optics, mechanics, electronics, software, and controls.

The Principal Systems Engineer will define system-level requirements, ensure cross-functional alignment, and drive technical execution from concept through production. This individual serves as the technical authority and plays a critical role in solving complex system-level challenges impacting performance, reliability, and scalability.

**Key Responsibilities**

System Architecture & Technical Leadership

* Define and own system architecture for complex, high-precision equipment.
* Translate product requirements into detailed system specifications and subsystem requirements.
* Lead trade studies, system partitioning, and design decisions across multiple engineering disciplines.
* Serve as the technical lead and decision-maker for system-level design reviews.

Requirements & Interface Management

* Develop, manage, and maintain system requirements, including traceability and validation.
* Define and control system interfaces (mechanical, electrical, optical, software).
* Ensure alignment between subsystem designs and overall system performance requirements.

Integration & Validation

* Lead system integration efforts, identifying and resolving cross-domain issues.
* Develop system-level test plans, validation strategies, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive root cause analysis and resolution of system performance issues.

Performance & Reliability Engineering

* Establish system error budgets, performance models, and sensitivity analyses.
* Ensure system stability under environmental conditions (thermal, vibration, contamination).
* Lead design for reliability, maintainability, and manufacturability at the system level.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Collaborate with optical, mechanical, electrical, and software engineering teams.
* Interface with product management, manufacturing, quality, and field service teams.
* Mentor junior engineers and influence technical direction across the organization.

Program Execution

* Support project planning, risk assessment, and milestone delivery.
* Identify technical risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Support customer engagements and translate application needs into system capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Optical, Physics, or related field).
* 10+ years of experience in complex system design and integration.
* Proven experience in systems engineering within semiconductor equipment, photonics, aerospace, or precision instrumentation industries.
* Strong understanding of multidisciplinary systems (mechanics, optics, electronics, controls, and software).
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with semiconductor metrology, inspection, or lithography systems.
* Knowledge of precision motion systems, optics, vacuum systems, or laser-based instrumentation.
* Familiarity with modeling and simulation tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink).
* Experience defining system error budgets and performance modeling.
* Exposure to cleanroom environments and high-reliability systems.

Key Competencies

* Strategic thinking with strong system-level perspective.
* Exceptional problem-solving and debugging skills in complex systems.
* Strong leadership and technical mentorship capabilities.
* Effective communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and drive decisions in complex environments.

Why Join Onto Innovation?

At Onto Innovation, we believe your work should matter—and so should your well-being. That’s why we offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you and your family. From health, dental, and vision coverage to life and disability insurance, PTO, and a 401(k) with employer match, we’ve got you covered. You’ll also enjoy access to our Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), wellness initiatives, and cutting-edge tools—all within a collaborative, inclusive culture where your contributions are valued and recognized.

**Compensation & Growth**

* Base Salary Range:

$130,000.00 - $195,000.00, offered in good faith and based on experience, location, and qualifications.

* Additional Rewards: Annual bonus opportunities and potential long-term incentives tied to both company and individual success.

Empowering Every Voice to Shape the Future:

Onto Innovation is committed to creating a workplace where every qualified candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed. We evaluate applicants based on skills, experience, and potential - without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe diversity of thought and background drives innovation and strengthens our team.

jobs.title: Early Career R&D S&E, Electrical Engineer ,Onsite
jobs.description:
**About Sandia**
----------------

  

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

* Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
* Extraordinary co-workers
* Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
* Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
* Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance\*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov

  

* These benefits vary by job classification.

**What Your Job Will Be Like**
------------------------------

  

The Future Nuclear Deterrent Systems Engineering department, Org 0231, is seeking a motivated Electrical Engineer to help execute a Rapid System Integration project under the 00200-led initiative utilizing Sandia designed and developed advanced reentry vehicles. This role offers an opportunity to work in a high-energy environment. You will be at the forefront of a mission to seamlessly incorporate a cutting-edge system prototype within incredibly tight deadlines.

On any given day you may be called on to:

* Design flight electronics, wire harnesses and cables, high-speed circuits, and electronics.
* Work with firmware and embedded software engineers to verify electronic hardware designs.
* Work in collaboration with mechanical, system, and qualification engineers to meet harsh environmental test requirements.
* Support environmental testing activities of component designs.
* Support avionics component development.

Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite.

**Salary Range**
----------------

  

$102,400 - $199,700

* Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

**Qualifications We Require**
-----------------------------

* A Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE- Q clearance or equivalent

**Qualifications We Desire**
----------------------------

  

The ideal R&D S&E Electrical Engineer candidate for Sandia National Laboratories will in addition possess the following:

* Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering or a highly related field where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation).
* Ability to work independently and collaborate well in a multidisciplinary team of designers and test engineers.
* Outstanding verbal and written skills, including the ability to develop and present briefings that are clear and compelling.

Also, for this posting we are seeking individuals with the following experience:

* Direct experience designing electronics.
* Demonstrated practice of circuit modeling/analysis, circuit testing, or circuit-device integration in electrical design.
* Component and/or System-level design trades experience.
* Familiarity with serial or Mil-Std digital interface communication standards.
* Electronic circuit verification via simulation.
* Knowledge of and user-experience with computer aided circuit-electrical design, printed circuit board layout, manufacturing, and testing.
* Experience with nuclear weapon qualification
* Knowledge of the Nuclear Weapons qualification process.

**About Our Team**
------------------

  

Organization 231 provides diverse engineering expertise to support high priority, short-turn projects for Sandia's Nuclear Deterrence mission. We partner with other design, testing, and production groups across the Laboratories to develop designs that meet customer needs and deliver on time. Our organization is flexible and adaptable to address a variety of requests from NNSA and DoD in initiating and executing programs through sound systems engineering principles.

**Posting Duration**
--------------------

  

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

**Security Clearance**
----------------------

  

Sandia is required by DOE to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain a security clearance may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.
