jobs.title: Software Engineer - Space Programs
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton has an immediate opening for a Jr./Mid-level **Software Engineer** who will join our team at the White Sands Complex in Las Cruces, NM. Your role in this position will include software requirements gathering, software design, development, troubleshooting and debugging.

  

Peraton is the prime contractor on the SENSE contract for NASA at the White Sands Complex near Las Cruces, New Mexico. Operating here are two functionally identical satellite ground terminals: The White Sands Ground Terminal, and the second TDRSS Ground Terminal. These two terminals ensure uninterrupted communications between various ground stations, NASA’s orbiting fleet of Tracking and Data Relay Satellites (TDRS), customer spacecraft (satellites), and the computer systems that support such spacecraft. The WSC also serves as an interface for distributing satellite data to control centers and scientists who then use the daily influx of data to expand our ever-growing knowledge of the Earth and the universe.

  

**This position will be responsible for:**

* Performs systems modeling, simulation and analysis to provide appropriate telemetry, tracking, and command software solutions.
* Provides input for documentation of new or existing programs to ensure information accessibility, as required.
* Participates in designing, developing, troubleshooting and analyzing software programs that operate with hardware systems.
* Assists in customizing purchased applications and assists in maintaining program libraries and manuals based on research and customer needs.
* Provides feedback and reports to management on the status and availability of software and hardware to ensure proper functioning.
* Works with customer(s) to provide hands-on first level support.

##### **Qualifications**

**Required Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics or related technical field and 2 years of relative experience.
* Security clearance - this position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a DoD Secret security clearance and to maintain the clearance thereafter.
* You must be a US Citizen and show proof of citizenship.
* Must be able to maintain ability to access government worksite.

**Desired Experience**

* Experience in software engineering with OpenVMS or Linux or Windows operating systems.
* Experience with SQL databases.
* Experience working with object-oriented coding languages such as Ada or C++ or Java.
* Experience working with software design principles.
* A willingness to learn and remain agile in a dynamic environment.
* The ability to work in a team environment.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills for design, creation and testing of software.
* Interpersonal skills to interact with customers and team members.

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

**EEO:** Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

We are looking for a motivated R&D Electrical Engineer to take on a unique and impactful role as the sole System Electrical Lead for the W88 Environmental Measurement Unit (EMU) team, as well as contribute to the broader D5LE2 program. * Present findings at technical design reviews and other forums, representing Sandia on internal and external multi-organizational project teams.
* Engage with the National Nuclear Security Administration and Department of Defense to ensure their requirements are met and incorporated.

This position offers a rare chance to lead electrical engineering efforts early in your career, with significant responsibility and visibility.

Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant will be required to work onsite in Albuquerque, NM. Some travel may be required for this position (up to 25%).

jobs.title: Software Engineer Sr
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

### **What We're Doing**

The coolest jobs on this planet… or any other… are with Lockheed Martin!

At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems in Owego, NY, we develop mission‑critical embedded software and advanced technologies for complex defense and aerospace systems. Our software supports safety‑critical avionics, mission computers, embedded processing, and secure systems where reliability and performance matter.

### **The Work**

As a Level 3 Senior Software Engineer, you'll work across the software development lifecycle, taking ownership of complex technical assignments and developing solutions that move from design into real mission systems. You’ll turn requirements into solutions, solve problems, and collaborate across engineering disciplines to deliver mission‑critical capabilities.

You’ll have the opportunity to:

* Design, develop, integrate, test, debug, and maintain product line application software for aircraft navigation systems.
* Analyze requirements and develop software solutions that run on Real‑Time Operating Systems and hypervisors such as LynxOS, Windriver VxWorks, or Green Hills Integrity.
* Perform hands‑on software/hardware integration, verification, troubleshooting, and system‑level debugging using target hardware and laboratory instrumentation.
* Analyze and resolve complex issues involving position calculation, flight planning, and hardware/software interfaces.
* Apply software‑engineering standards, development processes, configuration management, and coding best practices.
* Support modern DevSecOps practices, including CI/CD and automated testing.
* Participate in peer reviews and technical design discussions.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.

### **Who We Are**

RMS Owego brings together software, systems, hardware, and integration expertise to develop advanced mission solutions. Our engineers work with real mission hardware in onsite laboratories, taking software from architecture and design through integration, test, and delivery.

### **Who You Are**

You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys solving problems and figuring out how things work. You can independently tackle significant technical challenges, communicate effectively, collaborate across engineering disciplines, and apply sound engineering judgment.

### **Why Join Us**

At Lockheed Martin, you'll work alongside experienced engineers on technology with real‑world mission impact while continuing to grow your technical expertise. We offer flexible schedules, including 4×10 and Flex Time, comprehensive benefits, career development and mentorship, and hands‑on opportunities from early development through laboratory integration and testing.

Bring your ideas. Own the challenge. Build what’s next.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* 5+ years related experience with an Associates Degree in STEM related field.
* 2+ years developing C/C++ code for embedded systems.
* Familiar with developing and debugging software that controls hardware devices.
* Experience developing, integrating, and debugging software within a Real-Time Operating System (RTOS) or embedded Linux environment (e.g., Wind River VxWorks, LynxOS, Green Hills Integrity, or similar).
* Must be a US Citizen; this position will require a DoD government security clearance at the Secret level.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Bachelors degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent STEM computing field with 5 years related professional experience or 3+ years related experience required with a related Masters degree
* Experience working with communication protocols such as ARINC 429, MIL-STD 1553, RS 422 Serial.
* Experience writing device drivers and product line software

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Simulation, Fauna
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Fauna uses simulation to train robots, evaluate their behavior, and develop new capabilities before deploying them in the real world. We’re looking for a Simulation Software Engineer to build the environments, tools, and systems that make this possible—from generating diverse virtual worlds to testing robot behavior and running simulation at scale.
  
  
You’ll partner with scientists, robotics engineers, and technical artists to expand what robots can experience in simulation and what our teams can build with it. Your work could span procedural scene generation, automated evaluation, interactive experiences, and remotely hosted simulation. We welcome backgrounds in robotics, real-time systems, simulation, and scalable data infrastructure.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Develop workflows for generating, configuring, and managing diverse scenes, assets, and scenarios.

  

* Extend simulation to support robot capabilities and interactions among robots, people, and dynamic environments.

  

* Make simulation experiments reproducible and easy to inspect, with tools for automated evaluation, debugging, and regression testing.

  

* Build reliable pipelines for generating, processing, and managing simulation data.

  

* Scale simulation through automation, workload orchestration, and remote hosting, supporting both batch workloads and interactive use.

  

* Partner with scientists and technical artists to improve simulation performance, usability, and fidelity to real robot behavior (sim2real).

  
About the team  
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
  
  
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
  
  
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
  
  
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
  
  
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’d like to hear from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
* Experience developing robotics software, simulation systems, real-time applications, or scalable data pipelines.
* 2+ years of non-internship experience designing or architecting new and existing systems, including design patterns, reliability, and scaling.

* Experience with robotics simulation frameworks or real-time 3D engines, such as Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Unreal Engine, or Unity.

* Familiarity with sim2real transfer, domain randomization, or evaluating robot capabilities across varied environments.

jobs.title: Test Equipment Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Moog is a performance culture that empowers people to achieve great things. Our people enjoy solving interesting technical challenges in a culture where everyone trusts each other to do the right thing. For you, working with us can mean deeper job satisfaction, better rewards, and a great quality of life inside and outside of work.

  
  

**Job Title** :

Test Equipment Controls Engineer

**Reporting To:**

Mgr., Engineering

**Work Schedule:**

Onsite – Buffalo, NY  
  
  

Our team in Industrial Group is looking for a hands-on Test Equipment Controls Engineer to take ownership of the systems used to validate our products while driving the modernization of our testing capabilities through automation, controls, instrumentation, and software development.

  
  

As a Test Equipment Controls Engineer, you'll serve as the technical owner of production and engineering test systems, ensuring reliable operation of existing equipment while leading efforts to enhance and modernize testing capabilities.

  
  

This role combines the responsibilities of a controls engineer, automation engineer, and test systems engineer. You'll play a critical role in maintaining and improving the production and development test equipment used to support both manufacturing and new product development. If you're energized by troubleshooting complex systems, modernizing legacy equipment, developing automation solutions, and improving how products are tested, this is an opportunity to make a direct impact across Moog's Industrial Group.

  

**To be considered for Test Equipment Controls Engineer, here’s what you’ll typically bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Controls Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5+ years of experience supporting, designing, developing, or maintaining industrial test equipment, automation systems, controls systems, or complex manufacturing equipment.
* Experience programming, troubleshooting, and commissioning PLC-based control systems.
* Experience with industrial instrumentation, sensors, signal conditioning, measurement systems, and data acquisition hardware.
* Hands-on experience supporting electromechanical, hydraulic, servo-controlled, or automated systems.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
  

**It’s preferred if you bring:**

* Experience developing or supporting PC-based test software, HMI applications, or graphical user interfaces.
* Experience with National Instruments hardware and LabVIEW.
* Experience integrating PLCs, HMIs, motion control systems, instrumentation, and data acquisition platforms.
* Experience supporting manufacturing test equipment, automated test stands, or production testing environments.
* Experience modernizing legacy equipment through controls, automation, and software upgrades.
* Familiarity with servo motors, motion control, closed-loop control systems, and industrial automation technologies.
  

**As a Test Equipment Controls Engineer, you will:**

* Own the reliability, performance, configuration management, and continuous improvement of production test stands used to validate complex electromechanical, hydraulic, and motion control products.
* Troubleshoot and resolve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, instrumentation, controls, and software-related issues to minimize downtime and support manufacturing operations.
* Design, build, modify, and upgrade production and engineering test equipment, including test stands, control panels, instrumentation systems, and data acquisition hardware.
* Develop, modify, and troubleshoot PLC-based control systems, automated machine logic, and integrated test equipment controls.
* Create, maintain, and enhance operator-facing HMI and GUI applications that improve usability, efficiency, and data visibility.
* Select, install, calibrate, and maintain sensors, transducers, instrumentation, signal conditioning hardware, and measurement systems used for product testing and validation.
* Integrate PLCs, instrumentation, data acquisition systems, servo drives, motors, and other control hardware into automated test environments.
* Support engineering development, qualification, and performance testing by configuring test setups, implementing instrumentation plans, and developing test methods.
* Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions related to test equipment failures, measurement issues, and system performance concerns.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation including electrical schematics, control logic, operating procedures, calibration requirements, preventive maintenance plans, and software revision records.
* Drive modernization initiatives that improve automation, test capability, repeatability, safety, throughput, and overall equipment effectiveness through hardware and software enhancements.
* Partner closely with Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Quality, and Maintenance teams to ensure test systems effectively support both production and product development activities.
  

**How we care for you:**

----------

DUTY 1: The Principal Intelligence Analyst (PIA) will proactively lead the analytic enterprise for the assigned mission area & define the scope of the intelligence Program of Analysis (POA) for their analytical team.

**This position is contingent upon the ability to maintain/transfer active Department of War (DoW) Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI.**

WAG-AT conducts studies to identify new capabilities; matures laboratory technologies to be weapon system ready; and develops, tests, and rapidly fields new AT capabilities/products all which provide insight and foundational AT technology to seed DoD weapon system development programs. These are focused on reducing developmental risk and associated cost and schedule growth, ultimately ensuring AT architectures are developed, supporting protection of US warfighters against loss of life caused by technological exploitation of US weapons systems.

* Assess integrated circuitry, industry standard processors, and memory chips and determine methodologies for reverse engineering electronic systems and integrated circuitry
* Support ATEA FPO Education and Outreach Lead by developing engineering curriculum modules
* Work with Government and industry partners to develop and update training materials

* Review and analyze proposals for design feasibility and system compatibility
* Assess acquired capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications
* For program protection, identify technologies and evaluate system/subsystem design functions and improvements to protect Critical Program Information (CPI)

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering with a minimum of 12 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor

Additional desired experience and skills:

* Experience with Program Protection planning and implementation in weapon system programs
* Experience evaluating current fielded weapons systems to determine anti-tamper and reverse engineering susceptibility based on vendor design

You will design electrical controls systems for the oven and hot baking food processing equipment built at the Sandusky OH factory.

jobs.title: Cloud Production Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Experience organizing and prioritizing work across multiple teams in a large-scale, distributed environment and experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes in a large-scale, distributed environment.  
  
  

### **Cloud Production Platform Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Serve as subject matter expert for compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms in Meta's production data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers, anticipating and diagnosing issues for the operations teams, and escalating as appropriate to hardware design and NPI teams
* Act as the deep escalation point for cloud hardware issues, taking handoffs from the cloud triage teams and driving hardware and software investigation through to resolution
* Identify systemic hardware issues within a single cloud provider and across cloud providers, separating cloud provider specific behavior from platform behavior already characterized in Meta's own fleet
* Represent Meta's reliability, diagnosability, and serviceability expectations to cloud providers, compiling the technical evidence those conversations depend on
* Carry findings from the cloud environment back into Meta's own platform work, and apply what is already known about Meta's platforms to accelerate diagnosis in the cloud
* Provide end to end lifecycle support (operational test through end of life decommissioning) of hardware platforms and new technologies in the data centers
* Drive complex technical investigations globally and spanning multiple disciplines such as Hardware, Software/Firmware, Networking and Power & Cooling
* Analyze health of the global fleet of servers to proactively identify systemic issues, and take appropriate action to quickly mitigate impact
* Work closely with HW Engineering, Release to Production, and Systems Integration teams to take new server and storage platforms into mass production in the data centers
* Identify risks early in new hardware programs and contribute the test methods needed to characterize the product and assure end customer needs are met
* Act as product owner for specific server and/or storage platforms. Perform and drive RCA and CA, in collaboration with hardware and software engineering teams
* Issue timely alerts and fixes to operations teams, and assure a robust feedback pipeline to engineering teams
* Build strong relationships and collaboration with engineering and cross functional teams across the company. Actively solicit feedback from teams, and use that feedback to improve operational effectiveness as infrastructure scales
* Provide serviceability feedback on production hardware resulting in more efficient repair activities

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* BS or BA in electrical, mechanical, or computer engineering, or equivalent hardware-engineering-related experience
* 10+ years of experience with server hardware systems in an internet operations environment, or on a development team in design or test validation
* Experience triaging and debugging hardware platforms
* Familiarity or experience in NPI server platform development
* Familiarity with Linux or Unix Operating systems
* Experience training and mentoring technicians and/or engineers

ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™
  
  
​​ASRC Federal Advanced Research LLC (AFAR)​ is seeking an ​Electrical Engineer​ to join our ​Air-to-Ground Communications (AG COMM)​ team that supports the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). This is a ​full-time​ ​on-site​ position at the ​Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC)​ in ​Oklahoma City, OK​.
  
  
​​The AG COMM program comprises the infrastructure, facilities, and protocols that allow air traffic controllers to communicate via voice and data with pilots in flight.​
  
  
Citizenship/Permanent Residency Requirement
  
  
All candidates must have the following to pass the Federal Background Investigation and obtain the FAA Public Trust security clearance.
  

* Be a US Citizen.
* Has resided in the US for three (3) consecutive years.
* RealID Driver’s License/ID or current US Passport.

Relocation Requirement
  
  
Candidate must reside or be willing to relocate within a commutable distance to the ​Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC)​ in ​Oklahoma City, OK​.
  
  
Education & Experience Requirement

jobs.description:
**Hyve Company Overview**
-------------------------

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

  
  

**Job Description**

Platform management firmware is essential to the reliability, serviceability, and manageability of hyperscale AI servers. This Senior role owns BMC firmware architecture and development—built on OpenBMC—for Hyve's next-generation AI and compute server platforms, spanning manageability, telemetry, power/thermal control, security, and manufacturing enablement in close partnership with hardware and Hyperscaler customers.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* **BMC firmware architecture.** Define and own the OpenBMC-based firmware architecture for AI/GPU server platforms, including manageability stack, Redfish interfaces, IPMI, and platform telemetry.
* **Platform control and monitoring.** Develop and integrate power, thermal, fan-control, and sensor monitoring firmware in close collaboration with power delivery and thermal teams.
* **Security and reliability.** Implement secure boot, firmware update/recovery, RoT integration, and robust error handling to meet hyperscaler security and reliability requirements.
* **Bring-up and debug.** Lead firmware bring-up across EVT/DVT/PVT, debug at board and system level, and drive root-cause analysis and permanent fixes across firmware, hardware, and system-integration domains.
* **Manufacturing and deployment enablement.** Deliver firmware tooling and features for factory provisioning, diagnostics, and fleet deployment, and support field issue resolution at scale.
* **Technical leadership.** Set firmware development methodology, review code, and mentor engineers; represent firmware architecture to customers and internal executives.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
------------------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 10+ years of embedded/firmware development experience, including significant BMC/platform management firmware work and hands-on OpenBMC development. Proven delivery of server-class firmware into production; hyperscale experience preferred.
* **Technical expertise:** Strong C/C++ and embedded Linux skills; deep knowledge of OpenBMC, Redfish, IPMI, I2C/I3C, PMBus, SPI, and platform management interfaces; experience with secure boot, firmware update, and RoT.
* **Systems knowledge:** Solid understanding of server hardware, power/thermal control loops, and the interaction of firmware with BIOS, hardware, and manufacturing flows.
* **Communication:** Able to lead cross-functional debug, drive architecture decisions, and communicate effectively with hardware teams, customers, and executives.

Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. **Electrical Engineer I – Manufacturing & Test**

**Reading Thermal Systems (RTS) | Reading Bakery Systems**

Put your electrical engineering knowledge to work on instruments that measure temperature, heat flux, air velocity, and humidity.

RTS is seeking an Electrical Engineer I – Manufacturing & Test to support the manufacture, testing, calibration, and improvement of thermal measurement products, including the SCORPION® data logging system. You’ll work alongside experienced engineering and manufacturing personnel, gain hands-on experience with sensors and electronics, and help ensure products meet established quality and performance requirements.

This early-career opportunity is suited to an electrical engineering graduate who enjoys hands-on testing, troubleshooting, and practical problem-solving.

**What You’ll Do**

Your primary responsibilities will be:

* **Outgoing quality assurance — approximately 50%:** Test finished products before shipment, document findings, and verify compliance with established procedures.
* **Calibration support — approximately 25%:** Calibrate customer data loggers and sensors returned for service.

The remaining 25% of your role will include:

* Investigating production issues and troubleshooting circuitry, components, firmware, and measurement systems with guidance from experienced engineering staff.
* Creating and updating test specifications, work instructions, manufacturing records, and training materials.
* Helping develop, build, and validate production test systems, fixtures, and calibration procedures.
* Conducting engineering tests and analyzing product accuracy, reliability, and performance.
* Supporting the transition of prototypes into repeatable manufacturing processes.
* Assisting with component substitutions and engineering changes.
* Reviewing production and field data to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Supporting product assembly, repair, and manufacturing activities as needed.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Foundational knowledge of circuits, printed circuit boards, microprocessors, C programming, and CAD.
* Hands-on testing and troubleshooting experience from coursework, laboratory work, projects, internships, or employment.
* Familiarity with hardware and software interfaces used in test equipment or measurement systems.
* Interest in sensors, instrumentation, physics, and thermal measurement.
* Ability to interpret schematics, engineering drawings, and technical instructions.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to handle small components and perform fine-pitch soldering and rework.
* A willingness to learn, follow established procedures, and work collaboratively.

Experience with calibration, embedded firmware, data acquisition, thermal systems, or production fixtures is a plus.

**Work Requirements**

This position may require overnight domestic travel and occasional international travel. Responsibilities include regularly lifting or moving up to 10 pounds and occasionally up to 50 pounds. Work may involve production baking environments with high temperatures, humidity, noise, and other manufacturing hazards. Appropriate personal protective equipment is required.

**Who we are:**

Johnson Controls is global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. Our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places, and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. * On-the-job/cross-training opportunities
* Encouraging and collaborative team environment
* Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

**What you will do**:

This role combines engineering design, controls programming, project execution, and hands-on support of manufacturing equipment. The Automation Engineer will help define equipment requirements, develop technical specifications, manage automation projects, and support the successful startup and operation of manufacturing systems.

**How you will do it**:

* Work with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, and Engineering teams to identify manufacturing challenges and develop automation solutions that improve safety, quality, productivity, and equipment reliability.

* Analyze equipment performance, downtime trends, capacity constraints, and process bottlenecks to identify opportunities for improvement.

* Create and maintain engineering documentation including control narratives, software backups, operating procedures, equipment standards, and project records.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives through equipment upgrades, process improvements, cycle time reduction, labor optimization, quality improvements, and waste reduction.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to technicians, maintenance personnel, and engineers during equipment design, installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities.
* Ensure all automation systems and equipment comply with company safety standards, applicable codes, industry best practices, and established engineering principles.

**Requirements**:

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, with 3+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting automation systems in a manufacturing environment.
* Hands-on experience with industrial automation technologies including PLCs, HMIs, robotics, machine vision systems, industrial networks, and integrated manufacturing equipment.
* Strong technical aptitude including automation system design, controls programming, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and the ability to interpret electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and technical documentation.
* Experience leading automation or capital projects, including development of equipment specifications, supplier management, project execution, commissioning, and startup activities.

**Electronics Engineer – Embedded Systems and Product Development**

Lynntech is seeking an electronics engineer to support the development of electrical and embedded systems for prototype products in the defense, aerospace, and medical markets. A successful candidate will have the opportunity to work across the product development lifecycle, from early-stage technology proof-of-concept through prototype development and testing to qualification of production-ready designs. The engineer will contribute to multi-faceted electrical solutions through embedded firmware/software development, custom circuit board design, and integration of custom and commercial components.

The engineer will execute technical work as part of multidisciplinary project teams and will have opportunities to develop leadership skills through increasing technical responsibility, collaboration with customers and teammates, and participation in proposal development.

**Job Description**

At Lynntech, engineering is both theoretical and experimental. Our engineers split their time between developing detailed prototype designs and validating those designs in the lab. Engineering projects involve a wide variety of technologies at different stages in the product life cycle, from breadboard proof-of-concepts to minimum viable products. Our electronics engineers are commonly engaged in the following technical activities:

* Designing electrical system architecture and integrating custom electronics with commercial off-the-shelf components, such as power supplies, motor drivers, sensors, actuators, communication devices, connectors, and industrial control hardware.
* Developing system wiring diagrams, cable and wire-harness designs, interface-control documentation, and power management architecture
* Designing and modeling of schematics for both analog and digital circuits
* Designing and testing custom printed circuit boards for analog and digital applications
* Creating custom firmware implementations on a variety of platforms for implementation into advanced test fixtures, prototype designs, and marketable products
* Maturing prototype electrical systems into reproducible and supportable product designs through component derating, tolerance analysis, design-for-manufacture and design-for-test practices, environmental considerations, and verification against system requirements

The engineer will also participate in activities that support technology advancement and transition:

* Working with project leads, customers, end users, business-development personnel, and manufacturing partners to translate operational needs into technical requirements
* Collaborating with scientists and engineers to support grant proposals for the exploration and application of new technologies and the continued development of core technologies
* Participating in early-stage project research and contributing to the development of system requirements, architecture, and interfaces for envisioned prototypes
* Contributing to and executing test plans to evaluate prototype performance against system requirements
* Designing and fabricating test fixtures to support evaluation of prototypes, from breadboard systems to minimum viable products
* Participating in system design verification and validation activities
* Contributing to technical writing efforts for customer reports and project documentation

* Strong technical writing, speaking, and presentation skills

The Georgia Tech Research Institute (GTRI) is the nonprofit, applied research division of the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech). GTRI's renowned researchers combine science, engineering, economics, policy, and technical expertise to solve complex problems for the U.S. federal government, state, and industry.

### **Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

1. Students are our top priority.
  
2. We strive for excellence.
  
3. We thrive on diversity.
  
4. We celebrate collaboration.
  
5. We champion innovation.
  
6. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.
  
7. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.
  
8. We act ethically.
  
9. We are responsible stewards.

Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.

### **Project/Unit Description**

The Electronic Systems Laboratory (ELSYS) Applied Embedded Systems (AES) Division is currently seeking a Test Engineer for the Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO) Platform & Training Branch (EPTB). EPTB provides engineering and technical support for EMSO platforms to include the new United States Air Force (USAF) EA-37B Compass Call platform.
  
EPTB engineers also provide advanced and tailored Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) and EMSO education and training courses to U.S. Military personnel, Government civilians, and U.S. Foreign Military Sales (FMS) partner nations. In addition to training products, EPTB also performs assessments and direct support to Department of War (DoW) elements involved in EMSO. This opportunity within EPTB will provide direct support to the 654th Aeronautical Systems Squadron (654 AESS) on site in Waco, TX. This position will utilize their background in test engineering and EW to execute test and evaluation of the EA-37B Compass Call platform across the Baseline 3 block cycles and future baselines.

### **Job Purpose**

Test Engineers do the research, planning, development, and documentation of System Test activities including development of test cases, procedures, plans, and reports for sponsor research and development programs. This person should have experience working with complex systems and be strong in documentation as well.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Guide team toward a test-driven development mode of execution

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in C++, Java Script, and Python development, coupled with experience in robotics. This full-stack role involves developing robust frontend and backend software for virtual simulation.

This is an on-site position located in San Antonio, TX.

U.S. citizenship is required. Candidates selected may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

* Architect, develop, and maintain backend systems using C++, Python, ROS/ROS2, and containerized deployment environments (Docker).
* Implement scalable and maintainable build and CI/CD workflows using Git and automated pipelines.
* Develop front-end user interfaces and tools using JavaScript, Java-based GUI frameworks, REST APIs, and cloud-based technologies.

* Collaborate with autonomy and systems engineers to integrate perception, navigation, and control capabilities.
* Perform code reviews, mentor junior developers, and contribute to software engineering best practices.
* Troubleshoot and optimize software performance across distributed systems and heterogeneous hardware environments.
* Build and deploy containerized applications using Docker in development and production environments.

**Principal robotics engineer requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 12+ years of experience. Advanced degree may serve in partial fulfillment of the experience requirement.
  + Expert-level proficiency in C++, Python, and JavaScript for backend and frontend systems development.
  + Demonstrated experience with robotics software stacks including ROS/ROS2, simulation environments, and sensor or autonomy integration.
  + Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and distributed system architectures.
  + Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across complex software and hardware environments.

**Preferred experience:**

* Azure cloud services and cloud-native application development.
* Jira and Confluence for project tracking, documentation, and Agile workflow management.
* Experience building software for scalability, modularity, and long-term maintainability.
* Knowledge of physics‑based modeling, environmental simulation, or digital twin concepts.

ARA is an employee-owned international research and engineering company recognized for providing technically superior solutions to complex and challenging problems in the physical sciences. jobs.description:
**About Atmosphere TV**

Atmosphere is the leading streaming TV platform built specifically for businesses. Unlike ad networks or signage companies, Atmosphere is the only true TV company whose first priority is to entertain television audiences outside of the home. Our content is designed to be fun, engaging, and worth watching, transforming gyms, bars, airports, and restaurants into better experiences for customers and better businesses for owners.

We are the first and only company to think about both the business owner and their customers when creating TV content. With 55,000+ venues and a global audience of over 160 million monthly viewers, Atmosphere is redefining what TV means outside the living room.

**About the role**

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to champion our platform engineering initiatives and own the foundation our engineering teams build on: the infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and observability tooling behind a streaming platform serving 60,000+ businesses and over 150 million monthly viewers. You're a software engineer first. You understand how applications are built, how services talk to each other, and how the different parts of a system depend on one another. You also care about how software gets built, shipped, and run, and you want to own it. You'll partner closely with every engineering team, and your impact will show up in how quickly and confidently they're able to ship. AI is central to how you'll work: you'll use it heavily to execute platform initiatives and move faster than a platform team twice the size.

*This position will report to the VP, Engineering, and is on-site in Austin, TX! Availability to be in-office 4-5 days a week is required.*

**What you'll do**

* Use AI as a core part of how you plan, build, and ship.
* Be motivated, naturally curious, and enjoy solving new problems alongside other engineers.
* Build the tooling that makes AI effective for every other engineer.
* Own our infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD: module design and standards, keeping declared state and reality converged, and a fast, reliable path from commit to production.
* Define observability and resilience patterns across the org: every service measurable, debuggable, and alertable by default, safe deploy patterns, and incident response focused on root-cause fixes.
* Lead upgrades of datastores, runtimes, frameworks, and SDKs ahead of end-of-life deadlines, including the application-code changes they require, and automate away recurring toil like dependency upgrades and environment provisioning.
* Drive security remediation: triage cloud security findings, harden identity and network configuration, and close authentication gaps.
* Champion simplification by decommissioning unused infrastructure, deleting dead code, and keeping our footprint (and cloud bill) no larger than it needs to be.
* Work cross-functionally to prioritize infrastructure investments by impact.

**Job Category:** Engineering

**Location:** Houston, TX, United States

Join a company that is passionately committed to the pursuit of a better world through positive change. With more than 70 years of business and technical expertise in mining, energy, and infrastructure, our 10,000 colleagues in 150 countries tirelessly work toward bettering the industries in which we operate. With practical solutions that are safe, innovative and sustainable, we think globally while acting locally.

Hatch is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to join our electrical team in Houston, TX. The Senior Electrical Engineer is responsible for preparing engineering calculations, technical specifications, data sheets and reports. The Senior Electrical Engineer is also responsible for assistance/participation in on-site commissioning.

**Responsibilities include:**

* Prepare a list of engineering deliverables and time-based functions to facilitate the planning and control of the engineering budget
* Maintain the project scope of work documentation and revisions as required during the design evolution

* Promote and maintain the application of ethical and professional practices in the execution of electrical engineering work

We're building the future of UAS capabilities, and we're looking for exceptional talent to join us. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on next-generation flight systems, you belong here.

We are seeking a highly motivated Electrical Engineer III/IV to join our team. **Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop and test electrical systems and components for UAS platforms
* Develop and debug microcontroller systems and circuits
* Work with mechanical and software engineers to integrate electrical systems into UAS platforms
* Develop and maintain schematics, wiring diagrams, and documentation for electrical systems in UAS platforms
* Act as the Avionics liaison between engineering and the production line.
* Address and close out non-conformances from the production line.
* Develop and perform electrical tests and test procedures to verify system functionality

**Qualifications:**

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or a related field and 5+ years of experience
* Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting circuits in UAS platforms
* Proficiency in Altium for circuit board / harness design
* Knowledge of analog and digital circuits, power supplies, and CAN bus communication
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work well in a team environment

Expected outcomes:

* 3 Months: Work on existing UAS electrical systems projects, learning our development processes and systems. Participate in cross-functional teams to integrate electrical systems into UAS platforms.
* 6 Months: Take on more responsibility, including leading small electrical systems projects and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Take over responsibility for closing out avionics NCRs from the production line.
* 12 Months: Take over full responsibility as the liaison between the avionics design engineering team and the production line.

SLO: Level III - $131,000 - $161,000; Level IV - $160,000 - $200,000

**Job Description**

Vermont State University invites applications for **full-time, tenure-track faculty positions in Electrical Engineering Technology** . The University is currently seeking candidates for positions beginning in **Spring 2027** and anticipates hiring multiple faculty members as programmatic needs, enrollment, and course offerings evolve. The successful candidates will join the Department of Engineering and contribute to the delivery and continued development of applied, career-focused engineering technology programs.

  

The position is based at the University's Randolph Center and Williston campuses, home to longstanding engineering technology programs with a strong tradition of hands-on laboratory education, close connections with industry, and preparation of graduates for professional engineering and technical careers.

  

We seek enthusiastic educators who value applied learning and are committed to helping students develop strong technical, analytical, laboratory, design, and professional skills. Faculty will teach undergraduate courses in electrical and electronics engineering technology, participate in curriculum and laboratory development, advise and mentor students, contribute to program assessment and accreditation activities, and engage with industry and the broader University community.

  

**Hiring will occur based on evolving programmatic priorities, enrollment, and instructional needs.** Applicants may be considered for current or anticipated openings within the Electrical Engineering Technology program.

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

The successful candidate will be expected to:

* Teach undergraduate lecture and laboratory courses in Electrical Engineering Technology and related engineering areas.
* Teach courses that may include electric circuits, electronics, digital systems, instrumentation and measurement, electrical machines, industrial controls, programmable logic controllers, embedded systems, microcontrollers, renewable energy systems, communications, and related topics depending on the candidate's expertise and program needs.
* Develop and maintain engaging laboratory experiences emphasizing practical application, experimentation, troubleshooting, design, and modern engineering tools.
* Advise and mentor students regarding academic progress, career pathways, internships, and professional opportunities.
* Participate in curriculum development and continuous improvement of engineering technology programs.
* Contribute to student learning assessment and program accreditation activities, including work associated with ABET accreditation.
* Participate in departmental, school, and university service.
* Build and maintain connections with employers, industry partners, professional organizations, and other external stakeholders.
* Support student recruitment, retention, and outreach activities.
Engage in appropriate professional development, scholarly activity, applied research, consulting, industry collaboration, or other forms of professional practice consistent with the University's mission and expectations for tenure and promotion.  

  

**Required Qualifications**

Applicants must have:

* A master's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field by the time of appointment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of electrical and electronic systems and the ability to teach undergraduate engineering technology courses and laboratories.
* A commitment to applied, hands-on education and student-centered teaching.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
The ability to work effectively with students, faculty, staff, industry partners, and other stakeholders.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Preference may be given to candidates with one or more of the following:

* Professional experience in electrical engineering, electronics, manufacturing, automation, controls, energy systems, embedded systems, or a related technical field.
* College-level teaching experience, particularly in engineering or engineering technology.
* Experience developing and teaching laboratory-based courses.
* Knowledge of industrial automation, programmable logic controllers, electrical machines, power systems, renewable energy, embedded systems, instrumentation, or related emerging technologies.
* Experience with industry-standard engineering software, instrumentation, data acquisition systems, or electrical/electronic test equipment.
* Experience with ABET-accredited programs, outcomes assessment, or continuous program improvement.
* A Professional Engineer license or other relevant professional certification.
* Experience working collaboratively with industry and supporting internships, applied projects, undergraduate research, or capstone design experiences.
A demonstrated commitment to supporting students from a wide range of educational and professional backgrounds.  

  

**About the Department and Programs**

The Department of Engineering at Vermont State University provides career-focused education emphasizing the integration of engineering theory with extensive laboratory, design, and project-based experiences. Students work directly with modern equipment, software, instrumentation, and manufacturing technologies and benefit from strong connections with Vermont and regional employers.

  

The University's engineering technology programs prepare graduates for careers in engineering, advanced manufacturing, automation, energy, electronics, product development, and other technical industries. Faculty members have opportunities to contribute directly to curriculum development, laboratory modernization, industry partnerships, applied research, and the continued evolution of engineering education at Vermont State University.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description:
**Company Information:**  
Twenty-Six Defense, headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, is a leading provider of high-performance products, system solutions, and aftermarket support services focusing on the defense, homeland security, and commercial aviation markets. With facilities throughout the U.S., Twenty-Six Defense supports those who contribute to the national security of the United States. Twenty-Six Defense is wholly owned by Elbit Systems Ltd. (NASDAQ: ESLT and TASE: ESLT), a global high-technology company engaged in a wide range of programs for innovative defense and commercial applications.
  
Fueled by more than 800 talented employees and a proud 65-year legacy of night vision production excellence, Twenty-Six Defense’s Warfighter Systems business is rooted in the heart of Virginia’s Roanoke Valley. Surrounded by the scenic beauty of the Blue Ridge Mountains, you’ll find a unique blend of southern hospitality, outdoor adventure, and the energy of a thriving city – all alongside a purpose you can be proud of coming to work each day.
  
As a world leader in low-light sensor technology, the Warfighter Systems team is engineering the future of image intensifiers and night vision goggle systems as we enter a new era of the networked battlespace. Trusted by the U.S. and nearly 100 allied countries, our technology supports those in harm’s way during the most critical moments, with one goal in mind: bring them home safely.
  
The work our employees perform each day plays a direct role in national security, and our shared purpose is what truly makes Warfighter Systems so extraordinary. Join our collaborative team, where each voice is valued, and you can thrive, develop, and make a real impact!
  
  
Job Summary
  
The Software Automations Engineer works with a team of automation engineers and process engineers to translate process control concepts into machinery, support and modify software interfacing with hardware on existing equipment, and design new program controlled processes to meet manufacturing requirements. Basic electronics knowledge and familiarity with industrial protocols and interface techniques are applied to the developed programming solutions.
  
This role participates in the full software development life cycle, including specification, design, programming, implementation, integration, commissioning, and debugging. The position offers opportunities to apply program design to robotics, electronics, machine vision, analog and digital signal applications, data systems, and mechatronics.
  
Software development experience should include proficiency in various computer languages to address programming objectives related to automated process control, test/measurement, and data integration. Programs are created to connect construction and testing processes to test equipment, data collection systems, analog and digital control points, machine vision systems, motion control, and other specialized peripherals.
  
Responsibilities
  
The Software Automations Engineer collaborates with technicians and engineers across multiple departments to:
  

* Document project requests to create statements of work, use cases, and related documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve system quality, efficiency, and robustness.
* Write clean, well tested code with effective error handling.
* Create test plans and ensure quality using industry best practices such as unit and regression testing.
* Develop proofs of concept for new and innovative solutions.
* Enable data movement between equipment and databases.
* Break down large, complex technical projects into defined stages and deliverables.
* Work across multiple software and hardware platforms.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science (BSCS), Computer Engineering (BSCE), Electrical Engineering (BSEE), or a major in computer programming/engineering with a minor in electrical engineering.
* Proficiency with Visual Studio, SQL Server, MS Office, and Windows.
* Experience with relational databases and SQL.
* Ability to produce and maintain high quality, tested, and efficient code following industry standards.
* Strong understanding of design patterns, multithreading, and distributed systems.
* Experience in object oriented analysis and design using common design patterns.
* Practical understanding and motivation to apply software programming skills to control electronic components and interfaced systems.
* Knowledge of industrial networking.
* Versatile programming skills.
* Strong troubleshooting and investigative skills for equipment, process, and data modifications.
* Experience with source code version control systems such as GIT, TFS, SourceSafe, Subversion, etc.
* Ability to obtain a security clearance is required.

**Here Are Some of the Great Benefits We Offer:**  

* Most locations offer a 9/80 schedule, providing every other Friday off
* Competitive compensation & 401(k) program to plan for your future
* Robust medical, dental, vision, & disability coverage with qualified wellness discounts
* Basic Life Insurance and Additional Life & AD&D Insurances are available
* Flexible Vacation & PTO
* Paid Parental Leave
* Generous Employee Referral Program
* Voluntary Benefits Available: Longer Term Care, Legal, Identity Theft, Pet Insurance, and more
* Voluntary Tricare Supplement available for military retirees

Why Roanoke, Virginia?
  

* Lower cost of living
* Family-friendly area
* Career and economic growth
* Scenic beauty
* Outdoor enthusiast’s dream

jobs.title: Hardware Electrical Engineer – Space Systems (U.S. Citizen or Perm. Resident required)
jobs.description:
**Hardware Electrical Engineer – Space Systems (U.S. Citizen or Perm. Res. required)**

*Location:* Onsite in Sterling, VA

*Duration:*  12 months to 3 years with potential for extension(s)

\*\*\* ITAR required so must be U.S. Citizen, National, or Green Card Holder

**Position Summary**

The Hardware (Compute) Electrical Engineer will support digital electronics for a space-computing system built around processors, supporting devices, memory and complementary circuit cards. The role covers the full hardware lifecycle, but the immediate need is weighted toward analyzing and documenting existing designs, making controlled revisions, supporting production readiness, and debugging hardware. Design may represent only 10-15% of the near-term work; the engineer must be equally comfortable proving why the design works, documenting it and helping it succeed in test and production.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience with **digital or mixed-signal hardware, processors, memory devices, embedded compute platforms or related circuit-card assemblies**.
* Experience **reading and revising schematics using Cadence/OrCAD/Allegro, Altium or similar professional ECAD tools**.
* Experience performing or reviewing **electrical analysis such as part-stress, worst-case, reliability, FMECA or signal-integrity analysis**.
* Hands-on **board bring-up, benchtop test** **and root-cause debugging experience**.
* Ability to write and execute **test procedure**s and produce configuration-controlled engineering documentation.
* Strong fundamentals, positive and collaborative attitude, and ability to describe technical work with appropriate depth even when prior programs were classified.
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Approximately 4+ years of relevant electrical hardware experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand, maintain and revise processor-, memory- and digital-interface circuit-card designs for space and defense applications.
* Perform or support part-stress, worst-case, reliability and other circuit analyses that substantiate the design.
* Support radiation analysis and radiation-mitigation activities; prior radiation-effects experience is a major advantage, but the team can teach the domain.
* Read existing schematics, select components, make controlled CAD changes and re-release drawings and design packages.
* Support high-speed digital interfaces, including Ethernet and related waveform/signal-integrity considerations where applicable.
* Develop and execute hardware test procedures; use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and other laboratory equipment to diagnose failures.
* Write short Python scripts to communicate with hardware, automate tests and exercise functions such as memory testing.
* Use Linux to understand, bring up and troubleshoot the computing system and its hardware/software interfaces.
* Create and maintain requirements, drawings, bills of material, test procedures, analysis reports and production documentation.
* Collaborate closely with FPGA, embedded software, firmware, mechanical, RF, systems, test and program personnel.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Space, aerospace, defense or other high-reliability electronics experience.
* Radiation-effects analysis or design for radiation environments; candidates with this background should receive priority consideration.
* Python scripting for instrument control, test automation or hardware diagnostics.
* Linux experience for system bring-up and troubleshooting.
* High-speed digital design, Ethernet, memory interfaces, signal integrity, HDI PCB/PCA development or controlled-impedance design.
* Experience helping establish or improve a production line for complex electronics.

**Ideal Candidate:**  
Digital hardware EE with **4–8 years of experience** working with **processors, memory, embedded compute, and circuit-card hardware**. Strong at schematic/design work, engineering analysis, board bring-up/debug, and documentation, with enough **Python/Linux** knowledge to interact with and troubleshoot the compute platform.

*About H10*

H10 is an engineering services and consulting firm with a nationwide presence. Our teams support clients across mechanical and hardware engineering, software and application development, data and analytics, and project and program management.

*Salary & Benefits*

The salary range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including by not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate. *Salary Range:* $140,000- $180,000 annually

H10 provides eligible employees (those who are scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week) with a range of benefits including medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, PTO, and a 401k plan.

*Physical Demands*

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data.
* Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.
* Above demands are carried out within the local existing Health and Safety guidelines.

*Notes*

* This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

If forging a secure future excites you, look no further! **Northrop Grumman’s Space Sector** provides an arena where your passion for innovation and quest for exploration are welcome. As an ***Embedded Software Engineer – Level 1/ 2,*** your role at **Dulles, VA,** will be pivotal in supporting mission-critical efforts to national and global security.

Ready to join forces with our visionary team?

This Embedded Software Engineer will join our team of qualified, diverse individuals in the Space Systems organization, developing space flight software platforms for National Space Security programs. The individual we seek will be self-motivated, proactive, and goal-oriented.

This position will work a 9/80 schedule, with every other Friday off. **This position is 100% onsite and cannot accommodate telecommute work.**

* Work with other disciplines to establish Flight-Software requirements, testing, and verification plan.

* Work with multiple engineers to integrate spacecraft components and flight software with the simulation platform.
* Be involved in the hardware definition and software design, development, debug and integration on simulation and hardware-in-the-loop platforms.
* Analyze system resources to enhance efficiency, stability, and processing speed.
* Prepare design documentation, analysis, test results and presentation materials for internal and external customers.
* Work with software developers and other engineers, as needed, to help diagnose and identify the root cause of problems found during software installation, integration, acceptance test, and operational events.
* Work in an innovative environment across diverse assignments and in collaborative team settings across all levels.
* Other duties as assigned.

*This position is contingent upon the candidate obtaining final clearances and program access(es) within a reasonable period of time as determined by the company.*

**Basic Qualifications for** **Level 1**:

* Bachelor’s degree in **STEM** (Aerospace/Electrical/Computer/Software Engineering) with **0 years** of relevant professional experience – OR – Master’s degree
* *US citizenship required*
* Advanced programming proficiency with C/C++, Python.
* Understanding of common embedded system tools, real-time operating systems, and avionics integration and test practices
* Core affinity and parallel processing experience
* Experience with understanding the difference between concurrent and parallel processing
* Demonstrable programming experience on Linux
* GPA of 3.0 or above

**Basic Qualifications for** **Level 2**:

* Bachelor’s degree in **STEM** (Aerospace/Electrical/Computer/Software Engineering) with **2 years** of relevant professional experience – OR – Master’s degree
* *US citizenship required*
* Advanced programming proficiency with C/C++, Python.
* Understanding of common embedded system tools, real-time operating systems, and avionics integration and test practices
* Core affinity and parallel processing experience
* Experience with understanding the difference between concurrent and parallel processing
* Demonstrable programming experience on Linux
* GPA of 3.0 or above

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Top-Secret** / **SCI**
* System knowledge in one or more of the following domains: Spacecraft Command & Control, Mission Planning, Space Situational Awareness, and Visualization
* Experience with Digital, Analog, RS-422 synchronous serial and UART, MIL-STD-1553, SpaceWire electrical interfaces
* GPA of 3.5 or above
