jobs.title: Controls Engineer - NPI
jobs.description:
By living according to a common set of values, we create a culture that unifies, embraces the uniqueness we all bring to the company, and positions Integer for long-term success.

At Integer, our values are embedded in everything we do.

**Customer**

We focus on our customers’ success

**Innovation**

We create better solutions

**Collaboration**

We create success together

**Inclusion**

We always interact with others respectfully

**Candor**

We are open and honest with one another

**Integrity**

We do the right things and do things right

**Who are we?**
===============

Integer is a global organization providing innovative, high-quality technologies and manufacturing to Medical Device OEM’s (original equipment manufacturers) to enhance the lives of patients worldwide and a provider of high-end niche batteries for specialized applications in the energy, military, and environmental markets. We are guided by our six Values, including focus on Customers, Innovation, Collaboration, Inclusion, Candor, and Integrity. Working at Integer means you are part of a team passionately pursuing excellence in all that we do and always reaching for the next great achievement.

**What you’ll do in this role:**
================================

***The primary purpose of this position is to perform work which involves general engineering methods and tools; but you may also utilize more advanced technologies and engineering concepts while you are developing in your role as an engineer in the medical device industry. In this role, you will ensure that Integer’s internal and external customer expectations are met or exceeded*** ***with occasional direction, instruction and guidance from more experienced engineers and managers in your organization.***

* You adhere to Integer’s Values and all safety, environmental, security and quality requirements including, but not limited to: Quality Management Systems (QMS), Safety, Environmental and Security Management Systems, U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, company policies and operating procedures, and other regulatory requirements.
* You will generally work independently with occasional guidance from supervisors or mentors to evaluate, select and apply standard engineering techniques, procedures, and criteria, using judgment in making minor adaptations and modifications to existing specifications, procedures, and work instructions.
* You will review procedures and plans prior to implementation as well as evaluate existing products, processes and materials for failure analysis and potential improvements.
* You will participate in projects that require you to investigate, develop, document and implement new product and process technologies of moderate complexity and scope.
* While often you may be responding to situations presented to you by others, you will also be able to demonstrate proactive insight into technical challenges and mitigates potential issues or incorporates improvements.
* You will plan, schedule and execute the engineering work in a part of a major project; or you may lead a smaller scope project.
* You will perform work on technical projects where you will follow Integer’s standard quality management and production system methodologies to investigate opportunities for product and process improvements.
* You will apply standard data analysis practices and techniques to establish root cause for product and process failures or to support the justification for improvements to products and processes.
* You will be required to observe products and processes to recognize discrepancies in results and follow operations throughout a series of detailed steps or processes to establish root cause of the discrepancies.
* You are expected to collaborate with others in the exchange of information, ask questions and regularly check for understanding in support of your development as an engineer.
* You embed Quality within the Engineering discipline – “I own Quality.” You are a standard bearer for Quality in everything we do at Integer, by assuring adherence to our Quality Management System (QMS), facilitating and/or contributing to corrective and preventive actions, and contributing to the successful attainment of our quality KPI’s and journey to 5 Sigma.
* You may perform other duties as needed and as directed by your line of supervision.

***Provide support of Integer’s Manufacturing Excellence and Market Focused Innovation Strategies***

* You champion the development of and deployment of the systems and tools to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
* You embrace the Manufacturing Excellence culture based on the Integer Production System and its five focus areas:

  + **Strategy Alignment** through Site Hoshin Plans, the regular cadence of Sales, Inventory, and Operations’ Planning (SiOP) meetings, and regular updates to the value stream maps.
  + **Leadership of Sustained Change** by ensuring production monitoring & improvement activities and deployment of Leader Standard Work.
  + **Standardization** through workplace organization & visual controls (5S), Manufacturing Standard Work, and robust training & certification programs.
  + **Associate Engagement** promoted through the adoption of standardized problem solving. methodologies, behavior-based safety programs, and improvement idea and suggestion systems.
  + **Systems & Process Optimization** through adoption of principles of built in quality, optimized scheduling & material system designs, work cell design, and total productive maintenance.

**How you** **will be measured:**
=================================

jobs.title: Cloud Production Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Experience organizing and prioritizing work across multiple teams in a large-scale, distributed environment and experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes in a large-scale, distributed environment.  
  
  

### **Cloud Production Platform Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Serve as subject matter expert for compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms in Meta's production data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers, anticipating and diagnosing issues for the operations teams, and escalating as appropriate to hardware design and NPI teams
* Act as the deep escalation point for cloud hardware issues, taking handoffs from the cloud triage teams and driving hardware and software investigation through to resolution
* Identify systemic hardware issues within a single cloud provider and across cloud providers, separating cloud provider specific behavior from platform behavior already characterized in Meta's own fleet
* Represent Meta's reliability, diagnosability, and serviceability expectations to cloud providers, compiling the technical evidence those conversations depend on
* Carry findings from the cloud environment back into Meta's own platform work, and apply what is already known about Meta's platforms to accelerate diagnosis in the cloud

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

As a **Senior Software Engineer** on the **Software Defined Network (SDN) and Network Observability Team** , you will design and develop the software systems that manage, route, and monitor Blue Origin's dynamic satellite network in real time. You will build distributed services that enable network planning, orchestration, telemetry processing, and observability across thousands of user terminals, satellites, and terrestrial infrastructure. Working closely with spacecraft, user, and ground systems engineers, you'll help build resilient software that keeps the constellation operating reliably under constantly changing orbital conditions.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Design and develop highly available, low-latency distributed services supporting network orchestration, telemetry collection, and control plane operations across the TeraWave constellation.
* Build software that plans, disseminates, and coordinates state across terrestrial infrastructure, orbital assets, and users while maintaining reliability and consistency under dynamic network conditions.
* Develop scalable data pipelines capable of ingesting and processing high-volume telemetry streams to improve network visibility and operational responsiveness.
* Design efficient data models and storage solutions using relational, NoSQL, search, and streaming technologies to support real-time operational workflows.
* Build APIs and services that enable reliable communication between network planning, control, and execution components.
* Collaborate with spacecraft, RF, networking, and ground systems engineers to integrate software across the broader TeraWave platform.
* Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks in large-scale distributed systems with a focus on latency, throughput, and operational reliability.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, ML Training Performance
jobs.description:
Zoox is on a mission to reimagine transportation and build ground-up autonomous robotaxis that are safe, reliable, clean, and enjoyable for everyone. We’re still early in deploying on public roads, so this is a great time to join and have a significant impact. The ML Platform team enables innovation in large-scale Foundation models, VLMs, and VLAs to make autonomous driving as seamless as possible.

**The Opportunity**  
Are you excited to own ML training performance at Zoox and make the models that power autonomous driving train faster, cheaper, and at greater scale? You’ll set technical direction for distributed training, parallelism strategies, mixed-precision training, and RL on SOTA accelerators, especially for multi-modal VLA and VLM models. You’ll partner with all Autonomy teams (Perception, Prediction, Planner, Simulation, Collision Avoidance) and act as a force multiplier for our internal customers, while mentoring engineers and shaping the team’s roadmap as we expand into new ML domains. If you want to learn more about our stack behind autonomous driving, please look here. If you want to learn more about our ML Infrastructure, here is one of our past talks at re:Invent.

### **In this role, you will:**

* Lead the design, implementation, and operation of training performance optimizations (data/tensor/pipeline parallelism, mixed precision, gradient checkpointing, GPU kernels) to scale VLM, VLA, and Foundation model training.
* Own the technical strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for RL framework and RL performance optimization for driving foundation models.
* Drive profiling and root-cause analysis of throughput bottlenecks across the compute, compiler, framework, and cluster-networking stack.
* Partner with ML researchers, data engineers, and hardware engineers to define requirements and make architectural decisions for large-scale training infrastructure.
* Build custom kernels and benchmarks that track and validate performance gains across the stack.
* Mentor engineers and raise the team’s technical bar through design reviews and best practices.

### **Qualifications**

Note: **You do not have to meet all the requirements** below to be considered for this position:

* 7+ years of total experience, including 4+ years on large-scale model training platforms, with a record of leading projects end to end.
* Deep experience with distributed training frameworks (Megatron-LM, TorchTitan) and efficiently utilizing GPU/accelerator clusters at scale.
* Experience with RL frameworks (Verl/MILES) and algorithms (GRPO, PPO).
* Experience with collective communication libraries (e.g., NCCL) and optimizing communication/compute overlap in multi-node training.
* Strong command of profiling tools (NVIDIA Nsight, PyTorch Profiler, or XLA/JAX profiling) to find and resolve training bottlenecks.
* Proficiency in Python or C++.
* Experience with ML compilers, performance tooling, or hardware/software co-design (GPU/TPU/accelerator architectures).
* Ability to influence across teams and communicate technical tradeoffs to both researchers and engineers.

**About Zoox**

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

**Accommodations**

If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

***A Final Note:***

*You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.*

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > DSP Architecture and Design

**General Summary**

Qualcomm is seeking a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (6+ years of experience) to join the Core Platform Kernel software team. The Core Platform Kernel team develops and deploys real-time operating system (RTOS) software across multiple subsystems on Qualcomm SoCs, servicing Mobile Handset, XR, Compute, Automotive, Cloud AI, and IoT market segments. The team is responsible for the deployment and evolution of two RTOS platforms at scale: QuRT OS and Zephyr RTOS.

  

As part of Qualcomm's continued investment in open source software, this role will help drive our Zephyr strategy and serve as a technical leader for Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr ecosystem. We are specifically seeking engineers who can contribute to and help maintain upstream Zephyr components while enabling Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm products. This role is well suited for engineers who enjoy deep technical work, influence system architecture, collaborate across organizational boundaries, and have a passion for building software that benefits both Qualcomm products and the broader open-source community.

  

What You'll Do As a Staff Engineer, you will:

* Design, implement, and maintain RTOS and low-level system software components.
* Own and drive resolution of complex system-level issues involving performance, stability, scalability, and correctness.
* Lead feature development from problem definition through deployment.
* Analyze crash dumps, traces, and logs to perform deep root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate closely with hardware, systems, validation, and software teams to deliver robust solutions.
* Participate actively in design and code reviews, influencing technical direction and engineering standards.
* Drive Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr open-source community through technical discussions, code reviews, and upstream collaboration.
* Mentor engineers on upstream development practices, code quality, and community engagement.
Influence technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and software quality initiatives across the organization.  

  

You will be expected to take ownership of key technical areas, make sound engineering tradeoffs, and help raise the effectiveness of the broader team through technical leadership and example. QuRT OS QuRT OS is Qualcomm's real-time operating system optimized for the Hexagon DSP, enabling high-performance, low-power workloads including edge AI, modem processing, audio, sensor processing, and other specialized compute workloads. In the QuRT OS space, you will:

* Drive enhancements to expose the full capability of the Hexagon processor architecture.
* Design and implement new RTOS features with attention to correctness, performance, and maintainability.
* Own features end-to-end: requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, integration, and support.
Improve CI, automation, and test infrastructure to increase development velocity and software quality.  

  

Zephyr RTOS The Core Platform Kernel team is a major adopter of Zephyr RTOS across Qualcomm SoCs and subsystems. We maintain a scalable Zephyr platform while contributing improvements back to the upstream community. This role is focused on technical leadership, stewardship, and upstream engineering within the Zephyr ecosystem. Successful candidates will possess a strong understanding of RTOS architecture, embedded systems, and open-source development practices. In the Zephyr space, you will:

* Serve as a maintainer or technical owner for key Zephyr subsystems, drivers, platform infrastructure, or architecture components.
* Review, guide, and integrate contributions from both internal and external developers.
* Design and implement new Zephyr capabilities with an emphasis on upstream acceptance and long-term maintainability.
* Lead architecture discussions and influence technical direction within the Zephyr project.
* Drive Qualcomm's upstream contribution strategy and ensure internal development aligns with community best practices.
* Collaborate with maintainers and contributors from other companies across the Zephyr ecosystem.
* Enable Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm platforms through board support packages, architecture enablement, driver development, and system software integration.
* Improve testing, CI infrastructure, release readiness, and software quality across upstream and Qualcomm-maintained components.
* Represent Qualcomm in technical working groups, design reviews, and community discussions.
Help shape the future evolution of Zephyr through upstream contributions, reviews, and technical leadership.  

  

**How You Work (Tools, Automation & Modern Engineering)**

Staff Engineers at Qualcomm are expected to be force multipliers, not just individual contributors. In practice, this means:

* Applying modern development tools, including AI-assisted tools, when they meaningfully improve productivity or code quality.
* Leveraging automation, scripting, CI systems, debuggers, profilers, static analysis tools, and simulation environments to improve engineering effectiveness.
* Exercising strong engineering judgment regarding when automation is appropriate and when deeper hands-on investigation is required.
Continuously identifying opportunities to improve engineering workflows, developer productivity, and software quality.  

  

You are not expected to be an AI expert, but you are expected to be tool-fluent, curious, adaptable, and pragmatic.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

OR
  
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relate

Expand human ambition in the physical world.

At Watney, firmware engineers write the firmware for our robots’ mainboards and actuators, and bring up new boards with our manufacturing partners. They work with our mechanical, electrical, and ML teams as new sensors and embodiments arrive.

How far firmware can take a robot on its own is still an open question: which faults a board can recover from without a person, and how one design carries across new boards and embodiments.

* Build and run automated hardware-in-the-loop tests across embodiments.
* Build the common firmware base for mainboards and actuators, in Rust and C.
* Work with the ML and mechanical teams to prototype and validate new sensors.

* Have shipped production firmware to millions of devices.
* Have written production firmware in Rust, C, or both.
* Have debugged communication buses on real hardware.
* Have built or operated hardware-in-the-loop test infrastructure.

new_jobs.title: Production Systems Engineer, Edge
new_jobs.description:
Meta's Edge compute fleet - around 162,000 servers in more than 600 locations worldwide - is how our users reach us. Unlike most of Meta's hardware, this fleet doesn't run in our own data centers: it lives in Edge PoPs terminating user connections, and in ISP and cell-service-provider locations running caching for partner networks.The Edge Hardware team is the hardware engineering partner to the Traffic organization that owns this footprint. We are a key partner in hardware selection and qualification, qualify firmware across every component, investigate failures in the deployed fleet, and define the detection and remediation tooling that keeps it healthy. The work sits directly in the user path: a hardware fault we miss becomes a user-visible availability problem. You'd work day to day with an engineer being hired alongside you, and with the team in Dublin who owns the area today - plus the wider Edge and hardware reliability teams, and your Traffic partners, on both coasts.  
  
  

### **Production Systems Engineer, Edge Responsibilities:**

* As a Production Systems Engineer on Edge Hardware, you'll contribute across New Product Introduction and Sustaining work on Meta's Edge compute fleet, taking ownership of well-defined areas and growing your scope as you ramp
* Qualify successive server generations and new platforms into the fleet, and sustain existing generations for the 3–5 years they remain deployed
* Build out failure detection and remediation coverage - new checks, porting existing validation to new vendor hardware, cleaning up noisy checkers that currently create work for partner operations teams
* Help requalify components that have reached end of sale (new NICs, SSDs), unblocking Meta's ability to purchase Edge servers and replace failed parts
* Improve fleet visibility, surfacing failures we currently detect late or not at all
* Take on part of the firmware qualification cadence - NIC, BIOS, BMC, management engine, GPU VBIOS, PSU, flash

new_jobs.title: Vehicle Battery Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Anduril's Maritime Division is transforming American sea power to meet the defining national security challenges of our era and secure our future of maritime dominance.  
  
We are scaling at a historic pace, anchored by Arsenal-2, our new software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base.  
  
Arsenal-2 is purpose-built to break long-standing industrial bottlenecks and scale production of critical components for the Navy's Virginia-class attack submarines to support fleet requirements. At the same time, it will build the industrial muscle to field our next-generation AUVs at scale.  
  
We aren't waiting for the new shipyard to be completed. The work on this transformation starts right now, with development inside our new 160,000 square foot Proto-Factory in Orange County, California, where the team is already laying the foundation. As the prototyping hub for Arsenal-2, this facility gives us a multi-year head start, proving out the advanced manufacturing methods, digital workflows, and quality systems that will scale across our broader shipyard network.  
  
In Anduril's Maritime Division, we are actively building America's next decisive advantage at sea—and this is the moment to join us.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

You will own energy storage system design for a maritime autonomous vehicle. Reporting to the Vehicle Systems Lead, you will drive cell selection, module design, thermal management, and pressure-rated packaging for battery systems that must deliver ultra-long-range endurance under pressure.  
  
Your spectrum of support will be diverse in nature and require you to leverage your technical expertise as well as leadership skills to set objectives, build cross-functional teams, and rapidly drive to completion. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience will be key in making sure the right design, analysis, and test steps are completed to ensure success. The ideal candidate will leverage their experience executing and successfully completing prior highly optimized multi-disciplinary projects.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own energy storage architecture: cell chemistry selection, module design, and pack integration
* Design pressure-rated battery enclosures for full-ocean-depth operation
* Perform battery sizing, energy budget analysis, and cycle life modeling
* Drive thermal management design for safe operation across environmental conditions
* Define charging profiles and integration with external charging interfaces
* Interface with energy distribution, structural, and production teams
* Support prototype builds, testing, and design-for-manufacturability reviews
* Contribute to safety analysis for energy storage systems
* Travel up to 25% to test sites and vendor facilities

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent
* 5+ years of experience in battery system design, energy storage, or power electronics

The DeviceOS engineering team owns the core platform software running across all physical Clover smart devices and supports global mass manufacturing software pipelines. * Hands-on experience adapting Android frameworks, system services, and Hardware Abstraction Layers (HAL).
* Proficient with AOSP build tools and revision control workflows, including Git, Gerrit, repo, Android.bp, and Android.mk.
* Deep understanding of platform security protocols, encryption/decryption, PKI certificate management, and Hardware Security Modules (HSM).

**Experience that would be great to have**

  

* Hands-on experience with Android HAL development or Project Treble architecture.
* Experience working directly with the Linux Kernel for Android, device drivers, or ARM TrustZone / TEE environments.

new_jobs.title: Cloud Production Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. Our Production Platform Engineers are responsible for the performance of the compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms that run Meta's production workloads, both in our own data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers. They are responsible for the health of the server fleet, from NPI production operational test through end of life. Responsibilities include identifying systemic hardware, firmware, and tooling issues; engaging in hands on problem solving; and collaborating effectively with engineering, tooling, and onsite provisioning and break fix teams to improve performance of the fleet.This position carries the cloud platform scope for the team. Meta's cloud footprint is growing toward the scale of the fleet we run ourselves, across several cloud providers, and product groups expect the same reliability and availability from it. Because Meta does not design this hardware and does not have physical access to it, the engineer in this role works through each cloud provider's own repair and escalation process, reaches diagnostic conclusions with partial telemetry, and builds the technical evidence that supports cloud provider accountability. This remains a platform engineering role across both environments. It is not a cloud only role.This position requires a high degree of understanding of our platforms, leveraging technical expertise and using data to identify trends across the fleet and proactively identify and mitigate performance and reliability issues. Experience organizing and prioritizing work across multiple teams in a large-scale, distributed environment and experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes in a large-scale, distributed environment.  
  
  

### **Cloud Production Platform Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Serve as subject matter expert for compute, storage, and accelerator (GPU) platforms in Meta's production data centers and on capacity Meta consumes from cloud providers, anticipating and diagnosing issues for the operations teams, and escalating as appropriate to hardware design and NPI teams
* Act as the deep escalation point for cloud hardware issues, taking handoffs from the cloud triage teams and driving hardware and software investigation through to resolution
* Identify systemic hardware issues within a single cloud provider and across cloud providers, separating cloud provider specific behavior from platform behavior already characterized in Meta's own fleet
* Represent Meta's reliability, diagnosability, and serviceability expectations to cloud providers, compiling the technical evidence those conversations depend on
* Carry findings from the cloud environment back into Meta's own platform work, and apply what is already known about Meta's platforms to accelerate diagnosis in the cloud
* Provide end to end lifecycle support (operational test through end of life decommissioning) of hardware platforms and new technologies in the data centers
* Drive complex technical investigations globally and spanning multiple disciplines such as Hardware, Software/Firmware, Networking and Power & Cooling
* Analyze health of the global fleet of servers to proactively identify systemic issues, and take appropriate action to quickly mitigate impact
* Work closely with HW Engineering, Release to Production, and Systems Integration teams to take new server and storage platforms into mass production in the data centers
* Identify risks early in new hardware programs and contribute the test methods needed to characterize the product and assure end customer needs are met
* Act as product owner for specific server and/or storage platforms. Perform and drive RCA and CA, in collaboration with hardware and software engineering teams
* Issue timely alerts and fixes to operations teams, and assure a robust feedback pipeline to engineering teams
* Build strong relationships and collaboration with engineering and cross functional teams across the company. Actively solicit feedback from teams, and use that feedback to improve operational effectiveness as infrastructure scales
* Provide serviceability feedback on production hardware resulting in more efficient repair activities

**Description**

SAIC is seeking an experienced FPGA/Embedded-Systems Engineer to design, verify, and integrate advanced digital processing architectures. The ideal candidate will possess strong FPGA development experience using VHDL and Verilog, along with embedded software skills and a deep understanding of digital signal processing, timing closure, and Linux-based workflows. This role requires the ability to solve complex technical problems and deliver robust production-ready designs.

**Qualifications**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop FPGA architectures using VHDL-2019, VHDL-2008, VHDL, and basic Verilog as required.

* Implement high-throughput streaming data paths, including FIFO structures, CDC mechanisms, circular buffers, clocking architectures, and timing constraints.
* Perform FPGA debug through HDL simulation, waveform analysis, hardware debugging, and logic analyzer tools.

* Simulate HDL using tools such as Aldec Riviera Pro and ModelSim for detailed design verification.
* Build customized embedded Linux distributions for MPSoC and Versal devices using Yocto.
* Set up and debug FlexLM license servers as part of maintaining development environments.
* Leverage AI/ML code assistants to enhance development efficiency when appropriate.
* Use Git for version control and collaborative software and FPGA development.

Bachelors and fourteen (14) years or more experience; Masters and twelve (12) years or more experience; PhD or JD and nine (9) years or more experience.

* Additional experience may be substituted for a degree

* Must be a U.S. citizen with an active TS/SCI with Polygraph level clearance

  
Target salary range: $200,001 - $240,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Location Greenbelt, Maryland Category Support Services Job Type Full time Job Id R3000676 Posted Date 10/16/2026

  

**Title:**

Senior Electro-Optical Systems Engineer  
  

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.

  
  

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions.

  
  

Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact.

  
  

*Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment.*

  
  
  

**Position Summary**

  
  

KBR is seeking a Senior Electro-Optical Engineer to support the MIST Contract with NASA at Goddard Space Flight Center. The Senior Electro-Optical Engineer will work on projects from inception at the concept development stage to completion at the product space flight qualification stage. The position requires a specialist's level of knowledge in the design and laboratory testing of remote sensing systems and knowledge of radiometric modeling, radiometric calibration test techniques and algorithms, and level one data processing algorithms and techniques.

  
  

**Must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident**

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

* Conduct the electro-optical design, development, and test of both active and passive remote sensor systems and subsystems for making difficult and complex measurements for science and exploration spaceflight applications for both autonomous and human-rated systems.
* Responsible for the administration, design, selection and modification of the required electro-optical system applications and the development of systems requirements and verification methods.
* Develop radiometric models of remote sensing instruments and error sources.
* Interacts with end users to resolve engineering design issues and limitations, provide solutions, and coordinate with applications development to design system enhancements as necessary.
* Performs laser related Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) as well as Hazard Analysis for functional safety to identify, manage and reduce risks.
* Possesses both theoretical and experimental expertise in radiometry, radiometric calibration techniques, infrared detectors, programming, data acquisition and processing, and atmospheric spectroscopy.
* Possesses knowledge of electromagnetic sources, such as lasers and blackbodies, along with the means of optically collecting and detecting these sources. The development and deployment of advanced remote-sensing measurement systems is by nature a multi-disciplinary activity which involves a group of individuals with wide ranging skills and abilities. Interpersonal skills, communication skills, and team skills are essential.
* Performance monitoring and enhancements and Validation of performance via NIST calibration of Check Samples. Bidirectional Scatter Distribution Function calibration related experience is a plus.
* Work with Mechanical & Systems Engineers, thermal/structural engineers, customers, and vendors to produce opto-mechanical system development projects in cross-functional engineering teams
* Work with other engineers, technicians, manufacturing, and quality engineers in a team environment
* Prepare and deliver technical presentations, provide inputs to the project schedule and support project level reviews
* Write test procedures, plans & reports as necessary
  

  
  
  
  

**Required Education, Experience, & Skills:**

* MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Electro-Optical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 12 + years of experience as an electrical and/or electro-optical engineer in the aerospace arena.

* Experience with one or more of the following: BRDF measurements, fiber optics, fiber lasers, spectroscopy, integrated photonics, laser communication systems and RF photonics.

* Strong written and oral communication skills

* Strong knowledge in using Zemax or Code V for Aerospace applications with experience in design and/or analysis of optical assemblies and precision mechanisms.

* Knowledge of detectors, detector systems, fiber optics and the design and development of laser systems is desired
* Experience in the development and qualification of Flight Electro-Optical Systems
* Comfortable working in a cross-disciplinary environment to develop and implement new designs or help trouble-shoot existing ones.

* Knowledge of optics fabrication and testing methods.
* Demonstrate ethical and professional behavior in accordance with company values.
  

**Preferred Experience & Skills:**

* Solid understanding of the NASA flight hardware development process and methodology is strongly desired
* Knowledge of optical metrology and interferometry
* Knowledge of optical coating design, process and inspection
* Knowledge in using Zemax or Code V for Aerospace applications with experience in design and/or analysis of optical assemblies and precision mechanisms.
* Experience in the development and qualification of Flight Optical Systems is prefer

new_jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton has an immediate opening for a Jr./Mid-level **Software Engineer** who will join our team at the White Sands Complex in Las Cruces, NM. Your role in this position will include software requirements gathering, software design, development, troubleshooting and debugging.

  

Peraton is the prime contractor on the SENSE contract for NASA at the White Sands Complex near Las Cruces, New Mexico. Operating here are two functionally identical satellite ground terminals: The White Sands Ground Terminal, and the second TDRSS Ground Terminal. These two terminals ensure uninterrupted communications between various ground stations, NASA’s orbiting fleet of Tracking and Data Relay Satellites (TDRS), customer spacecraft (satellites), and the computer systems that support such spacecraft. The WSC also serves as an interface for distributing satellite data to control centers and scientists who then use the daily influx of data to expand our ever-growing knowledge of the Earth and the universe.

  

**This position will be responsible for:**

* Performs systems modeling, simulation and analysis to provide appropriate telemetry, tracking, and command software solutions.
* Provides input for documentation of new or existing programs to ensure information accessibility, as required.
* Participates in designing, developing, troubleshooting and analyzing software programs that operate with hardware systems.
* Assists in customizing purchased applications and assists in maintaining program libraries and manuals based on research and customer needs.
* Provides feedback and reports to management on the status and availability of software and hardware to ensure proper functioning.
* Works with customer(s) to provide hands-on first level support.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics or related technical field and 2 years of relative experience.

* Experience working with software design principles.
* A willingness to learn and remain agile in a dynamic environment.
* The ability to work in a team environment.

​​ASRC Federal Advanced Research LLC (AFAR)​ is seeking an ​Electrical Engineer​ to join our ​Air-to-Ground Communications (AG COMM)​ team that supports the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). This is a ​full-time​ ​on-site​ position at the ​Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC)​ in ​Oklahoma City, OK​.
  
  
​​The AG COMM program comprises the infrastructure, facilities, and protocols that allow air traffic controllers to communicate via voice and data with pilots in flight.​
  
  
Citizenship/Permanent Residency Requirement
  
  
All candidates must have the following to pass the Federal Background Investigation and obtain the FAA Public Trust security clearance.
  

* Be a US Citizen.
* Has resided in the US for three (3) consecutive years.
* RealID Driver’s License/ID or current US Passport.

Relocation Requirement
  
  
Candidate must reside or be willing to relocate within a commutable distance to the ​Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC)​ in ​Oklahoma City, OK​.
  
  
Education & Experience Requirement
  
  
All non-US Degrees must have a US Equivalency Certificate provided by the candidate at the time of application.
  

* A ​Bachelors (ABET)​ degree in ​Engineering or related IT field, such as Physics, Aerospace, Chemistry, Computer Science, or Mathematics.​
* Experience with NAS facilities, systems, and equipment is highly desirable.​
* 3 - 6​ years of related work experience.

Required Skills
  

* Solid foundation in circuit theory, power systems, grounding, and signal integrity.
* Skilled in interpreting schematics, wiring diagrams, and system block diagrams.
* Structured troubleshooting methodology including root cause analysis and fault isolation.
* Understanding of system integration principles involving hardware, firmware, and software interaction.
* Experience with programming in Python.
* Supports field service calls and explains complex technical issues to non-technical personnel.​
* Ability to:
* Work independently, as well as on a team, in an agile environment.
* Research, troubleshoot and problem solve quickly.
* Learn on the job/willing to self-teach.
* Communicate effectively through verbal and written communication with high organization.
* Write clear, structured technical documentation.

* Familiarity with industry safety standards and electrical best practices.
* Support for electrical engineering tasks in lab, field, and production environments.
* Participation in after-hours or mission-critical support when required.
* Working knowledge of Windows, UNIX, and UNIX-like operating systems (AIX, Linux).
* Troubleshooting and problem-solving experience.
* Experience with networking protocols and technologies including TCP, UDP, DHCP, SNMP, and VoIP.
* Understanding the importance of testing throughout all phases of engineering and programming.
* Ability to merge and apply technical skills across multiple environments and tasks.​

Essential Daily Job Duties
  
  

* Evaluate electrical systems, equipment, and applications.
* Take and support field service calls.
* Provide real-time troubleshooting support to field technicians.
* Document incident findings and corrective actions.
* Support remote and on-site system diagnostics.
* Participate in after-hours or mission-critical support when required.
* Contribute to system and hardware design, development, and testing.
* Create and update documentation for systems and hardware.​

Work Environment
  
  

* Standard flexible work schedule.
* Travel is ​10 - 25%​.
* Cubicle environment.

new_jobs.title: Electrical Engineer I, Manufacturing and Test
new_jobs.description:
**Electrical Engineer I – Manufacturing & Test**

**Reading Thermal Systems (RTS) | Reading Bakery Systems**

Put your electrical engineering knowledge to work on instruments that measure temperature, heat flux, air velocity, and humidity.

RTS is seeking an Electrical Engineer I – Manufacturing & Test to support the manufacture, testing, calibration, and improvement of thermal measurement products, including the SCORPION® data logging system. You’ll work alongside experienced engineering and manufacturing personnel, gain hands-on experience with sensors and electronics, and help ensure products meet established quality and performance requirements.

This early-career opportunity is suited to an electrical engineering graduate who enjoys hands-on testing, troubleshooting, and practical problem-solving.

**What You’ll Do**

Your primary responsibilities will be:

* **Outgoing quality assurance — approximately 50%:** Test finished products before shipment, document findings, and verify compliance with established procedures.
* **Calibration support — approximately 25%:** Calibrate customer data loggers and sensors returned for service.

The remaining 25% of your role will include:

* Investigating production issues and troubleshooting circuitry, components, firmware, and measurement systems with guidance from experienced engineering staff.
* Creating and updating test specifications, work instructions, manufacturing records, and training materials.
* Helping develop, build, and validate production test systems, fixtures, and calibration procedures.
* Conducting engineering tests and analyzing product accuracy, reliability, and performance.
* Supporting the transition of prototypes into repeatable manufacturing processes.
* Assisting with component substitutions and engineering changes.
* Reviewing production and field data to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Supporting product assembly, repair, and manufacturing activities as needed.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Foundational knowledge of circuits, printed circuit boards, microprocessors, C programming, and CAD.
* Hands-on testing and troubleshooting experience from coursework, laboratory work, projects, internships, or employment.
* Familiarity with hardware and software interfaces used in test equipment or measurement systems.
* Interest in sensors, instrumentation, physics, and thermal measurement.
* Ability to interpret schematics, engineering drawings, and technical instructions.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to handle small components and perform fine-pitch soldering and rework.
* A willingness to learn, follow established procedures, and work collaboratively.

Experience with calibration, embedded firmware, data acquisition, thermal systems, or production fixtures is a plus.

**Work Requirements**

This position may require overnight domestic travel and occasional international travel. Responsibilities include regularly lifting or moving up to 10 pounds and occasionally up to 50 pounds. Work may involve production baking environments with high temperatures, humidity, noise, and other manufacturing hazards. Appropriate personal protective equipment is required.

new_jobs.description:
Overview:

**Job Title: Electrical Controls Engineer**

**Location:** **Arnold AFB,** **TN**

**Job Family Code:** **X -Aviation Services**

**Function/Branch:** **Engineering/ID&C Branch**

**Directorate:** **Engineering & Tech Support**

**Position Type:** **Regular, Full-Time**

**Pay Type:** **Exempt**

**Grade****:** **L06 (XA0605) - L07 (XA0705)**

**Salary Range****:** **L06:** **$69,000 - $92,000; L07: $73,500 - $101,000/ per year**

**Overview**

Beyond New Horizons, LLC (BNH) has an opening for Electrical Controls Engineering that will be part of the Propulsion Instrumentation, Data and Controls (ID&C) group supporting the Test Operations and Sustainment contract at Arnold Engineering Development Complex at Arnold Air Force Base, TN. The Electrical Controls Engineer will work as a member of an integrated team responsible for operating and maintaining the United States Air Force Test Operations and sustainment efforts.

This position requires occasional scheduled extended hours and/or weekend work to meet critical contractual requirements and occasional unscheduled night or weekend support in emergency situations.

***Open to internal and external candidates.***

**Job Summary**

**Note**: *Join our elite engineering team as an Electrical Controls Engineer, where you will directly drive cutting-edge testing operations and system design at the historic AEDC complex. You will spearhead the integration of sophisticated motion and process control systems to ensure precision positioning and seamless execution of complex test sequences. Additionally, you will optimize vital test cell control systems, managing closed-loop operations of complex hardware like motors, compressors, and pneumatics to deliver exact test conditions.*

*In this dual-capability role, you will also serve as the Systems Engineer for critical low-voltage power infrastructure. You will oversee the integration, reliability, and safety of low-voltage power distribution systems, including electric motors, DC rectifiers, and electrical load banks, ensuring robust power delivery to crucial test cell components. By applying advanced concepts in signal processing, control theory, power distribution, and software, you will play a pivotal role in delivering mission-critical results for national security testing.*

**Job Duties:**

**Some of the specific duties for this entry-level position include:**

* **System Design & Documentation:**Develop ID&C system requirements, concept sketches, specifications, and material quantity estimates using CAD/CAE tools.
* **Test Operations & System Support:**Deploy, support, and monitor ID&C systems before and during active aerospace ground test operations.
* **Troubleshooting & Lifecycle Maintenance:**Diagnose, troubleshoot, and return ID&C systems to service while supporting ongoing lifecycle engineering and maintenance.
* **Software & Automated Control**: Design, develop, and maintain Automated Control and Human Machine Interface (HMI) software.
* **Engineering Analysis & Review:**Evaluate standard engineering methods and review technical design documents, drawings, and recommendations from vendors and subcontractors.
* **Testing & Quality Assurance:**Design, develop, and execute comprehensive System Verification and Validation (V&V) test plans.
* **Project Execution & Compliance:** Complete assigned engineering tasks on schedule, utilizing established common work processes and procedures across the assigned function.
* It is a condition of employment to wear company issued PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) in accordance with supervisory direction and company policy.
* Perform other related duties as required.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or Mechatronics from an accredited college or university
* Must be able to obtain and maintain an active security clearance and maintain authorized user access to the AEDC local area network.
* U,S. Citizenship is required due to federal government contract compliance requirements and the necessity to access secure federal databases and networks on Arnold Air Force Base.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior intern or co-op experience
* (2) years of engineering experience
* Multi-disciplinary knowledge or experience (electrical engineering, mechatronics, control systems, etc.) is a plus
* Ability to work in a dynamic environment with flexibility to accomplish mission objectives
* Strong communication skills (including verbal and written)
* Demonstrated experience successfully building relationships with teams across engineering and craft workforce
* Strong organizational skills to track and facilitate progress on projects
* Demonstrated proactiveness and initiative to drive results
* Exhibits strong level of technical curiosity and desire to seek understanding
* Participates in and fosters a work environment that is based upon openness, trust communication, teamwork, empowerment, innovation, and satisfaction
* Active Department of Defense Secret Security Clearance

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salaries
* Continuing education assistance
* Multiple healthcare benefits packages
* 401K with employer matching
* Paid time off (PTO) along with a federally recognized holiday schedule

**Who We Are**

Beyond New Horizons (BNH) is a fully populated joint venture of Astrion and Fluor Federal Services, Inc. formed to provide unmatched Test Operations and Sustainment services for the Arnold Engineering Development Complex.

We chose our name to serve as an enduring reminder of our commitment to AEDC’s rich aerospace research and development legacy anchored in AEDC’s Toward New Horizons founding study and the unprecedented opportunities to greatly expand AEDC’s capabilities and capacity Beyond those existing today. Leveraging the capabilities of our parent companies, BNH specializes in testing and evaluation for military and space systems combined with proven capability in large-scale Government program management

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer I
new_jobs.description:
**Company Information:**  
Twenty-Six Defense, headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, is a leading provider of high-performance products, system solutions, and aftermarket support services focusing on the defense, homeland security, and commercial aviation markets. With facilities throughout the U.S., Twenty-Six Defense supports those who contribute to the national security of the United States. Twenty-Six Defense is wholly owned by Elbit Systems Ltd. (NASDAQ: ESLT and TASE: ESLT), a global high-technology company engaged in a wide range of programs for innovative defense and commercial applications.
  
Fueled by more than 800 talented employees and a proud 65-year legacy of night vision production excellence, Twenty-Six Defense’s Warfighter Systems business is rooted in the heart of Virginia’s Roanoke Valley. Surrounded by the scenic beauty of the Blue Ridge Mountains, you’ll find a unique blend of southern hospitality, outdoor adventure, and the energy of a thriving city – all alongside a purpose you can be proud of coming to work each day.
  
As a world leader in low-light sensor technology, the Warfighter Systems team is engineering the future of image intensifiers and night vision goggle systems as we enter a new era of the networked battlespace. Trusted by the U.S. and nearly 100 allied countries, our technology supports those in harm’s way during the most critical moments, with one goal in mind: bring them home safely.
  
The work our employees perform each day plays a direct role in national security, and our shared purpose is what truly makes Warfighter Systems so extraordinary. Join our collaborative team, where each voice is valued, and you can thrive, develop, and make a real impact!
  
  
Job Summary
  
The Software Automations Engineer works with a team of automation engineers and process engineers to translate process control concepts into machinery, support and modify software interfacing with hardware on existing equipment, and design new program controlled processes to meet manufacturing requirements. Basic electronics knowledge and familiarity with industrial protocols and interface techniques are applied to the developed programming solutions.
  
This role participates in the full software development life cycle, including specification, design, programming, implementation, integration, commissioning, and debugging. The position offers opportunities to apply program design to robotics, electronics, machine vision, analog and digital signal applications, data systems, and mechatronics.
  
Software development experience should include proficiency in various computer languages to address programming objectives related to automated process control, test/measurement, and data integration. Programs are created to connect construction and testing processes to test equipment, data collection systems, analog and digital control points, machine vision systems, motion control, and other specialized peripherals.
  
Responsibilities
  
The Software Automations Engineer collaborates with technicians and engineers across multiple departments to:
  

* Document project requests to create statements of work, use cases, and related documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve system quality, efficiency, and robustness.
* Write clean, well tested code with effective error handling.
* Create test plans and ensure quality using industry best practices such as unit and regression testing.
* Develop proofs of concept for new and innovative solutions.
* Enable data movement between equipment and databases.
* Break down large, complex technical projects into defined stages and deliverables.
* Work across multiple software and hardware platforms.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science (BSCS), Computer Engineering (BSCE), Electrical Engineering (BSEE), or a major in computer programming/engineering with a minor in electrical engineering.
* Proficiency with Visual Studio, SQL Server, MS Office, and Windows.
* Experience with relational databases and SQL.
* Ability to produce and maintain high quality, tested, and efficient code following industry standards.
* Strong understanding of design patterns, multithreading, and distributed systems.
* Experience in object oriented analysis and design using common design patterns.
* Practical understanding and motivation to apply software programming skills to control electronic components and interfaced systems.
* Knowledge of industrial networking.
* Versatile programming skills.
* Strong troubleshooting and investigative skills for equipment, process, and data modifications.
* Experience with source code version control systems such as GIT, TFS, SourceSafe, Subversion, etc.
* Ability to obtain a security clearance is required.

**Here Are Some of the Great Benefits We Offer:**  

* Most locations offer a 9/80 schedule, providing every other Friday off
* Competitive compensation & 401(k) program to plan for your future
* Robust medical, dental, vision, & disability coverage with qualified wellness discounts
* Basic Life Insurance and Additional Life & AD&D Insurances are available
* Flexible Vacation & PTO
* Paid Parental Leave
* Generous Employee Referral Program
* Voluntary Benefits Available: Longer Term Care, Legal, Identity Theft, Pet Insurance, and more
* Voluntary Tricare Supplement available for military retirees

Why Roanoke, Virginia?
  

* Lower cost of living
* Family-friendly area
* Career and economic growth
* Scenic beauty
* Outdoor enthusiast’s dream

Meta is seeking a experienced hardware engineering professional with technical leadership experience and skills in Server Hardware, high performance Compute, Storage, Accelerators (GPU), and/or Networking, ideally in a data center environment. Our data centers, the global fleet of servers installed in them, and the growing cloud capacity Meta operates alongside them are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure efficiently operates and on which our innovative services are delivered. new_jobs.title: Software Automation Engineer II
new_jobs.description:
**Company Information:**  
Twenty-Six Defense, headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, is a leading provider of high-performance products, system solutions, and aftermarket support services focusing on the defense, homeland security, and commercial aviation markets. With facilities throughout the U.S., Twenty-Six Defense supports those who contribute to the national security of the United States. Twenty-Six Defense is wholly owned by Elbit Systems Ltd. (NASDAQ: ESLT and TASE: ESLT), a global high-technology company engaged in a wide range of programs for innovative defense and commercial applications.
  
Fueled by more than 800 talented employees and a proud 65-year legacy of night vision production excellence, Twenty-Six Defense’s Warfighter Systems business is rooted in the heart of Virginia’s Roanoke Valley. Surrounded by the scenic beauty of the Blue Ridge Mountains, you’ll find a unique blend of southern hospitality, outdoor adventure, and the energy of a thriving city – all alongside a purpose you can be proud of coming to work each day.
  
As a world leader in low-light sensor technology, the Warfighter Systems team is engineering the future of image intensifiers and night vision goggle systems as we enter a new era of the networked battlespace. Trusted by the U.S. and nearly 100 allied countries, our technology supports those in harm’s way during the most critical moments, with one goal in mind: bring them home safely.
  
The work our employees perform each day plays a direct role in national security, and our shared purpose is what truly makes Warfighter Systems so extraordinary. Join our collaborative team, where each voice is valued, and you can thrive, develop, and make a real impact!
  
  
Job Summary
  
The Software Automation Engineer II works with a team of automation engineers and process engineers to translate process control concepts into machinery, support and modify software interfacing with hardware on existing equipment, and design new program controlled processes to meet manufacturing requirements. Basic electronics knowledge and familiarity with industrial protocols and interface techniques are applied to the developed programming solutions.
  
This role participates in the full software development life cycle, including specification, design, programming, implementation, integration, commissioning, and debugging. The position offers opportunities to apply program design to robotics, electronics, machine vision, analog and digital signal applications, data systems, and mechatronics.
  
Software development experience should include proficiency in various computer languages to address programming objectives related to automated process control, test/measurement, and data integration. Programs are created to connect construction and testing processes to test equipment, data collection systems, analog and digital control points, machine vision systems, motion control, and other specialized peripherals.
  
Responsibilities
  
The Software Automation Engineer II collaborates with technicians and engineers across multiple departments to:
  

* Document project requests to create statements of work, use cases, and related documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve system quality, efficiency, and robustness.
* Write clean, well tested code with effective error handling.
* Create test plans and ensure quality using industry best practices such as unit and regression testing.
* Develop proofs of concept for new and innovative solutions.
* Enable data movement between equipment and databases.
* Break down large, complex technical projects into defined stages and deliverables.
* Work across multiple software and hardware platforms.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science (BSCS), Computer Engineering (BSCE), Electrical Engineering (BSEE), or a major in computer programming/engineering with a minor in electrical engineering, 3 years of related experience.
* Proficiency with Visual Studio, SQL Server, MS Office, and Windows.
* Experience with relational databases and SQL.
* Ability to produce and maintain high quality, tested, and efficient code following industry standards.
* Strong understanding of design patterns, multithreading, and distributed systems.
* Experience in object oriented analysis and design using common design patterns.
* Practical understanding and motivation to apply software programming skills to control electronic components and interfaced systems.
* Knowledge of industrial networking.
* Versatile programming skills.
* Strong troubleshooting and investigative skills for equipment, process, and data modifications.
* Experience with source code version control systems such as GIT, TFS, SourceSafe, Subversion, etc.
* Ability to obtain a security clearance is required.

* Basic Life Insurance and Additional Life & AD&D Insurances are available

new_jobs.title: PKI Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Job ID: 2618069

**Location:** Springfield, VA, US

**Date Posted:** 2026-10-16

**Category:** Engineering and Sciences

**Subcategory:** Systems Engineer

**Schedule:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** No

**Minimum Clearance Required:** Top\_Secret

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** None

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

**Description**

**Position Description:**

The Enterprise & Mission Solution Business Unit currently has an opening for a Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Systems Engineer to support the Department of State (DoS) Bureau of Information Resource Management (IRM) PKI program. This program provides transparent security services in support of the Department’s goals to secure communications among Department staff and systems. The position falls under the "Vanguard 2.2.1" contract.

This is a senior-level PKI engineering position within the Vanguard 2.2.1 program’s Enterprise Engineering Office (EEO), providing PKI engineering and integration support, administering, maintaining, and deploying various PKI systems based on Entrust solutions, onsite at the various DoS Datacenters and at certain selected DoS domestic and overseas locations. The preferred candidate must possess strong skills in designing, installing, configuring, and maintaining PKI systems. Additionally the preferred candidate should have some experience in providing tier-3 level support in large enterprises.

  

**Description of Duties:**

* Providing PKI engineering support in the operation of a number of PKI systems deployed at the Department of State.
* Manage and maintain enclaved server hardware, storage, switches, server operating systems, and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).
* Directly working with customer to analyze requirements and then deploy security related solutions to meet those requirements.
* Providing problem analysis following any service issues to prevent recurrence
* Performing product evaluations and making product recommendations
* Identifying security risks to systems and suggest mitigations
* Developing test cases for software/hardware testing and developing test evaluation reports for stakeholders.
* Developing and updating systems documentation (e.g., ConOps, Operating procedures, systems architecture documents)

**Qualifications**

**Required Education/Experience:**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s degree or 3 years of relevant work experience with a Master’s degree
* Excellent MS-Windows Server administration & maintenance
* Familiarity with PKIs and related technologies (LDAP directories, HSMs, OCSP) and security practices
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Working knowledge of Entrust suite of PKI products (Security Manager, Administration Services, Security Manager Proxy) especially in a government setting.
* Hands-on experience with Hardware Security Modules (HSMs)
* Experience with directory products (LDAP), such as Critical Path or Active Directory
* CISSP, Security+, or similar certification
* Network device configuration – Cisco and Juniper firewalls and switches
* Network infrastructure diagnostics (TCP/IP general networking knowledge, network monitoring tools)
* Virtualization technologies (ESX/ESXi)
* Working knowledge of External storage solutions
* Interpersonal skills including the ability to collaborate effectively, self-awareness, and excellent written and oral communications.

**Desired Experience/Skills/Attributes:**

* Working knowledge of Entrust suite of PKI products (Security Manager, Administration Services, Security Manager Proxy) especially in a government setting.
* Hands-on experience with Hardware Security Modules (HSMs)
* Experience with directory products (LDAP), such as Critical Path or Active Directory
* CISSP, Security+, or similar certification
* Network device configuration – Cisco and Juniper firewalls and switches
* Network infrastructure diagnostics (TCP/IP general networking knowledge, network monitoring tools)
* Virtualization technologies (ESX/ESXi)
* Working knowledge of External storage solutions
* Interpersonal skills including the ability to collaborate effectively, self-awareness, and excellent written and oral communications.

  
Target salary range: $100,001 - $140,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.
